skills: Technology solutions related to clinical trial disclosure
jobs.description:
Working with Us

Challenging. Meaningful. Life-changing. Those aren't words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. You'll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities uncommon in scale and scope, alongside high-achieving teams. Take your career farther than you thought possible.

Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. Read more: careers.bms.com/working-with-us.

The Clinical Trial Disclosure Manager will provide the operational support of:

  • Redaction of clinical trial documents in accordance with evolving global regulations.
  • Manage and Coordinate redaction of clinical documents in accordance with EMA Policy 0070, Health Canada Public Release of Clinical Information (PRCI), EU Clinical Trial Regulation, and other global regulations.
  • Develop training and drive change management for novel processes related to the EU Clinical Trial Regulation and other regulations
  • Collaborate with Global Development Operations, Global Biostatisticians, Medical Writing, Submission Managers, and other stakeholders to operationalize redaction requirements
  • Provide vendor oversight to support data sharing and document redaction, as appropriate
  • Work with IT, as needed, to implement technology solutions related to clinical trial disclosure
  • Manage and track redaction book-of-work; compile and report on volume and performance metrics
  • Provide operational support to CT Results Managers, as required
  • Assist in monitoring the global regulatory environment and maintains working knowledge of disclosure requirements 
  • Communicate with internal and external stakeholders to improve on processes and manage unmet need 

Train new staff and develops job aids, work instructions, and user guides, as needed

jobs.title: Associate Site Payment Specialist (Fixed Term - 9 months)
jobs.description:
Premier Research is looking for a Associate Site Payment Specialist (Fixed Term - 9 months) to join our Functional Services Provider (FSP) team.

You will help biotech, medtech, and specialty pharma companies transform life-changing ideas and breakthrough science into new medicines, devices, and diagnostics. What we do is profoundly connected to saving and improving lives, and we recognize our team members are the most valuable asset in delivering success.

  • We are here to help you grow, to give you the skills and opportunities to excel at work with the flexibility and balance your life requires.
  • Your ideas influence the way we work, and your voice matters here.
  • As an essential part of our team, you help us deliver the medical innovation that patients are desperate for.

Join us and build your future here.

Position Summary

Responsible for completing site finance activities on behalf of the clinical trial sponsor, including but not limited to, study and global site contract setup in electronic investigator grant payment system and payment issue reconciliation.

Please Note: This is a fixed-term contract for 9 months. The working hours for this role are 1:30 PM – 9:30 PM IST. We are looking for immediate joiners who can start in August.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Reviews and interprets payment terms as outlined in global clinical site payment documents for each contract executed (e.g., North America and Rest of World (ROW) Clinical Trial Agreements (CTAs), budget grids, amendments, change orders and budget modification letters)
  • Ensures the payment configuration requirements are clearly delineated and defined for each study (backup requirements, manual vs. Electronic Data Capture (EDC) driven, bulk vs. individual line items, etc.)
  • Escalates ambiguous payment information to contract negotiator for clarification
  • Extracts payment information (e.g., amounts, caps, limits, backup requirements) from clinical site payment documents and populates machine readable payment system template to facilitate site set up in the payment system
  • Distinguishes between data driven and manual payment line items and configure accordingly
  • Reviews site setup in the payment system to ensure there are no errors
  • Collaborates and communicates with business partners
  • Ensures finance activities are completed within timelines as per service level agreements
  • Troubleshoots issues and ensures problems are seen to resolution
  • Performs additional duties as assigned

What We Are Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree, or international equivalent from an accredited institution, preferably in a finance, technical, clinical, or health-related field, or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • 1 to 2 years of practical experience in global site finance activities and/or clinical trial finance including hands-on experience writing, interpreting, or reviewing payment terms in global Clinical Trial Agreements (CTAs). Alternately, must have proven experience in all primary job functions
  • Demonstrates excellent English verbal and written communication skills
  • Excellent computer skills in a Microsoft Windows environment including proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite of tools (eg - Outlook, Work, Excel, etc)
  • Proven ability to drive a successful customer experience through positive customer interactions, provision of quality and timely deliverables, and task ownership
  • Strong analytical and organization skills, able to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities

jobs.title: Security Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
The Security Engineering Manager leads day-to-day operations of the Smartstream Security Engineering organisation - a Centre of Excellence team, that closely collaborates with embedded Security Engineers aligned to product lines, and a Security Champions community across engineering and business applications - owning execution of Secure SDLC, AppSec, and product-side cloud security across the product portfolio.

This is a player-manager role: set strategy and run the team but also engage personally with the most complex security initiatives, customer audits, regulatory exchanges, and incident escalations.

Requirements

  • Team leadership. Lead and grow a multi-disciplinary Security Engineering team across the Centre of Excellence and embedded engineer pods. Own hiring, performance, and career development; inspire and actively mentor the team
  • Secure SDLC governance Own and govern the Secure SDLC framework across the product portfolio, including security policies, standards, controls, and integration of security requirements throughout the software development lifecycle
  • Drive adoption of secure engineering practices, including SAST, SCA, AI-assisted code reviews, LLM-driven vulnerability scanning, and threat modelling, while advancing security maturity aligned with OWASP SAMM / BSIMM practices
  • Threat modelling & risk assessment. Sponsor early-stage architectural evaluations and threat-modelling reviews for new features, products, and material design changes - identifying and mitigating risks before code ships
  • VulnOps. Oversee the unified vulnerability-operations function - a single risk-scored backlog consolidating findings from SAST, DAST, SCA, container/IaC, secret scanning, CSPM, and pen testing. Drive remediation through ASPM/RBVM-powered prioritisation (exploitability, reachability, business impact), deduplication, automated fixes, and SLA-driven cadence with engineering - reducing noise to engineering and bringing down mean-time-to-remediate
  • Supply chain security. Establish and drive the software supply chain security strategy, including dependency management, SBOM governance, and third-party component risk management. Provide security oversight and remediation guidance while Product teams are responsible for implementing approved actions
  • Customer Security Assurance (Technical SME). Act as the technical security-controls SME for financial-institution customer security audits, vendor risk questionnaires, and contractual evidence requests - covering Secure SDLC, AppSec, VulnOps, threat modelling, pen testing, cloud security, supply-chain security, and incident response
  • External pen testing & regulatory evidence. Scope and drive third-party (external) penetration testing engagements requested by financial-institution customers. Maintain the technical evidence base for product alignment with SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, DORA, and applicable data-protection laws (e.g., GDPR)
  • Incident response. Own product-security incident command - direct remediation, internal triage, and customer communication for product CVEs and security incidents
  • Programme reporting. Run program dashboards for AppSec/cloud posture, finding burndown, SLA breach, MTTR, coverage, and pen-test status. Present to CISO, CTO, engineering leadership, and Board sub-committees
  • Security evangelism & mentorship. Educate engineering, product, and QA teams on secure coding, threat modelling, and secure-by-design. Sponsor and govern the Security Champions network (BSIMM Satellite model)
  • Vendor & tooling ownership. Own the AppSec and product-security toolchain across SAST, DAST, SCA, ASPM/RBVM, SBOM, secret scanning, LLM-assisted code scanning, and CSPM
  • Engineering partnership. Partner with engineering leads and business operations; ensure embedded SEs are integrated into sprint planning, release gating, and change management

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years in application / product and cloud security, including 4+ years leading AppSec or Security Engineering teams
  • Direct experience running secure SDLC programs for a B2B software vendor selling into regulated financial services
  • Hands-on familiarity with at least two of the following security frameworks and maturity models: OWASP SAMM, BSIMM, OWASP DSOMM, AWS Security Reference Architecture (AWS SRA), or equivalent cloud security frameworks
  • Strong knowledge of AWS cloud security and cloud vulnerability management, including S3 bucket misconfigurations, IAM risks, and CVE remediation. Working knowledge of DORA, PCI DSS v4.0.1, ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type 2, and GDPR and how each translates into engineering controls
  • Proven experience integrating security tooling into CI/CD pipelines at scale, and coaching engineers through threat-modelling methodologies (STRIDE, PASTA, LINDDUN, or equivalent)
  • Practical knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and OWASP AI Security & Privacy, with hands-on experience securing GenAI/LLM features against prompt injection, insecure output handling, data poisoning, and excessive agency
  • Understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP) security - server/client auth, scoped tool permissions, secret handling, tool poisoning, and indirect prompt injections
  • Demonstrated ability to lead financial-institution customer audit responses and engage with customer security teams and regulators
  • Strong grounding in modern AppSec tooling (SAST, DAST, SCA, ASPM, SBOM, secret-scanning) and cloud security posture management
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting to CISO, engineering leadership, and external auditors

Preferred Qualifications

  • CISSP, CISM, CSSLP, GIAC GSLC, or equivalent
  • Experience operating a Security Champions / BSIMM Satellite model
  • Experience with LLM-assisted threat modelling and code scanning at scale
  • Working knowledge of AI/ML security frameworks (NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, ISO/IEC 42001, Google SAIF)

Key Skills

AppSec, Secure SDLC, BSIMM, OWASP SAMM, DORA, ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, Threat Modelling, SAST, DAST, SCA, ASPM, RBVM, CSPM, SBOM, Vulnerability Management, CI/CD Security, Supply-Chain Security, AWS Cloud Security, IAM, Security Hub, GuardDuty, Cloud & Container Security, IaC Security, FSI / Financial Services, Incident Response, Team Leadership, Security Champions.

Desired Skills

CISSP, CISM, CSSLP, GIAC GSLC, LLM-assisted Security, AI Agent Security, Agentic Remediation, BSIMM Satellite Model, Cloud Security Posture Management, GDPR.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager - Decision Platform, Retail Business Services (RBS)
jobs.description:
Description

We are building Amazon's first horizontal self-serve decisioning platform — an intelligence layer that upgrades static rule-based systems into outcome-learning, context-aware decision engines. The platform serves multiple tenants across multiple organizations and domains, each requiring structured onboarding, cross-org coordination, and production launch governance.

We are looking for a Program Manager to own tenant onboarding execution end-to-end — from first contact through production launch and steady-state operations. This role operates at the intersection of platform product, tenant engineering, and business stakeholders — orchestrating complex multi-party programs where each tenant brings a different tech stack, org structure, data readiness level, and decision type.

Key job responsibilities

Tenant Onboarding Execution

  • Own the end-to-end onboarding lifecycle — contract → data readiness → prototyping → shadow mode → production launch.
  • Manage parallel tracks across multiple tenants simultaneously at different stages.
  • Drive timelines against committed milestones, identify blockers early, and escalate decisively across cross-org dependencies.

Cross-Org Stakeholder Management

  • Navigate multi-persona commitment structures (builder, system owner, sponsor) across organizational boundaries.
  • Coordinate across platform engineering, applied science, BA/RA teams, and tenant-side engineering.
  • Serve as the single-threaded owner tenant leadership engages with throughout onboarding.

Process Design & Operational Excellence

  • Design and iterate on scalable onboarding processes — playbooks, health dashboards, RACI matrices, milestone trackers.
  • Drive process improvements as the platform moves from bespoke onboarding to self-serve at scale.

Data Readiness & Pre-flight

  • Drive data readiness (the #1 time sink) by providing clear requirements, checklists, and embedded support.
  • Coordinate pre-flight validation: data quality gates, signal checks, and integration testing.
  • Ensure contract commitments are met before prototype begins.

Governance & Launch Readiness

  • Coordinate shadow mode, launch readiness reviews (circuit breakers, fail-safes, RACI sign-off), and transition to steady-state operations with support handoff and monitoring.

Pipeline & Reporting

  • Maintain full pipeline visibility. Report program health with actionable metrics: onboarding velocity, time-to-production, blocker resolution.
  • Partner with GTM to convert qualified demand into onboarding-ready tenants.

About The Team

We operate at the intersection of product, science, and GTM — building a platform that connects decision systems across Amazon so that one signal makes all of them smarter. The platform is live with founding tenants, scaling to broad GA, and building pipeline for pan-Amazon adoption. This role is critical to ensuring that every tenant that enters the funnel moves through onboarding with velocity, quality, and trust.

You will work directly with platform leadership, applied science, engineering, BA/RAs, and tenant-side stakeholders to drive the operational machinery that turns platform readiness into production impact — one tenant at a time, then many in parallel.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
  • 5+ years in program management, technical program management, or platform operations roles
  • Experience managing multi-party programs with cross-organizational dependencies and competing priorities
  • Demonstrated ability to drive programs in environments with ambiguity — where processes don't exist yet and must be built while executing
  • Strong stakeholder management skills — comfortable holding senior leaders accountable to commitments and escalating decisively when programs are at risk
  • Track record of managing parallel workstreams (5+ concurrent programs) with clear milestone tracking and proactive risk management
  • Excellent written communication — able to produce clear program documents, status reports, and playbooks that scale beyond the individual

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree, or MBA in management, business administration, economics, engineering, marketing
  • Experience in platform onboarding, developer ecosystem programs, or internal tooling adoption at large-scale technology organizations
  • Familiarity with data platform or ML/AI product ecosystems — comfortable navigating conversations about data readiness, model validation, and production governance
  • Background in building scalable onboarding processes that reduce per-tenant effort over time (self-serve model design)
  • Experience with change management in multi-org environments — driving adoption where commitment requires budget, headcount, and cross-functional alignment

jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Title: QA & Project Support Analyst (System Monitoring)

Department: Quality Assurance / Project Support

Reports To: Project Manager / QA Lead

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time

Exp: 1-2 Years

Role Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented QA & Project Support Analyst to monitor system health across our client base, validate data integrity, and support the smooth delivery of ongoing projects. The role combines quality assurance, proactive monitoring, and strong client communication. The ideal candidate is comfortable writing database queries, spotting anomalies against historical trends, testing ongoing work, and leveraging AI tools to work more efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

•   Monitor system health on a client-by-client basis, ensuring each client environment is stable, performant, and functioning as expected.

•   Write and run database queries to investigate system behaviour, extract data, and diagnose issues.

•   Validate data accuracy and integrity by comparing current outputs against historical data and expected patterns.

•   Track, log, and monitor client-reported issues, ensuring they are triaged, followed up on, and resolved in a timely manner.

•   Perform quality assurance and testing of ongoing work and new deliverables before they reach clients.

•   Apply AI prompting to accelerate analysis, testing, documentation, and issue investigation.

•   Provide project support and coordination, keeping tasks, timelines, and stakeholders aligned.

•   Communicate clearly with clients and internal teams, translating technical findings into concise, actionable updates.

Required Skills & Experience

•   Working knowledge of databases and the ability to write and interpret SQL / DB queries.

•   Experience in quality assurance and testing of software or data-driven deliverables.

•   Strong analytical skills, with the ability to validate data against historical trends and flag anomalies.

•   Familiarity with system health monitoring and issue-tracking practices.

•   Proficiency in AI prompting — skilled at using AI tools and writing effective prompts to speed up analysis, testing, and documentation.

•   Excellent written and verbal communication skills for client-facing interaction.

•   Good organisational and project-support abilities, with attention to detail and follow-through.

Preferred (Nice to Have)

•   Exposure to monitoring or observability tools and dashboards.

•   Prior experience in a client-facing support or delivery role.

•   Basic scripting or automation skills for repetitive checks.

What Success Looks Like

  • In this role, success means client systems stay healthy and issues are caught early, data is trusted because it is regularly validated, deliverables are tested and reliable before release, and clients feel well-informed through clear, timely communication.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Customer Success Manager based in India.

This role offers the opportunity to become a trusted advisor to enterprise customers using complex cloud and business technology solutions.

You will own key customer relationships, ensuring service quality, satisfaction, adoption, retention, and long-term value.

Working across customer-facing and technical teams, you will manage escalations, coordinate resolutions, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

You will also engage with senior stakeholders through strategic business reviews, translating service performance into actionable recommendations.

The role requires a strong understanding of public cloud environments, particularly SAP and Oracle solutions, as well as commercial and contractual considerations.

You will operate in a global environment where proactive communication, accountability, and customer advocacy are essential.

This is an opportunity to combine relationship management, technical understanding, and strategic thinking to influence meaningful customer outcomes.

Accountabilities

  • Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with enterprise customers, acting as a trusted advisor and advocate throughout the service engagement.
  • Serve as a primary customer point of contact, ensuring responsive communication and a consistent, high-quality customer experience.
  • Maintain regular engagement with customers to understand business priorities, service feedback, emerging risks, and opportunities.
  • Proactively identify, manage, and resolve customer escalations while minimizing business disruption and maintaining customer trust.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional technical and delivery teams to investigate issues, drive timely resolutions, and establish preventive measures.
  • Develop and maintain a strong understanding of customer contracts, service-level agreements, deliverables, and contractual obligations.
  • Support contract amendments and renewals while helping establish outcomes that are beneficial for both the customer and the business.
  • Conduct Executive Business Reviews with senior customer stakeholders, presenting achievements, service performance, risks, opportunities, and recommendations.
  • Develop tailored customer success plans aligned with business objectives and monitor customer health indicators to improve adoption, retention, and expansion.
  • Apply knowledge of public cloud solutions, SAP, Oracle, and related technologies to advise customers on best practices and opportunities to optimize their technology investments.
  • Work with technical delivery teams to identify recurring issues and contribute to cross-functional continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Coordinate service activities and take ownership where required to ensure issues, process gaps, and service delivery concerns are addressed through to closure.
  • Support problem-management activities and drive corrective actions to completion.
  • Identify opportunities to improve customer experience, service delivery, operational processes, and overall account health.

jobs.title: Head
jobs.description:
1. Job Purpose

To lead and drive the engineering reliability strategy across all PIL manufacturing units, ensuring zero safety incidents attributable to equipment condition, maximizing asset uptime, and optimizing lifecycle costs. This role is accountable for embedding a proactive maintenance culture, ensuring 100% statutory compliance, and horizontally deploying reliability best practices across the organization to achieve world-class manufacturing standards.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Safety & Compliance (Non-Negotiable)

  • Zero Accidents: Achieve and sustain zero reportable accidents caused by equipment or system condition failures.
  • Safety Tagging: Ensure all safety-critical equipment and systems are identified, documented, and tagged per Standard Operating Procedures (SOP).
  • Inspection & Auditing: Conduct regular field inspections to verify that maintenance practices for safety-critical equipment strictly adhere to laid-down standards.
  • SOP Development: Develop, deploy, and continuously improve SOPs, Work Instructions (WI), and Inspection/Test/Preventive Maintenance (ITPM) checklists for safety-critical assets across all PIL units.
  • Statutory Compliance: Monitor and guarantee 100% statutory compliance for all equipment registered under applicable statutory and regulatory bodies.

B. Preventive & Predictive Care

  • Maintenance Strategy: Define and ensure a robust maintenance strategy exists for all manufacturing equipment at every PIL plant.
  • Annual Planning: Plan and oversee the flawless execution of annual Preventive Maintenance (PM), Predictive Maintenance (PdM), and instrument/equipment calibration schedules per the PIL maintenance strategy.
  • System Audits: Conduct systematic audits of engineering systems compliance at PIL plants, identifying gaps and tracking them to closure.
  • Hazardous Area Integrity: Ensure strict flameproof integrity checks and audits in all hazardous areas with flammable atmospheres.
  • Asset Inspection: Oversee the inspection of safety-critical vessels, piping, and structures at predefined frequencies, executing corrective work to restore them to original design status.
  • Spares Management: Direct Unit Engineering Managers (UEMs) to routinely review and update critical spares lists, ensuring availability to eliminate unplanned downtime.
  • Bad Actor Management: Drive the Bad Actor program, delivering reliable technical solutions to eliminate repeat failures and implementing preventive actions across all sites.
  • RCA & CAPA: Lead the review and improvement of Breakdown Root Cause Analyses (RCAs), ensuring horizontal deployment of corrective actions across the organization.

C. Engineering Reliability (Lifecycle Management)

  • Design Review: Review the design basis of critical equipment at the inception stage, ensuring procurement and installation meet reliability, maintainability, and local regulatory requirements.
  • Quality Assurance: Ensure new installations strictly follow the Quality Assurance Plan (QAP), Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), installation verification protocols, and Handover/Takeover (HOTO) procedures.
  • Performance Assurance: Provide the necessary systems and comprehensive documentation to guarantee equipment performance (safety and reliability) before regular operation commences.
  • Zoning Compliance: Verify that all new equipment complies with hazardous area zoning classifications.
  • Lifecycle Optimization: Lead lifecycle management initiatives to proactively identify low-reliability assets and execute strategic replacement/upgrade plans before failure occurs.

D. People Development & Culture

  • Capability Building: Cultivate deep reliability expertise and a proactive maintenance culture within engineering, reliability, and project teams.
  • Skill Gap Analysis: Identify technical skill gaps among the workforce; upskill and reskill staff to enable advanced asset management techniques.
  • RBTM Compliance: Ensure all maintenance personnel are trained per the Role-Based Training Matrix (RBTM); monitor yearly training plans and drive strict compliance.
  • Leadership & Inspiration: Inspire teams to shift from reactive to proactive maintenance, championing asset reliability improvements at every level.

E. Coordination & Best Practices

  • Project Integration: Provide critical reliability inputs during project scope definition, execution, and commissioning discussions, including Pre-Startup Safety Reviews (PSSR).
  • Fabrication Oversight: Ensure rigorous quality monitoring during the fabrication and installation phases of critical systems.
  • Seamless Handover: Oversee the comprehensive handover of new plants and equipment, guaranteeing the receipt of complete and accurate drawings, manuals, and documentation.
  • KPI Governance: Actively participate in IRM (Incident Review Meetings) and Functional Review Meetings (FRM); drive the implementation of assigned Maintenance Indices (MI), Key Indicators (KI), and maintenance KPIs.
  • Budgeting: Collaborate closely with UEMs and Cluster Engineering Heads (CEHs) to forecast and budget for end-of-life equipment replacements and major reliability upgrades.

4. Qualifications & Experience

Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, or Instrumentation Engineering (Master's degree in Reliability Engineering or Management is highly preferred).

Experience:

  • 15–18 years of progressive experience in Engineering, Maintenance, and Reliability within a large-scale manufacturing environment (preferably Chemicals, Paints, Pharmaceuticals, or FMCG).
  • Minimum 5–8 years in a senior leadership role managing multiple manufacturing units or a corporate reliability function.
  • Proven track record of managing statutory compliance (e.g., Factory Act, Boiler/Pressure Vessel regulations, Hazardous Area certifications).

Certifications (Preferred):

  • Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP).
  • Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE).
  • Six Sigma Black Belt / Lean Manufacturing certification.

5. Key Competencies & Behavioral Traits

  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to balance long-term lifecycle planning with day-to-day operational pressures.
  • Analytical Rigor: Deep expertise in RCA, FMEA, and statistical analysis of maintenance data.
  • Regulatory Acumen: Strong understanding of local and national safety/statutory frameworks.
  • Influential Leadership: Capable of inspiring UEMs, CEHs, and shop-floor teams to adopt reliability-first mindsets.
  • Change Management: Experience in driving cultural shifts from reactive maintenance to proactive/predictive care.
  • Financial Acumen: Competence in CAPEX/OPEX budgeting for large-scale asset replacements.

Zeeco is a global leader in the design and manufacture of advanced combustion and pollution control technologies for the petroleum, chemical, petrochemical, pharmaceutical, and allied process industries. Our product portfolio includes ultra-low emission burners, gas and liquid flaring systems, thermal oxidizers, vapor recovery systems, and hazardous waste incineration solutions.

Headquartered near Tulsa, Oklahoma (USA), Zeeco operates one of the industry's largest combustion research and testing centers alongside a 66,000 sq. ft. manufacturing facility. With operations across the United States, United Kingdom, South Korea, India, Saudi Arabia, Japan, and other global locations, Zeeco delivers innovative engineering solutions worldwide.

At Zeeco, we foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and technical excellence, empowering our employees to challenge conventional thinking and create lasting value.

Position Overview

Zeeco India is seeking a Quality Control (QC) Engineer with 3 to 6 years of experience in the fabrication and inspection of pressure vessels, process equipment, structural steel, piping, and skid-mounted systems. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable codes, client specifications, and Zeeco's Quality Management System throughout all stages of manufacturing.

The role requires strong technical knowledge of fabrication processes, welding, metallurgy, inspection techniques, documentation, and quality assurance practices, along with the ability to coordinate effectively with engineering, production, procurement, clients, third-party inspection agencies, and certification bodies.

jobs.title: Technical Formulator / Product Development Specialist
skills: Evaluating novel inputs for real farm-level performance
Presenting technical findings to non-technical audiences
jobs.description:
Purpose of the Role

Most feed and healthcare product decisions in this industry get made in tradition or a supplier's word, not on data collected from the pond itself. This role exists to change that at Loopworm — going out, running real field trials with fish and shrimp farmers, and using what actually happens on the ground to shape what the company builds next.

Reporting directly to the Founder and VP Sales, and with only one opening, this isn't a role buried in a large R&D hierarchy — it's a high-visibility seat where your findings shape the product roadmap directly, and where you'll also be the technical voice the sales team leans on to make a credible case to customers.

What You'll Own

Field Trials & Data Collection

Design and conduct rigorous on-site field trials for fish and shrimp to gather comprehensive performance and operational data — growth rates, feed conversion ratios, survival rates, and health outcomes under real pond conditions

Select trial sites and farmer partners, define control and test groups, and set sample sizes and durations that will hold up to scrutiny

Ensure trials are set up with sound experimental design so the resulting data can actually be trusted and acted on — not just observational anecdotes from a single pond

Track trial progress in the field, catching and correcting issues (dosing errors, inconsistent feeding, environmental variables) before they compromise the data

Maintain organized, audit-ready trial records and datasets that others in the company can reference later

Formulation & Product Development

Analyze field trial data to design, develop, and optimize new aquaculture feed ingredients and healthcare product blends

Turn findings into formulations that move Loopworm's product pipeline forward, not just incremental tweaks to existing blends

Evaluate alternative and novel ingredients — including insect-based inputs like LoopMeal-for nutritional value, cost efficiency, and farmer-level performance

Run bench-level iteration and small-batch testing before a formulation is committed to a larger field trial

Document formulation rationale and trial evidence clearly enough that it can support regulatory, quality, or investor scrutiny if needed

Commercial & Sales Support

Work closely with the sales and BD teams to translate technical field data into commercial narratives that make sense to a farmer or distributor

Support customer-facing technical discussions directly when a deal needs scientific credibility to close

Run training sessions and technical workshops for the sales team and clients to build product trust and credibility in the field

Build simple, reusable technical materials (trial summaries, comparison sheets, FAQs) the sales team can use without needing you in every conversation

What We're Looking For

Education: Ph.D. in Aquaculture or related field (mandatory) — this needs to be someone whose scientific grounding is deep enough to be trusted with formulation decisions, not just data collection

Experience: Minimum 3 years hands-on in fish and shrimp nutrition — real pond and lab experience, not purely academic research

Proven expertise running field trials, analyzing data, and developing feed ingredient or aquaculture healthcare formulations, with evidence of formulations that actually made it to farmers, not just to a paper

A rigorous, evidence-first mindset — someone who trusts what the data says over what tradition or a supplier claims, and is comfortable being the person who says a popular assumption doesn't hold up

Genuinely energized by field work, not just tolerant of it — this role lives in ponds and farms as much as it does in analysis, and someone who prefers to stay deskbound will struggle here

Comfortable with ambiguity and building from scratch — there's no existing formulation playbook to follow; this role is expected to define one

Able to work independently with minimal oversight, while still keeping the Founders and VP Sales genuinely informed — this is a high-trust, high-visibility seat, not a role that thrives on being told what to do next

A translator's instinct — equally comfortable in a rigorous scientific conversation and in a simple, credible pitch to a farmer or distributor

Skills & Competencies

Experimental design and statistical analysis

Deep working knowledge of aqua-nutrition and alternative ingredients, including evaluating novel inputs for real farm-level performance

Ability to translate raw field data into formulations and clear commercial narratives, not just research findings

Strong scientific documentation — records and rationale clean enough to hold up to regulatory, quality, or investor scrutiny

Comfortable presenting technical findings to non-technical audiences, including farmers, distributors, and the sales team

Trainer's instinct — able to run a workshop that actually builds the sales team's confidence, not just deliver a lecture

Ready for extensive field travel across India; working proficiency in English required, additional regional languages a plus

How We Work at Loopworm

Freedom and responsibility — we tell you the outcome and the constraints, then get out of your way. No micromanagement. You own the result.

Honesty over comfort — bad news should travel fast. We'd rather hear about a problem the day it happens than a polished story a month later.

Numbers, not opinions — decisions are made on data; bring the arithmetic with your proposal.

jobs.title: Nutanix Migration Engineer
jobs.description:
Details:

Job Description

The Nutanix Migration Engineer is the technical executor of the VMware-to-Nutanix transition. The role spans the full migration lifecycle - assessment and sizing, migration design, Nutanix Move 6.0 execution, cutover, validation, troubleshooting, and post-migration stabilization. This is a delivery-focused engineering role: the expectation is independent, hands-on execution inside a production healthcare environment where failed cutovers and extended outages are not recoverable events. The engineer must be equally comfortable on the VMware source side and the Nutanix target side, because the majority of migration failures originate in the source estate rather than the destination.

Job Requirements

Details:

  • Perform discovery of the source VMware estate using Nutanix Collector, RVTools, and native vCenter reporting - capturing VM inventory, resource consumption, disk layout, snapshots, VMware Tools state, guest OS versions, and network configuration.
  • Analyze workload characteristics to identify migration blockers before scheduling: unsupported guest operating systems, RDMs, shared VMDKs, oversized disks, encrypted VMs, VMs with attached ISOs, static IP dependencies, application clustering, and licensing anchored to hardware identifiers.
  • Support target sizing and capacity planning using Nutanix Sizer - validating CPU, memory, storage, and node count against actual measured consumption rather than allocated values.
  • Group workloads into migration waves by application dependency, business criticality, downtime tolerance, and owner availability; document per-wave migration approach and rollback plan.
  • Produce the migration design and cutover runbook for each wave: pre-checks, sequence, validation steps, back-out procedure, and named approvers.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain Nutanix Move 6.0 - appliance sizing, source and target environment registration, credential and permission configuration, and network mapping between source port groups and AHV virtual networks.
  • Build and execute migration plans: seed data replication, monitor replication progress and lag, manage bandwidth and concurrency limits, and coordinate cutover timing with application owners.
  • Manage guest preparation - VirtIO driver injection for Windows guests, Linux guest readiness, VMware Tools removal, and IP retention or reassignment per the network design.
  • Execute cutovers within approved change windows, including final delta sync, source VM shutdown, target power-on, and confirmation of guest boot, network reachability, and service startup.
  • Handle migration exceptions where Move is not the right tool - in-guest methods, backup-and-restore migration via the client's backup platform, database-native replication, or rebuild-and-reinstall for legacy or unsupported workloads.
  • Execute post-migration validation: guest OS health, VirtIO device and driver state, disk presence and capacity, network and DNS resolution, application service startup, backup job re-registration, and monitoring agent check-in.
  • Troubleshoot migration failures across the stack - Move appliance and agent errors, CBT and snapshot issues, vCenter permission and API failures, source datastore performance limits, boot failures on AHV (UEFI/BIOS mismatch, missing drivers, disk controller changes), and post-cutover network isolation.
  • Coordinate application owner validation and formal acceptance sign-off for each migrated workload; drive open defects to closure within the agreed hypercare window.
  • Perform post-migration optimization: right-sizing CPU and memory, storage container and compression/dedupe policy alignment, VM affinity rules, and protection policy or replication configuration on the target.
  • Decommission source objects only after acceptance and retention criteria are met, following the agreed decommissioning checklist.
  • Maintain as-built documentation, migration logs, exception records, and lessons learned; contribute reusable runbook content back to the Stefanini Nutanix practice.
  • 5+ years in enterprise virtualization or infrastructure engineering, including 2+ years hands-on with Nutanix in production.
  • Demonstrable participation in at least one completed enterprise VMware-to-Nutanix migration - candidates must be able to describe scale, tooling, failure modes encountered, and how they were resolved.
  • Required certification: Nutanix Certified Professional - Multicloud Infrastructure (NCP-MCI), current version.
  • Preferred: Nutanix Certified Master - Multicloud Infrastructure (NCM-MCI), VMware Certified Professional - Data Center Virtualization (VCP-DCV), Microsoft or Red Hat OS-level certification.
  • Experience in a healthcare or other regulated production environment, working within formal change control and maintenance windows.

jobs.title: NPD Research Scientist
jobs.description:
NPD Research Scientist – Skincare

Location: Coimbatore (On-site) Experience: 4+ years Department: R&D (Lab) · New Product Development

Budget: ₹12–15 LPA

About the Role

We're a fast-growing, science-led skincare brand building a strong new-product pipeline. We're looking for an exceptional NPD Research Scientist to own the bench-to-batch development of our products.

This is a purely technical, lab-based role — you're the scientist behind the product, not the person marketing it. You'll decide what a product should be at a formulation level — the actives, the base, the texture, the stability — and take it from concept brief through prototype, testing, and pilot/scale-up handover.

If you love the lab, believe in clean-yet-effective formulation, and want real ownership over what a growing brand launches, this is for you.

Key Responsibilities

New Product Development (core)

  • Convert product concept briefs into technical development plans — define formulation strategy, active systems, and target performance for each new product.
  • Design, formulate, and iterate prototypes at the bench across categories: face care (serums, cleansers, masks, sunscreen, toners, eye cream), hair care, body care, and lip care.
  • Evaluate and work with natural/plant-based actives and modern actives (bakuchiol, peptides, niacinamide, AHAs/BHAs, botanical extracts) to build differentiated products.
  • Help shape the product roadmap — recommend what new products and categories the brand can credibly launch based on ingredient science and formulation feasibility.

Lab, Testing & Validation

  • Plan and run stability testing (accelerated & real-time), compatibility, pH, viscosity, and preservative-efficacy (challenge) testing.
  • Coordinate safety, efficacy, and claim-support testing with internal and external labs (dermatological testing, SPF testing for sun care, in-vitro/in-vivo where relevant).
  • Troubleshoot formulation issues — emulsion stability, phase separation, discoloration, odor, actives degradation — and resolve them at the bench.
  • Maintain rigorous documentation: formulation records, batch records, specs, and development reports.

Scale-up & Handover

  • Support pilot batches and scale-up trials; work with manufacturing to ensure lab formulas translate reliably to bulk production.
  • Define raw-material specs, finished-product specs, and SOPs for new formulations.
  • Partner with QC/QA on release specifications and method development.

Regulatory & Compliance (technical)

  • Ensure formulations comply with applicable regulations (CDSCO/BIS for India, plus target-market norms like EU/US where relevant) — ingredient limits, restrictions, and technical labeling inputs.
  • Uphold clean-formulation standards (paraben-free, sulfate-free, cruelty-free, pregnancy-safe) while keeping products effective.
  • Prepare and maintain technical documentation supporting product claims and safety.

What We're Looking For

Experience 4+ years of hands-on formulation/NPD experience in skincare, personal care, or cosmetics R&D — from a brand, contract manufacturer, or ingredient house. A real track record of taking products from concept to launch. We care more about depth of formulation skill than a specific number of years — genuinely strong candidates are encouraged to apply.

Education Degree in Cosmetic Technology, Cosmetic Science, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical Engineering, or a related field. A cosmetic-technology background (e.g., ICT Mumbai or equivalent) is a strong plus but not mandatory if the hands-on experience is there.

Technical Skills Deep, practical knowledge of emulsion science, surfactant systems, actives, preservatives, and rheology modifiers. Strong grasp of stability, compatibility, and preservative-efficacy protocols. Familiarity with cosmetic ingredient regulations and INCI nomenclature. Comfort with lab instrumentation (pH meter, viscometer/rheometer, homogenizer, stability chambers, etc.). Ability to read scientific/ingredient literature and translate it into formulation decisions.

Attributes Meticulous documentation and a structured, experimental mindset. A hands-on problem-solver who genuinely enjoys the bench. Able to balance scientific rigor with cost, manufacturability, and timelines.

Bonus Natural/plant-based actives experience. Protein-based actives experience.

Department

Quality Control

Reports To

Manager / Quality Head – Quality Control

Location

JSW Cement Limited, Nandyal

Shift

Shift cum General Shift

Job Purpose

To perform chemical analysis of raw materials, fuels, clinker, cement and other process samples using laboratory analytical instruments, ensuring timely and accurate results to support process control and maintain product quality. The Chemist is responsible for laboratory testing, equipment maintenance, quality assurance activities, and compliance with safety and quality management systems while working in both shift and general shift schedules.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

  • Chemical Analysis
  • Perform routine chemical analysis of limestone, laterite, bauxite, iron ore, raw meal, kiln feed, clinker, gypsum, fly ash, slag, pozzolana, cement, coal, pet coke, AFR, and other raw materials.
  • Carry out analysis using XRF, wet chemistry, titration, gravimetric methods, and instrumental techniques.
  • Prepare fused beads and pressed pellets for XRF analysis.
  • Verify analytical accuracy using certified reference materials (CRMs).
  • Ensure timely reporting of laboratory results.
  • Quality Control
  • Monitor chemical parameters including:

○ Lime Saturation Factor (LSF), Silica Modulus (SM), Alumina Modulus (AM)

○ Free Lime, LOI, Insoluble Residue

○ CaO, SiO₂, Al₂O₃, Fe₂O₃, MgO, SO₃, Na₂O, K₂O, Chloride

  • Compare analytical results with quality control limits.
  • Immediately report abnormal results to Production, CCR and Quality Management.
  • Assist in process adjustments to maintain consistent clinker and cement quality.
  • XRF Laboratory Operations
  • Operate and monitor XRF spectrometer.
  • Perform daily calibration and standardization.
  • Prepare calibration samples and conduct drift correction and performance verification.
  • Troubleshoot basic instrument issues.
  • Coordinate with service engineers for preventive maintenance.
  • Wet Chemistry
  • Conduct wet chemical analysis as per SOPs.
  • Prepare and standardize laboratory reagents.
  • Perform volumetric and gravimetric analysis.
  • Validate XRF results through wet chemistry when required.
  • Sample Preparation
  • Receive and identify production samples.
  • Dry, crush, pulverize, sieve and homogenize samples.
  • Operate sample preparation equipment safely.
  • Prevent sample contamination and mix-up.
  • Physical Testing Support
  • Assist in cement physical testing, including:

○ Blaine Fineness, Residue / Sieve Analysis

○ Initial & Final Setting Time, Soundness

○ Mortar Compressive Strength, Standard Consistency, Density (as required)

  • Data Management & Documentation
  • Record laboratory data accurately in LIMS, ERP or laboratory registers.
  • Prepare daily, weekly and monthly laboratory reports.
  • Maintain calibration records, QC charts and analytical logs.
  • Ensure traceability of all laboratory samples and results.
  • Instrument Maintenance
  • Perform daily instrument health checks and monitor laboratory equipment performance.
  • Maintain calibration schedules.
  • Coordinate preventive and breakdown maintenance.
  • Ensure availability of laboratory consumables and chemicals.
  • Quality Assurance
  • Follow ISO 9001 quality management requirements.
  • Participate in internal quality audits.

Amazon's Buyer Abuse Prevention (BAP) team sits within the broader Buyer Risk Prevention (BRP) organization — a centralized technology and program team whose mission is to make Amazon the safest and most trusted place worldwide to transact online. Buyer abuse is defined as the risk associated with customers repeatedly violating Amazon's policies and affecting the profitability, brand, and reputation of Amazon or its Selling Partners.

BAP sits at the intersection of technology, policy, and operations to detect, investigate, and prevent abusive behaviors across Amazon. Our work directly impacts Amazon's bottom line, protecting hundreds of millions of dollars in concession losses annually while preserving the customer and seller experience.

BAP is seeking an innovative, results-oriented, and customer-centric Program Manager to own and drive the Automation program across the Buyer Abuse Prevention organization. In this role, you will be responsible for scaling Amazon's ability to investigate and act on risky orders and concessions at billions-of-transactions scale — without relying on manual effort. You will define the automation strategy, manage a portfolio of automation initiatives, and balance the dual mandate of maximizing automation rate while carefully managing enforcement quality through leakage (under-enforcement) and customer experience (over-enforcement) metrics.

The successful candidate will be highly analytical, resourceful, customer focused, team oriented, and have an ability to work independently under time constraints to meet deadlines. He or she will have a proven track record in taking on end-to-end ownership and successfully delivering results in a fast-paced and dynamic business environment.

  • Define and manage key success metrics for the Automation program, including automation rate, task coverage, precision, leakage rate, false positive rate, and customer-facing impact metrics.

About Metaforms

Metaforms is redefining how market research gets done. Our AI platform helps the world's leading research agencies — Dynata, Savanta, Borderless Access — scale 10x faster without sacrificing quality, automating survey programming, data processing, and project management.

  • 1,000+ surveys processed monthly

The Role

We're hiring a Research Manager who lives and breathes primary research - someone who can pick up a business problem and turn it into a sharp questionnaire, then turn the data back into an insights report a client actually acts on.

You'll own research quality end-to-end at Metaforms: designing and reviewing questionnaires, sense-checking data, and building reports that hold up to client scrutiny. You'll also be the research conscience for our product and engineering teams - making sure the AI we build actually reflects how good research gets done, not a shortcut version of it.

What You'll Do
  • Design questionnaires from a brief: objectives, sampling plan, screener logic, scale choice, routing - the full craft, not just clean-up
  • Review and QA questionnaires and data for methodological soundness (bias, leading questions, sampling issues, logic errors)
  • Turn survey data into insights reports and decks that make a clear, defensible argument — not just banner tables
  • Be the domain expert other teams call on for is this research right — Product, Engineering, AI teams included
  • Partner with Product & Engineering to make sure AI-powered research tools (auto-programming, auto-tabbing, auto-reporting) meet the bar a good researcher would hold them to
  • Test and give structured feedback on new tools/prototypes before they ship
  • Train and calibrate other researchers and tech teams on research standards and edge cases
What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in market research, with real ownership of questionnaires and insights reports - not just fielding or coordination
  • Strong grounding in questionnaire design, sampling, and methodology
  • Can independently write an insights report that tells a story, not just describe charts
  • Sharp eye for what's wrong with a survey or a dataset

Bonus

  • Experience working alongside survey programmers / DP teams

About Amazon

Amazon.com, Inc. seeks to be Earth's most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online, and endeavors to offer its customers the widest of selection at low price that drives Amazon's flywheel.

About The Team

The vision of Retail Business Services (RBS) Organization at Amazon is to accelerate Amazon's flywheel by improving customer experience and enabling our Selling Partners (SPs) to grow their business with Amazon. RBS provides catalog augmentation and correction technologies for the Amazon selling community. Our solutions ensure information in Amazon's catalogs is both complete and comprehensive enough to give our customers a great shopping experience every time.

Role Overview

RBS is looking for a Senior Program Manager to lead a Strategy for Shopping Mission Completion for Customers. Amazon Store Walk analysis uncovers critical defects across the Amazon shopping journey; spanning across product discovery, evaluation, and purchase completion. These systemic problems impact the customer shopping journey, from how customers discover and evaluate products to their ability to complete purchases. These issues are categorized into four key defect themes: Data, Search, Catalog and Customer Experience. To resolve these issues, we recommend a coordinated, cross-functional engagement with partner teams that will improve overall customer shopping experience . This role will be at the center of collaboration between multiple world wide teams in re-imagining the purchase experience for customers.

Key job responsibilities

Shopping Mission is an essential part of the consumer experience and can fundamentally influence the way customers shop on Amazon as well as shape their perception of Amazon.

As a Senior Program Manager - Purchase, you will

  • Think Big and own vision for building a Strategy that enables customers to complete their shopping journey.
  • Disambiguate the problem space and size the problem and opportunity for RBS
  • Be responsible for end-to-end business strategy, goal setting, program management, review and collaboration mechanisms.
  • Break down ambiguous problems into clear abstract use cases and solution workflows for Tech and Product teams.
  • Be responsible for end to end program management with multiple parallel tasks.
  • Establish accountability with partner teams and influence them without authority on a common goals.
  • Identify risks and develop strategies to mitigate them.
  • Be responsible for reporting and review mechanisms and communication to Leadership (Flash updates, WBR, QBR, Deep dives)

To be successful in this role, you should be comfortable and confident liaising with remote global teams in business, design and technology at senior leadership levels. You will solve ambiguous problems and proactively identify and mitigate risks (before they become roadblocks). You will be data-driven and demonstrate good judgment in how and when to escalate (without damaging relationships).

Representing the voice of customers, you will be an evangelist for the program vision, maintaining support for your cause, keeping engineering teams energized and excited, and driving your program roadmap at all levels. You will be very comfortable with written communication skills and a proven track record of delivering projects from concept to launch.

About The Team

The Shopping Mission program is part of the Customer Experience vertical of RBS. The program is responsible for defining the Vision and long term strategy of improving Customer Experience through improving the quality of Amazon products. RBS is the global sponsor of the program, bringing together multiple world-wide product, design and engineering teams to execute in a federated manner.

Must-Have Skills & Attributes

Good-to-Have Skills & Attributes

jobs.title: Principal Program Manager, LMAQ
jobs.description:
Description

When you attract people who have the DNA of pioneers and the DNA of explorers, you build a company of like-minded people who want to invent. And that's what they think about when they get up in the morning: how are we going to work backwards from customers and build a great service or a great product – Jeff Bezos. Amazon.com's success is built on a foundation of customer obsession.

Have you ever thought about what it takes to successfully deliver millions of packages to Amazon customers seamlessly every day like clock work In order to make that happen, behind those millions of packages, billions of decisions get made by machines and humans. What is the accuracy of the customer provided address Do we know exact location of the address on a Map Is there a safe place to leave the package at Can we make an unattended delivery Would a signature be required Is the address a commercial property Do we know open business hours of the address What if customer is not home Is there an alternate delivery address Does the customer have any special delivery preference What are the other addresses that also have packages to be delivered on the same day Are we optimizing the delivery associate's route Does the delivery associate know the locality well enough Is there an access code to get inside the building And the list simply goes on. At the core of it all is the underlying data that can help make those decisions in time. The Last Mile Analytics and Quality (LMAQ) team capitalizes on Amazon's scale, speed, and ability to invent and simplify to accelerate the data flywheel and curate fresh and authoritative geospatial datasets to improve customer delivery experience. We work closely with tech and science teams on multiple initiatives to automate processes to operate at scale across all regions.

Skills

Amazon is seeking an experienced leader to drive the executive customer escalations process for all Geospatial teams. As a Principal Program Manager with the Last Mile Analytics and Quality (LMAQ) team, you will partner with program, technology, science and operations teams to deep dive on customer reported delivery defects and identify strategic long term solutions to improve customer delivery experience. As a key member of the LMAQ org, you will continually raise the bar on innovation for great customer experience. You will bring innovation, a strategic perspective, a passionate voice, and an ability to prioritize and execute on a fast-moving set of priorities, competitive pressures, and operational initiatives. You will partner closely with product, technology and sciences teams to define and build innovative and delightful experiences for customers. You must be highly analytical, able to work extremely effectively in a matrix organization, and have the ability to break complex problems down into steps that drive product development at Amazon speed. You will set the tempo for defect reduction through continuous improvement and drive accountability across multiple business units in order to deliver large scale high visibility/ high impact projects. Excellent communication and writing skills and executive presence to get in front of VPs and SVPs across Amazon will be imperative. You will need to work in a high pace environment with pressing timelines. The successful candidate will be able to:

  • Effectively manage customer expectations and resolve conflicts that balance client and company needs.
  • Drive effective teamwork, communication, collaboration and commitment across multiple disparate groups with competing priorities.
  • Develop process to effectively maintain and disseminate project information to stakeholders.
  • Be successful in a delivery focused environment and determine the right processes to innovate on behalf of customers.
  • This opportunity requires excellent technical, problem solving, and communication skills. The candidate is not just a policy maker/spokesperson but drives to get things done.
  • Possess superior analytical abilities and judgment. Use quantitative and qualitative data to prioritize and influence, show creativity, experimentation and innovation, and drive projects with urgency in this fast-paced environment.
  • Partner with key stakeholders to develop the vision and strategy for customer experience on our platforms. Influence product roadmaps based on this strategy to identify medium and long term goals.
  • With the business growing rapidly, this leader will not have the luxury of having a tunnel-vision for any one area; rather, this individual will need to exhibit excellent judgment on how to prioritize between competing priorities.
  • Serve as a role model for Amazon Leadership Principles inside and outside the organization.
  • Actively seek to implement and distribute best practices across teams.

Key job responsibilities

  • Write executive responses on the escalations and anecdotes working with Geo Spatial product, tech, program, sciences and operations teams.
  • Define, own and drive large cross-functional programs spanning multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with product, tech and sciences teams within the Last Mile Technology to drive global programs and systems improvements and reduce customer defects.

Basic Qualifications

  • 7+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
  • 7+ years of program or project management experience
  • 7+ years of managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership experience
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
  • Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience delivering projects within scope, time, budget and quality

The GSO leads the Safety Analysis Team (SAT), Global Safety Team (GST) and is a core member of the Executive Safety Committee (ESC). The GSO also is a member of the Evidence Generation Team. The GSO will be assigned as delegate for the TAH as needed and has management of Global Safety Scientists.

jobs.title: Sr Workday Applications Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Team

Zillow's People Technology organization builds and operates the platforms that power how Zillow employees work: Workday, ServiceNow, and the agentic AI layer connecting these systems to the surfaces employees use every day - Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, and AI tools. The India engineering team owns this platform stack end to end: production access, change ownership, on-call rotation, and direct relationships with the business teams we support.

Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes. Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow's mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.

About The Role

You are a key contributor to the team, leading the way on the most important integration and application initiatives, designs, and operational events across Workday and the broader enterprise ecosystem. You habitually design effective architectures, deliver critical bodies of code and integration, and shepherd the quality of the team's outputs. You are an expert on your team's systems and business domain, and you understand how they fit into the larger cross-team architecture. You contribute to projects that cut across teams and domains, and you are relied upon to resolve critical operational incidents, meet essential deadlines, and propose effective designs.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the technical lead for complex integration and application work across Workday, Gem, BrightHire, ServiceNow, AD/Okta, payroll and benefits vendors, and internal platforms; define the reusable patterns and set standards for the team
  • Build complex integrations, services & applications using Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, and REST/SOAP/GraphQL APIs, and architect Extend applications (custom objects, validations, orchestration-backed workflows)
  • Act as an expert in multiple subdomains owned by your team; influence and shape team architecture, working closely with Principal and other senior Engineers, and treat testability, resiliency, and observability as first-order concerns
  • Design and own MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and connectors that expose Workday capabilities to AI agents and internal tooling; treat the AI-enablement layer as first-class platform work
  • Establish how the team uses and adopts AI-assisted IDEs and coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot); raise delivery speed and code quality across the team/org, not just your own output
  • Set the standard for observability across the integration estate (dashboards, metrics, alerts, and runbooks); resolve complex, high-severity production issues at the root cause and drive measurable improvements in platform health and reliability
  • Act as a focal point for projects: coordinating deliverables, writing designs, ensuring accurate estimates, and reviewing artifacts
  • Mentor engineers, improving their craft and integrating them into team culture and process
  • Communicate consistently with technical and non-technical staff, documenting decisions and the rationale behind build/buy and design tradeoffs

This role has been categorized as an Office position. Office employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.

In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation subject to applicable laws and relevant Zillow policies. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location.

Who you are

  • 5-8+ years of software or application engineering experience, with significant time spent on platform or enterprise systems
  • 4+ years of hands-on Workday development across integrations (Studio, EIB, Core Connectors), Extend, Orchestration, and RaaS/WQL
  • 3+ years writing production code in JavaScript, Java, Python, or Go, with strong SQL or equivalent querying experience
  • Highly skilled in building with REST/SOAP and GraphQL, and in data transformation patterns (XML, XSLT, JSON)
  • Demonstrated ownership of integration architecture, including event-driven patterns, API gateway patterns, and fault-tolerant design
  • Deep understanding of the Workday data model and security fundamentals (domains, segments, business processes)
  • Uses AI-assisted development as a standard part of the daily workflow and sets the bar for the team
  • Bachelor's degree from a recognized university in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or a related field (B.E./B.Tech/MCA), or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience designing MCP servers or API-layer connectors for AI tooling
  • Experience with an iPaaS platform such as MuleSoft or Workato
  • Workday Integration or Extend certification

Get to know us

At Zillow, we're reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers.

As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., Zillow helps millions of customers navigate buying, selling, financing, and renting with greater ease and confidence. Our teams in India play a critical role in building and scaling the technology, products, and operations that power this experience.

Whether you're working in tech, operations, or shared services, you'll collaborate with global partners to solve meaningful problems and help more people make home a reality.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S.. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, maternity status, HIV status, or veteran status. Reasonable accommodations will be provided to candidates with disabilities, in accordance with applicable policies.
