jobs.title: Brand Manager
jobs.description:
ANKURAM IVFJOB DESCRIPTION – BRAND MANAGERMarketing, Doctor Relations & Business Growth

Department: Marketing & Business Development

Designation: Brand Manager – Marketing & Business Growth

Reporting To: Director / Management

Location: Ranchi, Jharkhand

Employment Type: Full-Time

1. POSITION SUMMARY

ANKURAM IVF is looking for an experienced, dynamic and result-oriented Brand Manager – Marketing & Business Growth to lead the overall marketing and business development activities of the organization.

This is a senior marketing role with responsibilities similar to a Marketing Head, with particular emphasis on doctor referrals, professional relationship management, hospital and clinic tie-ups, patient acquisition, territory development, brand building and revenue growth.

The Brand Manager will be responsible for developing and executing strategies that increase the visibility, reputation and market presence of ANKURAM IVF and ultimately contribute to growth in fertility consultations, IVF cycles and revenue.

The candidate must be capable of working independently, managing a marketing team, building strong professional relationships with doctors and identifying new opportunities for business growth.

2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIESA. Doctor Referral & Relationship Management

Doctor relationship management will be one of the most important responsibilities of this position.

The Brand Manager will develop and maintain strong, professional and long-term relationships with Gynecologists, Obstetricians, Physicians, Urologists, General Practitioners and other healthcare professionals who can contribute to the fertility referral network.

Responsibilities include:

  • Identify high-potential doctors and develop them as active referral partners.
  • Regularly visit and engage with referring doctors.
  • Develop a structured doctor relationship management system.
  • Track doctor-wise referrals, consultations, conversions and IVF cycles.
  • Identify doctors whose referrals have declined and develop reactivation strategies.
  • Continuously add new doctors to the ANKURAM IVF referral network.
  • Develop doctor-specific engagement plans.
  • Organize professional meetings, CME programs, scientific sessions and doctor networking events.
  • Maintain regular communication and professional relationships with referring doctors.
  • Understand doctors expectations and identify opportunities to improve the referral experience.

The objective is to build a strong, ethical and sustainable doctor referral ecosystem for ANKURAM IVF.

3. HOSPITAL, CLINIC & INSTITUTIONAL TIE-UPS

The Brand Manager will identify and develop strategic relationships with:

  • Hospitals
  • Nursing homes
  • Gynecology clinics
  • Maternity centres
  • Diagnostic centres
  • Pathology laboratories
  • Corporate organizations
  • Healthcare institutions
  • Community organizations

The candidate will be responsible for identifying potential partners, initiating discussions, developing professional tie-ups and monitoring the business generated through such relationships.

The objective is to expand ANKURAM IVF's referral network beyond individual doctors and establish a wider healthcare ecosystem.

4. BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & PATIENT GROWTH

The Brand Manager will have direct responsibility for developing strategies for patient and business growth.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Develop monthly, quarterly and annual marketing plans.
  • Increase fertility consultations and IVF cycles.
  • Identify new sources of patient acquisition.
  • Develop strategies for increasing referrals and repeat business.
  • Identify underperforming geographical areas.
  • Develop territory-wise growth plans.
  • Identify new markets for ANKURAM IVF.
  • Monitor patient acquisition and conversion.
  • Work with the counselling team to improve consultation-to-treatment conversion.
  • Analyse reasons for patient drop-outs and recommend corrective measures.
  • Identify opportunities to increase revenue through better market penetration.
  • Develop innovative marketing strategies beyond traditional marketing methods.

The Brand Manager will be expected to focus on business outcomes rather than simply activity numbers.

5. FIELD & OFFLINE MARKETING

The Brand Manager will lead and supervise the offline marketing activities of ANKURAM IVF, including:

  • Doctor visits
  • Hospital visits
  • Infertility awareness camps
  • Community awareness programs
  • Rural outreach
  • Sahiya/health-worker engagement
  • Corporate awareness programs
  • Referral meetings
  • Local events
  • Outdoor branding
  • Poster campaigns
  • Hyperlocal marketing
  • New territory development

The candidate should continuously identify innovative methods of reaching potential patients and referral sources.

The objective is to ensure that field marketing generates qualified patients and measurable business, rather than simply increasing the number of activities.

6. BRAND MANAGEMENT

The Brand Manager will be responsible for strengthening the overall brand presence of ANKURAM IVF.

Responsibilities include:

  • Develop and maintain consistent brand positioning.
  • Improve brand visibility among doctors and the public.
  • Develop concepts for infertility awareness campaigns.
  • Plan offline brand-building initiatives.
  • Coordinate with the creative and digital marketing teams.
  • Ensure consistency of brand communication.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen ANKURAM IVF's position as a trusted fertility care provider.
  • Monitor market perception and competitor positioning.

The Brand Manager should continuously identify new ideas that can differentiate ANKURAM IVF from competing fertility centres.

7. DIGITAL MARKETING – STRATEGIC COORDINATION ONLY

Digital marketing will be handled by a separate digital marketing team/agency.

The Brand Manager will not be responsible for daily digital marketing execution.

However, the Brand Manager will provide strategic inputs based on market and field-level observations.

Responsibilities include:

  • Suggest ideas for digital campaigns.
  • Recommend topics based on patient and doctor requirements.
  • Share successful field campaigns with the digital team.
  • Suggest geographical and audience opportunities.
  • Provide feedback on the quality of digital leads.
  • Coordinate offline and digital marketing campaigns.
  • Review whether digital activities are aligned with the overall ANKURAM IVF brand strategy.

The Brand Manager will not be responsible for daily social media posting, graphic designing, video editing, SEO, Google Ads or Meta Ads execution.

8. MARKETING TEAM MANAGEMENT

The Brand Manager will lead and supervise the marketing/business development team.

Responsibilities include:

  • Set monthly targets.
  • Allocate territories.
  • Monitor field visits.
  • Monitor doctor and hospital visits.
  • Review referral performance.
  • Conduct weekly performance meetings.
  • Train team members in doctor relationship management and communication.
  • Monitor individual performance.
  • Identify underperforming areas and employees.
  • Develop corrective action plans.
  • Motivate the team to achieve business targets.

The Brand Manager should create a target-driven and performance-oriented marketing culture.

9. CRM, MIS & DATA ANALYSIS

All marketing activities must be systematically recorded and analysed.

The Brand Manager will monitor:

  • Doctor visits
  • Doctor referrals
  • Hospital visits
  • New tie-ups
  • Leads
  • Consultations
  • IVF conversions
  • IVF cycles
  • Revenue
  • Area-wise performance
  • Centre-wise performance
  • Marketing expenditure
  • Referral source
  • Conversion rate

Monthly reports should clearly identify what is working, what is not working and where additional resources should be invested.

10. COMPETITOR & MARKET INTELLIGENCE

The Brand Manager will regularly monitor:

  • Competitor IVF centres
  • New fertility clinics
  • Competitor doctor networks
  • Pricing and packages
  • Marketing campaigns
  • Referral strategies
  • New centre openings
  • Local brand visibility
  • Competitor positioning

The candidate should provide practical recommendations to management based on market intelligence.

11. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

Performance will be measured primarily through measurable growth.

Primary KPIs
  • Growth in IVF consultations
  • Growth in IVF cycles
  • Revenue growth
  • Increase in active referring doctors
  • Increase in doctor referrals
  • Doctor referral conversion
  • New hospital/clinic tie-ups
  • Growth in new geographical territories
  • Marketing ROI
  • Marketing team target achievement
Secondary KPIs
  • Doctor engagement activities
  • CME and professional meetings
  • Awareness programs
  • Field productivity
  • CRM compliance
  • Competitor intelligence
  • Brand visibility
12. CANDIDATE PROFILEEducation

MBA/PGDM in Marketing or Business Development preferred. Healthcare Management qualification will be an advantage.

Experience

5–10 years of experience in healthcare marketing, business development or related fields.

Candidates with experience in IVF, fertility, hospitals, gynecology, maternity or diagnostics will be preferred.

Candidates having an established professional network among Gynecologists and healthcare professionals in Ranchi/Jharkhand will receive strong preference.

Required Skills
  • Excellent communication and networking skills
  • Strong doctor relationship management
  • Business development capability
  • Leadership and team management
  • Negotiation skills
  • Strategic thinking
  • Field marketing experience
  • Data analysis
  • Presentation skills
  • Strong follow-up ability
  • Target orientation
  • Willingness to travel
  • Ability to work independently
13. CORE EXPECTATION

This is not a conventional Marketing Executive position.

ANKURAM IVF is looking for a person who can think and perform like a Marketing Head and Business Growth Leader.

The candidate should be capable of:

Building Doctor Relationships → Developing Referral Networks → Creating Hospital Tie-ups → Expanding Territories → Generating Patients → Improving Conversion → Increasing IVF Cycles → Growing Revenue.

The Brand Manager will be expected to take end-to-end ownership of marketing growth, identify problems independently, develop solutions and execute them effectively.

PRIMARY OBJECTIVEBuild the ANKURAM IVF brand, strengthen the doctor referral network, expand the market, generate quality patients and deliver sustainable growth in IVF cycles and revenue.

Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world's toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

As a Compliance Manager within the Audits and Inspections team, you will be responsible for managing all aspects of GxP audits and Regulatory Authority inspections for the company, investigator sites, and clients. The Compliance Manager leads and/or reviews complex internal and external audits and inspections to ensure compliance with established quality assurance processes, standards, global regulatory guidelines and/or client contractual obligations.   • Contribute to lessons learned discussions and participate in company-wide improvement initiatives.
  • Develop and effectively share guidance and reference information, repositories, and communication channels including policies, procedures, guidance documents, or quality management systems training.
  • Lead process improvement initiatives and collaborate with a variety of cross functional staff to ensure appropriate execution and completion and continuous improvement.
  • Develop tools and other materials for tracking of compliance management activities and analyse trends.
  • Mentor less experienced staff and serve as project lead for group projects.
  • Identify and resolve issues impacting the quality and/or integrity of clinical research programs, determine root cause of non-conformance and develop strategies to address issues.

  • 1+ years of experience in management/leadership roles preferred

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

  • Proven expertise and experience in quality management systems and regulatory frameworks, conducting internal audits, supporting, hosting/management of client audits and GxP regulatory inspections across the region
  • Proven experience in root cause analysis
  • Strong problem solving, critical thinking, risk assessment and impact analysis abilities
  • Detail oriented with ability to deal with multiple and changing priorities
  • Exceptional communication (verbal and written) and presentation skills (including appropriate use of medical and scientific terminology)
  • Strong negotiation and conflict management skills
  • Ability to effectively mentor and provide direction to staff and to work independently or in a team environment
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, flexibility and ability to multi-task and prioritize complex demands/workload
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and compliance-related software. Veeva QMS experience is a plus

Why Join Us

When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence. You'll work in an environment where collaboration and development are part of the everyday experience—and where your contributions truly make a difference.

Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow's breakthroughs.

jobs.title: Test Architect / Tech Lead - CTI MD Tech (GRA/GSC)
functions: Global Regulatory Affairs And Scientific Communications
jobs.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it's work worth doing. If you're driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

Test Architect / Tech Lead - CTI MD Tech (GRA/GSC)

Global Regulatory Affairs (GRA)

  • Global Scientific Communications (GSC)
  • CTI-MD Tech@Lilly

Global Regulatory Affairs (GRA) and Global Scientific Communications (GSC) together own how Lilly's medicines move through health authority review, stay compliant once approved, and get communicated externally — spanning regulatory submissions, labelling, clinical trial disclosures, and scientific publications. Both functions operate under strict compliance and audit-readiness requirements, and are scaling agentic and generative AI capabilities across their platforms, creating a growing need for consistent, reusable test automation and AI quality engineering practices across GRA and GSC.

The Test Architect / Tech Lead (R4), GRA/GSC is accountable for building the test automation frameworks and reusable testing components that drive quality engineering across GRA and GSC, with particular depth in evaluating and validating generative AI and agentic systems. The role also carries tech lead accountability: designing and building the application architecture for GRA/GSC platforms and owning delivery of key initiatives end to end, not solely test strategy. This is a single R4 path role by design: test standards, automation architecture, and application architecture need to be set once and held consistently rather than fragmented across roles without the seniority to drive strategic evolution end to end. The role owns the build-out of reusable frameworks and components, drives test automation initiatives, leads delivery of key technical initiatives, and manages stakeholders to ensure quality and AI evaluation rigor scale consistently as GRA/GSC's agentic platforms mature.

Path/Level: R4 (Test Architect / Tech Lead)

Key Responsibilities

  • Reusable Test Framework Development — design, build, and own reusable test automation frameworks and shared components (libraries, harnesses, fixtures, evaluation pipelines) that can be adopted consistently across GRA and GSC rather than rebuilt per program.
  • Application Architecture & Design — design and build the application architecture for GRA/GSC platforms as a tech lead — defining technical approach, component design, and integration patterns alongside the test and quality strategy.
  • Delivery Ownership — act as tech lead for key technical initiatives, owning end-to-end delivery — from architecture and build through testing and release — and holding accountability for outcomes, not just quality gates.
  • Automation Enablement — drive test automation efforts across GRA and GSC, identifying opportunities to replace manual and duplicated testing effort with shared, scalable automation.
  • AI & Agentic Quality Engineering — build and own evaluation frameworks for generative AI and agentic systems — groundedness validation, hallucination detection, relevance/accuracy testing, and RAG and LLM evaluation — using tools such as RAGAS, DeepEval, and LLM-as-a-Judge approaches.
  • Test Initiative Leadership — define and drive test initiatives end to end — scoping, prioritizing, and delivering automation and quality-engineering improvements across concurrent teams and workstreams.
  • Stakeholder Management — partner with engineering leads, product owners, and quality/compliance stakeholders to align on architecture, delivery plans, test strategy, and adoption of shared frameworks.
  • Observability & Trace Analysis — establish agent observability and trace-analysis practices to diagnose failures in multi-agent and agentic workflows, and feed findings back into architecture, framework, and test design.
  • Synthetic Test Data & Coverage Strategy — build synthetic test data generation capabilities and apply risk-based prioritization to determine test depth and coverage across critical workflows.
  • Talent Development & Mentorship — mentor test engineers and technical leads, building a team capable of operating independently on architecture, framework design, automation, and AI evaluation.

Technical & Strategic Expertise Areas


Application & Solution Architecture

  • AI Evaluation Frameworks (RAGAS, DeepEval, LLM-as-a-Judge)
  • Groundedness Validation
  • Hallucination Detection
  • Relevance & Accuracy Testing
  • Generative AI Testing
  • Agentic AI Testing
  • RAG Validation
  • LLM Evaluation
  • Prompt Engineering & Context Validation
  • Multi-Agent Systems
  • Agentic Frameworks
  • AI Quality Engineering
  • End-to-End Test Automation
  • API & Integration Testing
  • Agent Observability & Trace Analysis
  • Synthetic Test Data Generation
  • Python
  • JavaScript/TypeScript

Basic Qualifications


  • Proven track record architecting and scaling test automation frameworks across multiple concurrent programs.
  • Demonstrated experience designing application architecture and leading end-to-end delivery of key technical initiatives as a tech lead.
  • Demonstrated experience driving technical direction for AI-driven or agentic platforms, not solely test execution.
  • Experience setting quality/validation standards enforced consistently across distributed or vendor-delivered teams.
  • Track record of operating with seniority across functional boundaries in ambiguous, fast-scaling transformation environments.

Additional Qualifications / Competencies


  • Experience in both Global Regulatory Affairs and Scientific Communications, or comparable regulated pharma functions.
  • Familiarity with Regulatory Content and Submission Management, Veeva RIM, and regulatory platforms.
  • Experience with document and content management ecosystems.
  • Background in pharma and GxP-regulated environments.

jobs.title: Senior QAQC Manager (Trivandrum, Mangalore, Ahmedabad)
jobs.description:
Company Description

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world.

We believe infrastructure creates opportunity for everyone. Whether it's improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive.

Our clients trust us to bring together the best people, ideas, technical expertise and digital solutions to our work in transportation, buildings, water, the environment and new energy. We're one global team – 47,000 strong – driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world.

Here, you will have freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

We will give you the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you're working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.

You will help us foster a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion – a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.

We will encourage you to grow and develop your career with us through our technical and professional development programs and diverse career opportunities. We believe in leadership at all levels. No matter where you sit in the organization you can make a lasting impact on the projects you work on, the teams and committees you join and our business.

We offer competitive pay and benefits, well-being programs to support you and your family, and the development resources you need to advance your career.

When you join us, you will connect and collaborate with a global network of experts – planners, designers, engineers, scientists, consultants, program and construction managers – leading the change toward a more sustainable and equitable future. Join us and let's get started.

Job Description

Position Overview:

The Senior QA/QC Manager shall report to the Project Director / Project Head and serve as the PMC lead for Quality Assurance and Quality Control management across the airport development project.

The role shall be responsible for establishing, implementing, monitoring, and continually improving project-wide Quality Management Systems (QMS), quality governance frameworks, inspection and testing regimes, compliance monitoring processes, and quality performance improvement initiatives throughout the project lifecycle.

The position shall provide leadership and oversight to ensure that all design, construction, testing, commissioning, and handover activities are executed in accordance with project specifications, approved drawings, contract requirements, statutory regulations, aviation standards, applicable codes and international best practices.

The Senior QA/QC Manager shall proactively identify quality risks, implement preventive and corrective measures, promote a culture of quality excellence across all project participants, and support the successful delivery of airport infrastructure meeting the highest standards of safety, performance, durability, reliability, and operational readiness.

Key Responsibilities:

Quality Leadership & Governance
  • Develop, implement and maintain the Project Quality Management Plan and Quality Assurance Framework.
  • Establish project-wide quality governance structures, reporting mechanisms, quality objectives, and performance monitoring systems.
  • Provide strategic quality leadership and guidance to the Project Director and Project Leadership Team.
  • Promote a culture of quality excellence, continuous improvement, and proactive quality management across all stakeholders.
  • Lead and mentor QA/QC engineers, inspectors, laboratory personnel, and quality teams deployed across the project.

Quality Assurance Management
  • Establish and maintain ISO 9001 compliant Quality Management Systems for project delivery.
  • Review and approve Contractor Quality Plans, Method Statements, Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), Quality Procedures, and Quality Manuals.
  • Ensure quality requirements are integrated into project planning, procurement, design reviews, construction, commissioning, and handover activities.
  • Monitor contractor and supplier compliance with approved quality systems and contractual quality requirements.
  • Review quality management procedures and recommend improvements where necessary

Quality Control & Inspection Management
  • Oversee inspection and testing activities for civil, structural, architectural, finishing, MEP, utilities, airfield and associated infrastructure works.
  • Ensure compliance of materials, workmanship, installations, equipment, and systems with project specifications and approved standards.
  • Monitor laboratory testing, field testing, inspections, mock-ups, factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT), testing and commissioning activities.
  • Review quality records, test certificates, inspection reports, calibration records, and compliance documentation.
  • Ensure timely identification and resolution of quality deficiencies.

Risk Management & Non-Conformance Control
  • Establish systems for identification, monitoring and mitigation of quality risks.
  • Manage NCRs, observations, deviations, concession requests, corrective actions, preventive actions and root cause analysis processes.
  • Lead investigations into recurring quality issues and implement sustainable improvement measures.
  • Monitor quality trends and develop proactive risk mitigation strategies.
  • Advise project leadership on critical quality issues and recommended corrective actions.

Testing, Commissioning & Handover Quality
  • Oversee quality assurance requirements during testing, commissioning, integrated systems testing and operational readiness activities.
  • Ensure commissioning documentation and quality records are properly maintained.
  • Monitor snagging, defect management, punch-list closure and readiness assessments.
  • Verify compliance of completed facilities prior to handover and operational acceptance.
  • Support transition from construction to operational phases while ensuring all quality requirements have been achieved.

Audits, Compliance & Performance Monitoring
  • Conduct quality audits, surveillance inspections, compliance reviews and management assessments.
  • Evaluate contractor, supplier and consultant quality performance.
  • Develop quality dashboards, KPIs, trend analysis reports and management review reports.
  • Monitor compliance with Employer Requirements, contractual obligations, approved specifications and statutory requirements.
  • Identify opportunities for quality improvement and process optimization.

Stakeholder Coordination
  • Coordinate with Airport Operators, Designers, Contractors, Independent Testing Agencies, Authorities, Consultants, Vendors and Regulatory Bodies on quality-related matters.
  • Support interface management between multiple contractors and project stakeholders.
  • Facilitate timely resolution of quality issues arising during project execution.
  • Participate in project reviews, technical workshops, governance meetings and quality management forums.

Qualifications

Qualifications & Experience:
  • Bachelor's degree in civil engineering or other relevant Engineering discipline from a recognized university.
  • Master's degree in engineering/ construction management/ quality management or related discipline shall be preferred.
  • Professional certifications in Quality Management, Lead Auditor (ISO 9001), Six Sigma, CQI/IRCA or equivalent shall be preferred.
  • Overall, 15-20 years of professional experience in quality assurance and quality control management for large construction, infrastructure or industrial projects.
  • Minimum 10 years of relevant QA/QC experience on airport or aviation-related projects, including terminal buildings, airside infrastructure, runways, taxiways, aprons, ATC facilities, utility systems and operational airport environments.
  • Demonstrated experience in development, implementation, and administration of ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems for design, construction, testing and commissioning activities.
  • Experience in PMC, EPC, Design-Build, Independent Engineer, or Client-side project management environments.
  • Strong knowledge of airport construction standards, quality control procedures, material testing requirements, inspection methodologies, and commissioning protocols.
  • Experience in brownfield airport developments, operational airports, complex multidisciplinary construction projects, and fast-track project delivery shall be preferred.
  • Strong working knowledge of relevant Indian and international standards, including BIS, IRC, IS Codes, ASTM, ACI, ICAO, FAA, EASA and other industry standards, as applicable.
  • Experience in at least one Greenfield or Brownfield airport project of minimum 10 MPPA capacity involving terminal, airside or major airport infrastructure works.

Additional Information

Key Competencies:
  • Proven leadership in QA/QC management for major airport and aviation infrastructure projects.
  • Strong expertise in Quality Management Systems (QMS) and ISO 9001 implementation.
  • Comprehensive understanding of airport construction quality requirements for terminal, airside, landside, MEP and utility systems.
  • Expertise in Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), quality audits, material testing, acceptance criteria and compliance management.
  • Strong knowledge of testing, commissioning, ORAT-related quality requirements and handover processes.
  • Experience in NCR management, CAPA implementation, root cause analysis and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Strong capability in quality audits, inspections, supplier quality management and contractor performance monitoring.
  • Proficiency in digital quality management systems, dashboards, reporting tools and performance analytics.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making and risk assessment capabilities.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management and leadership skills.
  • Ability to manage multidisciplinary teams and complex contractor interfaces.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify quality risks, implement mitigation measures and drive continuous improvement.
  • Ability to perform effectively under demanding project schedules while maintaining the highest standards of quality, compliance and operational readiness.

Job Description

Position Overview:

The Program Director provides executive leadership and overall PMC accountability for the integrated Solar, Wind and BESS programme. The role ensures that recommendations presented to the Client are coordinated, evidence-based, and aligned with contractual milestones while maintaining effective programme governance and stakeholder engagement.

Key Responsibilities:

Programme Governance & Leadership
  • Establish programme governance structures, decision gates, escalation protocols, and reporting cadence across all project packages.
  • Provide leadership and strategic direction to PMC teams, ensuring alignment with client objectives and programme milestones.
  • Drive executive-level decision-making and issue resolution throughout the project lifecycle.

Stakeholder Management
  • Chair executive progress meetings, risk reviews, interface reviews, and commissioning readiness assessments with the Client and package leaders.
  • Represent PMC during high-level engagements with the Client, utility authorities, government agencies, and key stakeholders.
  • Facilitate alignment among project stakeholders to ensure successful programme delivery.

Programme Oversight & Risk Management
  • Direct resolution of cross-package issues affecting COD, energization, HOTO, safety, quality, contractual obligations, and stakeholder approvals.
  • Review and endorse programme recovery plans and corrective action strategies.
  • Lead strategic risk treatment initiatives and provide programme-level recommendations to mitigate project risks.

Commercial & Contractual Governance
  • Review strategic change recommendations and programme-level closeout positions.
  • Ensure recommendations comply with contractual requirements, project governance standards, and client expectations.
  • Maintain PMC independence while supporting informed client decision-making.

Accountability & Performance Assurance
  • Ensure PMC services remain within the agreed RACI framework.
  • Verify that Contractor and OEM execution accountability is maintained and not diluted.
  • Monitor programme performance against key delivery milestones and governance requirements.

Principal Client-Facing Outputs
  • Monthly Executive Programme Report.
  • Programme Decision Log and Governance Dashboard.
  • Consolidated Risk and Escalation Brief.
  • Recovery Strategy and Recommendation Reports.
  • Programme Readiness Recommendations for:
  • Energization
  • Commercial Operation Date (COD)
  • Hand-Over / Take-Over (HOTO)
  • Executive stakeholder presentations and programme status updates.

Qualifications

Minimum Experience: 20+ Years with Bachelor's of Technology.

Additional Information

Preferred Attributed:
  • Executive Leadership
  • Renewable Energy Programme Management
  • Governance & Compliance
  • Stakeholder Engagement
  • Risk Management
  • Commercial Acumen
  • Strategic Planning
  • Contract Administration
  • Decision-Making & Problem Solving
  • Communication & Negotiation Skills
  • Large-scale Renewable Energy Projects
  • Hybrid Solar, Wind & BESS Programmes
  • Transmission & Grid Integration Projects
  • EPC / PMC Environment
  • Multi-package Infrastructure Programmes
  • Utility-scale Energy Developments

Premier Research is looking for a Manager, Clinical Data Sciences to join our Clinical Data Sciences team.

You will help biotech, medtech, and specialty pharma companies transform life-changing ideas and breakthrough science into new medicines, devices, and diagnostics. What we do is profoundly connected to saving and improving lives, and we recognize our team members are the most valuable asset in delivering success.

  • Serves as primary Clinical Data Sciences contact in assigned studies and ensures that data cleaning is performed in a consistent way between team members

IoW Architect (Background CSA or Architecture) x2,

IoW (CSA) x 2

IoW (Mechanical) x 2

IoW (Electrical) x 2

Requirement

  • Personnel shall not exceed 55 years of age. IOW personnel must have at least 5 years of work experience.
  • Personnel must be familiar with design drawings and local codes, and must be able to identify issues in site construction quality based on design drawings and construction specifications.
  • Contract project basis, minimum 1 year.
  • Registered as graduate engineer or inspector of work with BEM. Must provide proof of certificate.

Compliance with Standards

  • Ensure all construction activities strictly adhere to approved design documents, technical specifications, national codes, and industry standards.
  • Verify that any deviations or modifications are formally approved before implementation.

Inspection of Materials and Equipment

  • Review and approve the quality certificates, test reports, and supplier documentation for all materials and equipment delivered to site.
  • Conduct on-site inspections to confirm that materials meet specified requirements before use.
  • Reject or quarantine non-conforming materials and report findings to the project owner.

Workmanship Supervision

  • Monitor construction methods and workmanship to ensure they meet contractual and technical requirements.
  • Conduct regular site inspections and witness all construction processes (e.g., concrete pouring, steel reinforcement placement, waterproofing).
  • Require corrective actions for any deficiencies identified during inspections.

Testing and Verification

  • Supervise and witness laboratory and field tests (e.g., soil compaction, concrete strength, weld integrity).
  • Review test results and confirm compliance with specifications.
  • Ensure that independent testing agencies are properly accredited and that testing procedures follow recognized standards.

Quality Documentation

  • Maintain detailed records of inspections, test results, and approvals.
  • Prepare non-conformance reports (NCRs) and track corrective actions until closure.
  • Submit periodic quality assurance reports to the project owner.

Continuous Improvement

  • Recommend improvements to construction processes and quality management practices.
  • Provide guidance to contractors on best practices and preventive measures to avoid recurring issues.

Coordination and Communication

  • Coordination: Collaborate with subcontractors, suppliers, and project managers to address quality concerns and ensure timely resolution of issue.
  • Attend Quality Coordination Meetings with the PM/PD, GC on the quality issues that found on site.
  • Attend Quality Coordination Meetings with client QA/QC team on the quality issues that found on site.
  • Attending Regular Meetings (on work progress, coordination, design, etc.) with GC and Consultant to discuss key issues related to the project quality issues and take effective corrective actions.

Job Description

The Quality Advisor works closely with the Asia HSEQ team and reports to the Associate Quality Excellence (India). This person will be key in implementation of surveillance and monitoring programmes across our projects to ensure a robust and compliant quality culture is in place that aligns to our IMS and Way of Working. This person will also ensure quality compliance and liaise with Project teams where required, closely work with the Associate Quality Excellence (India) to provide source support and guidance to our Project Leaders, Quality leads, and their teams deliver an effective quality management framework across their project programmes.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure that our people follow our way of working, the requirements of the Project Life Cycle (PLC) and Integrated Management System (IMS)
  • Support and promote our quality management system (QMS)
  • Perform online scheduled quality audits and reviews across all projects and undertake surveillances as required, including reports.
  • Use quality management tools and techniques to promote continual improvement and quality awareness
  • Predict quality performance using trends and reports, lead actions to address risk elsewhere in the business
  • Provide quality management support and assistance, working closely with the project teams
  • Provide inputs to our quality statistical tracking and trending data, provide weekly and monthly reports.
  • Advises the projects on suitable quality objectives, KPIs and targets in line with WSP and client quality requirements, report for any deviations noted.
  • Following a risk-based approach, assist in the preparation of the quality audit schedule, ensuring compliance and identify any gaps and/or improvements
  • Report audit findings with recommendations for correction, corrective and improvement to the management
  • Participate in management meetings providing insight into the key areas of risks and opportunities
  • Reviews, collates, and communicates all quality reports from Projects, prepares countries overall KPI reporting and sends to Quality Excellence Team Leader for senior level reporting.
  • Monitor quality trends, conducts analysis, and provides reporting as may be required.
  • Reviews and ensures follow-up of any quality related complaints or concerns.

Why does it matter to our Business


  • Our Way of Working is what differentiates us from our competitors
  • Compliance with our IMS framework drives consistency in our processes and excellence in our service delivery
  • Process and system audits enable us to understand the true position of compliance and risk
  • Embedding a compliance and improvement culture drives long term resilience in our approach to right first time and maintains our organisational ISO certifications
  • Ensures that our governance and operational process are fit for purpose.

How do I know when I am successful at what I do


  • Reduction of complaints and improvement in project teams compliance with WSP way of working.
  • Building strong relationships with project leads and Quality Managers
  • I achieve our targets and objectives for support, compliance, and training.
  • Our people are actively engaging in quality collaboration and excellence
  • Audits are timely done and reported, same with the Project KPIs.

What are my key relationships


  • Head of HSEQ/Quality - Asia (Asia based)

Qualifications

  • Formal training in an ISO 9001:2015 related course
  • Bachelor's degree in an Engineering and/or Construction related discipline
  • Excellent communication skills, verbal and written in English
  • Experience of operational auditing
  • Basic knowledge of database computer systems and software including Microsoft word, excel, visio and SharePoint.
  • Flexible approach to managing, prioritising and delivering to deadlines in a demanding environment
  • Experience of documentation processes within an engineering, design, or construction environment
  • Good understanding of ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards

Key Competencies


Quality Advisor is expected to have the below-listed skills to excel in their role and contribute to high-quality outcomes and deliverables that bring value to the organization.

  • Strong Analytical Skills
  • Attention to Detail
  • Technical Proficiency
  • Excellent Communication Skills
  • Problem-Solving Abilities
  • Knowledge of Quality Techniques
  • Adaptability and Continuous Learning
  • Strong Documentation Skills.

We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
At GoML, we design and build cutting-edge Generative AI, AI/ML, and Data Engineering solutions that help businesses unlock the full potential of their data, drive intelligent automation, and create transformative AI-powered experiences.

Our mission is to bridge the gap between state-of-the-art AI research and real-world enterprise applications—helping organizations innovate faster, make smarter decisions, and scale AI solutions seamlessly.

We're looking for a Business Analyst with strong experience in large-scale government initiatives, requirement gathering, process documentation, user training, and product documentation.

In this role, you will work directly with government stakeholders and internal delivery teams to ensure requirement clarity, documentation excellence, stakeholder alignment, and smooth project execution. You will also play a key role in continuously defining project scope, documenting workflows and changes, and ensuring alignment with applicable government and internal standards.

If you enjoy stakeholder engagement, process-driven delivery, and working on impactful public-sector transformation programs, this role is for you.

Why You Why Now

Government and PSU digital transformation projects require a high level of discipline, documentation precision, stakeholder coordination, and structured governance.

With the increasing focus on Digital India initiatives, compliance, and structured delivery, we need a Business Analyst who can bring clarity to complex requirements, manage multiple stakeholders, document evolving workflows and scope, and create clear functional and user-facing documentation throughout the project lifecycle.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in structured environments, can manage government-level stakeholders, and enjoys transforming complex requirements into clear, actionable documentation for technical teams, end users, and project leadership.

What You'll Do

First 30 Days: Foundation & Stakeholder Alignment

  • Understand the project context, scope, government client expectations, and delivery milestones.
  • Review existing requirement documents, project templates, governance processes, and documentation standards.
  • Familiarize yourself with tools such as JIRA, Confluence, MS Visio, and the MS Office Suite.
  • Shadow stakeholder meetings and internal discussions to understand workflows, dependencies, and expectations.
  • Study the project governance structure, approval hierarchy, reporting processes, and applicable government standards.
  • Understand the product, target users, training requirements, and existing user documentation.

First 60 Days: Execution & Delivery Support

  • Conduct requirement-gathering sessions through stakeholder interviews, workshops, meetings, and process walkthroughs.
  • Continuously support project scoping by identifying, analysing, and documenting business needs, workflows, dependencies, assumptions, and changes.
  • Create and maintain key project documents, including:
  • Business Requirement Documents (BRD)
  • Functional Requirement Specifications (FRS)
  • Software Requirement Specifications (SRS)
  • Process flows and workflows
  • Use cases and user stories
  • UAT documents and test scenarios
  • Change request and impact analysis documents
  • User training materials
  • Product manuals, user guides, and standard operating procedures
  • Act as a bridge between government client teams and internal development, testing, product, and delivery teams.
  • Support change requests, requirement tracking, impact assessment, and version-control practices.
  • Participate in project status meetings, requirement reviews, demonstrations, and client presentations.
  • Ensure project documentation, workflows, and changes remain aligned with applicable government guidelines and internal delivery standards.
  • Coordinate with product and technical teams to ensure user manuals and training content accurately reflect the implemented solution.

First 180 Days: Ownership & Governance Excellence

  • Own end-to-end requirement traceability and ensure alignment across requirements, design, development, testing, training, and delivery.
  • Manage UAT support, issue tracking, resolution coordination, closure, and final client sign-offs.
  • Maintain complete, structured, and audit-ready documentation trails.
  • Ensure effective governance for requirement approvals, scope changes, workflow changes, and change management.
  • Continuously review and document evolving project scope, business processes, workflows, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Ensure changes are clearly communicated and aligned with government requirements, internal standards, and delivery objectives.
  • Own the creation, review, versioning, and maintenance of user training materials, product manuals, user guides, FAQs, and operational documentation.
  • Plan and facilitate user training sessions, product walkthroughs, and knowledge-transfer activities for government stakeholders and end users.
  • Gather user feedback from training and UAT sessions and translate it into actionable product or documentation improvements.
  • Provide continuous improvement recommendations for documentation standards, training processes, stakeholder workflows, and project governance.
  • Support the implementation of government-prescribed standards and formats where applicable.

What You Bring

Must-Have

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of relevant Business Analysis experience.
  • Strong hands-on exposure to Government or PSU projects.
  • Demonstrated experience in requirement gathering, scope definition, process mapping, and change management.
  • Proven ability to create structured business, functional, technical, training, and user documentation.
  • Experience creating product manuals, user guides, training materials, and standard operating procedures.
  • Experience conducting or supporting user training, product demonstrations, and knowledge-transfer sessions.
  • Excellent stakeholder communication, coordination, facilitation, and documentation skills.
  • Strong understanding of public-sector operations, approval structures, and structured delivery models.
  • Ability to continuously track and document evolving requirements, workflows, dependencies, and scope changes.
  • Proficiency in MS Visio, JIRA, Confluence, and the MS Office Suite.

Nice-to-Have

  • Business Analysis certifications such as CBAP, CCBA, or PMI-PBA.
  • Understanding of Agile, Waterfall, and Hybrid delivery models.
  • Experience in RFP/RFQ analysis, proposal support, or pre-sales documentation.
  • Familiarity with MeitY guidelines, NIC formats, and Digital India frameworks.
  • Experience designing training plans, conducting train-the-trainer sessions, or developing e-learning content.

Why Work With Us

  • Opportunity to work on large-scale Government and PSU digital transformation projects.
  • Be part of structured delivery environments with strong project discipline and governance.
  • Direct stakeholder interaction across impactful public-sector programs.
  • Ownership of requirements, workflows, user training, and product documentation.
  • Work alongside product, delivery, QA, and engineering teams to ensure end-to-end delivery excellence.

jobs.title: GIS Specialist
jobs.description:
About Us

Egis is a leading global architectural, consulting, construction engineering, operations and mobility services firm. We create and operate intelligent infrastructure and buildings that both respond to the climate emergency and contribute to balanced, sustainable and resilient development.

Our 22,000 employees operate across over 100 countries, deploying their expertise to develop and deliver cutting-edge innovations and solutions for clients. Through the wide range of our activities, we are central to the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.

With 3,500 employees across 8 countries in the Middle East, Egis has delivered over 700 complex development projects, stimulating economic growth and enhancing quality of life. Ranked among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development. The Group's operations in the Middle East are built on strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions. Egis long history of providing comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services makes it a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers.

About The Role

We are seeking a skilled GIS Specialist to support the development and delivery of geospatial solutions across infrastructure, buildings, urban development, and sustainable city projects. The successful candidate will be responsible for spatial data management, GIS analysis, BIM-GIS integration, application support, and geospatial visualisation while collaborating with multidisciplinary project teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and manage GIS databases and geospatial datasets.
  • Perform spatial analysis, data modelling, and geoprocessing to support project requirements and decision-making.
  • Create high-quality maps, dashboards, and visualisation products for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Support BIM-GIS integration workflows and coordinate geospatial data exchange with BIM platforms.
  • Utilise FME for data transformation, migration, validation, and interoperability between various systems.
  • Assist in the design and implementation of GIS workflows, standards, and best practices.
  • Develop and maintain GIS applications, tools, and automated processes.
  • Conduct quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) activities on geospatial datasets.
  • Collaborate with engineers, planners, architects, and project teams to gather and analyse spatial requirements.
  • Support the management and analysis of remote sensing and imagery datasets.
  • Prepare technical documentation, reports, and project deliverables.
  • Stay updated with emerging GIS technologies and recommend process improvements.

What do we need from you

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in GIS, Geomatics, Geography, Geoinformatics, Environmental Science, Civil Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
  • 4 to 8 years of relevant GIS experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with ArcGIS Pro and QGIS.
  • Experience in spatial analysis, cartography, and geospatial data management.
  • Working knowledge of BIM-GIS integration concepts and workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with FME for data conversion and ETL processes.
  • Experience with spatial databases and SQL.
  • Proficiency in Python scripting for GIS automation and workflow optimization.
  • Understanding of coordinate systems, projections, and geospatial standards.
  • Experience working with raster, vector, and remote sensing datasets.

Preferred Skills

  • Exposure to infrastructure, transportation, utilities, urban planning, smart city, or building projects.
  • Experience with ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online, or Web GIS applications.
  • Knowledge of Autodesk BIM platforms (Revit, Civil 3D, InfraWorks, Autodesk Construction Cloud).
  • Familiarity with geospatial data publishing, dashboards, and web mapping solutions.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple project deliverables and timelines.
  • Effective stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.

What's in it for you

Please upload your Resume, Cover Letter and any other supporting documentation where asked within your application. Ensure you consider the skills and experience needed for this role and include in your application.

The Electronic Market Making Cash Trading team systematically provides liquidity in US Equities and ETFs, both on-exchange and to low-touch client flow. We're a small team that demands a high level of ownership and accountability from each contributor, while strongly emphasizing collaboration and transparency. Engineers on the team are deeply involved in both software and strategy development. We are seeking a dedicated and ambitious engineer who thrives in a challenging environment and wants to make a meaningful impact at the firm.

Your Impact

You will be working on building and enhancing platforms focused on electronic trading, market making and execution. You will work with other engineers and trading teams to improve all aspects of execution, price-making and risk management. You'll do this with a keen eye on performance, guided by a robust measurement framework and lots of experimentation. You will have an opportunity to develop a deep understanding of how GS interacts with some of the most dynamic and liquid markets in the world.

Responsibilities

Design, build and maintain high performance, low latency trading platform which can evolve and adapt to changes in our fast-paced, global business environment.

Strong track record of designing, developing and maintaining reliable trading components and critical infrastructure

A deep passion for technology and software development

Sound understanding of multi-threaded application design and development and experience with lock-free data structures

Professional experience working with distributed systems

Knowledge of CPU microarchitecture, caches and memory subsystems and experience with micro-optimizations

We are seeking a Tax Compliance Program Manager to support the First Line of Defense (1LoD) for EU/UK tax compliance across Amazon's Marketplace business. In this role, you will execute against defined risk workstreams, support governance processes, and deliver control activities arising from EU and UK tax regulations. Working within established risk frameworks and under the guidance of senior programme leaders, you will contribute to ensuring the business operates within clearly defined risk appetite and compliance standards.

You will support the identification, assessment, and mitigation of tax compliance risks across Amazon's Global Selling ecosystem. This includes executing operational controls aligned to EU/UK regulatory requirements, maintaining risk documentation, tracking programme deliverables, and escalating emerging risks through appropriate channels. You will monitor regulatory developments and assess their operational implications, contributing analysis that informs programme-level decisions.

Your focus will be on maintaining preventative controls, supporting data integrity across tax and identity systems, and producing audit-ready documentation. Working cross-functionally with Legal, Policy, Product, Tax, and Data Science partners, you will execute against programme plans, support the resolution of systemic issues, and contribute to risk-based control frameworks. You will ensure compliance activities within your workstreams are proportionate, risk-calibrated, and delivered on time and to the expected quality bar.

  • Own defined workstreams within EU and UK tax compliance programmes, delivering risk assessments and control activities on time and to quality standards

  • Analyze EU/UK tax compliance regulations (e.g., VAT, DAC7, JSL, Deemed Reseller) and their implications for Amazon sellers, translating requirements into actionable deliverables
  • Support the development and maintenance of risk models and detection mechanisms to identify non-compliant or fraudulent seller behaviour related to tax obligations
  • Collaborate with legal, policy, finance, tax, tech, and product teams to execute programme plans and deliver operational controls for new and existing programmes

You are joining a global team spread across the US, EU, Japan, and India. You will partner closely with a Tax Governance manager in the UK and collaborate heavily with Risk teams based in India and the EU to ensure Amazon's compliance controls are in the best possible working order.

Your days will blend regulatory analysis, cross-functional delivery, and stakeholder coordination across multiple time zones. One morning you are reviewing control effectiveness with the 2nd Line of Defence; the afternoon you are in a working session with EU 3P Marketplace partners assessing the impact of a new VAT regulation on sellers. No two days are the same, but the constant is pace, impact, and global reach.

Description

Amazon's Global Procurement Organization is on a mission to transform how procurement works at Amazon scale. We build the technology that powers billions of dollars in purchasing decisions, and We're looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead the delivery of technical solutions and programs focused on inventory management of non-inventory supplies across Amazon's global operations. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of technology, operations, and business strategy — where your work directly influences how Amazon procures and manages supplies at scale.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own and drive complex, cross-functional programs that modernize how non-inventory supplies are managed across Amazon's global network of sites.
  • Collaborate deeply with business partners and technology teams within the Operations business unit to ensure solutions integrate seamlessly with existing software and hardware deployed at Amazon Operations sites worldwide
  • Actively participate in architecture and design discussions, leveraging a strong understanding of AWS services to drive the right technical decisions and trade-offs
  • Independently identify and resolve integration challenges across external and internal teams, driving alignment without requiring constant escalation
  • Champion the use of AI and machine learning tools to automate workflows, surface insights, and transform procurement technology
  • Define program strategy, set objectives, manage roadmaps, and drive delivery across multiple engineering teams and organizations
  • Proactively identify risks, clear blockers, and accelerate progress by driving crisp, timely decisions
  • Communicate program status, trade-offs, and outcomes effectively to senior leadership including Directors and VPs

What We're Looking For

Successful applicants will have experience developing functional and non-functional requirements, writing high-level technical designs, systems integration plans, and technical specifications. You are someone who thrives facilitating both business and technical meetings, partnering with resources outside of your immediate team to get things done, and navigating shifting priorities by scheduling and pivoting project plans as needed. You bring a track record of communicating status clearly, resolving risks proactively, removing barriers for engineering teams, leading cross-functional teams, and communicating effectively to a large number of stakeholders across multiple organizations.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with AWS services and cloud-native architectures, and can hold their own in design reviews and technical deep dives. You have a strong grasp of AI and machine learning technologies and understand how to apply them to solve real-world operational problems. You are comfortable operating in ambiguity, bringing structure and clarity where none exists, and you have a bias for action that keeps programs moving forward. Above all, you are customer-obsessed — always working backwards from the needs of the business and the end user.

Why You'll Love It Here

Our team thinks big and moves fast. We're passionate about innovating on behalf of our customers and tackling problems at a scale few organizations ever encounter. You'll work in a fast paced environment where your designs directly impact how Amazon operates, with the freedom to push boundaries and make bold ideas real.

Key job responsibilities

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Define and manage the end-to-end lifecycle of complex, cross-functional technology programs — from requirements gathering and design through build, launch, and iteration.
  • Develop functional and non-functional requirements, high-level technical designs, systems integration plans, and technical specifications in partnership with engineering, product and business teams.
  • Drive architecture and design discussions, applying deep knowledge of AWS services and AI to evaluate trade-offs, challenge assumptions, and ensure solutions are scalable, secure, AI-driven and operationally sound.
  • Lead integration efforts with existing software and hardware systems deployed across Amazon sites, independently resolving cross-team technical challenges and driving alignment across organizations.
  • Manage program roadmaps, milestones, and dependencies across multiple engineering teams. Proactively identify risks, develop mitigation strategies, and remove barriers to keep delivery on track.
  • Facilitate business and technical meetings, driving crisp decisions and ensuring the right people are in the room at the right time.
  • Communicate program status, risks, trade-offs, and outcomes to a broad set of stakeholders — from engineering teams to Directors and VPs — through clear written narratives and verbal updates.
  • Schedule and pivot project plans as priorities shift, balancing short-term delivery needs against long-term strategic goals.
  • Drive process improvements that increase the speed and quality of delivery across teams, streamlining mechanisms and eliminating unnecessary overhead.
  • Drive the expansion and scaling of existing products within your program portfolio into new regions, business lines, or use cases — identifying growth opportunities, building the business case, and leading cross-functional execution to broaden impact.

About The Team

Global Procurement Technology is the technical force behind Amazon's Global Procurement Organization. We build the tools and systems that power procurement across Amazon — a function that forms the backbone of the company's operations. Our team sets the technology strategy for the business, driving its AI transformation by embedding intelligent automation, machine learning, and data-driven capabilities into every layer of the procurement experience. We partner closely with business teams to modernize systems, simplify complex workflows, and deliver scalable solutions that help Amazon procure smarter, faster, and more efficiently at global scale.

The HR Operations Specialist is primarily responsible for managing clinical license reimbursement. This role will process and track license reimbursement submissions, review receipts and supporting documentation, verify clinical licenses, coordinate reimbursement processing, ensure accurate and timely inputs, and manage reimbursement repayment dates. In addition to licensing and reimbursement responsibilities, the HR Operations Specialist will support employee and consultant lifecycle processes, HR documentation, workforce administration, HRIS maintenance, compliance activities, and coordination with internal stakeholders.

Clinical Licensing & Reimbursements:

· Manage and maintain accurate records of clinical license reimbursement submissions across the organization and supported regions.

· Review submitted license reimbursement requests for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with company reimbursement policies.

· Review receipts and supporting documentation to verify that expenses are valid and relate to the applicable clinical license, renewal, or licensing fee.

· Verify clinical license information associated with reimbursement submissions, including license number, state, status, and other applicable details.

· Process and track reimbursement requests from submission through reimbursement completion and repayment timelines.

· Coordinate with employees, consultants, payroll, finance, and other internal stakeholders to resolve missing documentation, discrepancies, or questions related to reimbursement submissions.

· Ensure approved reimbursement information is accurately submitted to payroll within established processing timelines.

· Follow up on outstanding reimbursement payments, rejected submissions, or discrepancies to ensure timely resolution.

· Maintain organized records of reimbursement requests, receipts, payment confirmations, license documentation, and related correspondence.

· Coordinate payment of applicable fees associated with new clinical license applications.

· Verify newly issued licenses and ensure accurate license information is documented in the appropriate internal systems.

· Communicate with employees, consultants, payroll, and other stakeholders regarding application and reimbursement status.

· Prepare regular reports or updates on license reimbursement activity, new license applications, pending submissions, and payment status.

· Identify incomplete submissions or documentation issues and follow up with the appropriate individuals to obtain the information needed to complete processing.

· Ensure all licensing and reimbursement records are maintained accurately and are readily available for audit or compliance purposes.

Qualifications:

· Experience in HR Operations, HR Shared Services, staffing operations, workforce administration, licensing administration, or a related operational role.

· Experience processing or tracking professional or clinical license reimbursements preferred.

· Familiarity with clinical license verification and state licensing boards.

· Experience reviewing receipts, expense documentation, and reimbursement requests.

· Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify discrepancies, missing documentation, and payment issues.

· Experience coordinating reimbursements, payments, payroll inputs, or finance-related processes.

· Ability to manage multiple reimbursement submissions and licensing applications simultaneously.

· Knowledge of employee lifecycle management and HR operational processes.

· Hands-on experience with HRIS platforms such as UKG and Keka preferred.

· Strong communication, follow-up, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.

· Excellent organizational and documentation skills.

This is a senior technical program leadership role focused on security, cloud infrastructure, and large-scale engineering environments.

You will coordinate complex programs spanning multiple engineering teams, product groups, legal stakeholders, and enterprise commitments.

A key focus will be driving cloud security initiatives, remediation programs, audit readiness, and secure operational practices.

The role combines strong program management with hands-on technical depth, including architecture reviews, production systems, security tooling, and incident analysis.

You will help establish scalable mechanisms for prioritization, intake, launch readiness, and long-term program execution.

The position requires the ability to reason deeply about distributed systems, cloud architecture, security data, and modern software development.

Working remotely from India, you will have significant influence on security programs supporting critical experiences at massive scale.

Accountabilities

  • Lead and coordinate complex technical programs and multiple workstreams across Product Engineering, Security, Legal, and enterprise-facing initiatives.
  • Own the program management layer for cloud security efforts, including security control rollouts, remediation service-level agreements, governance, and audit readiness.
  • Build scalable execution mechanisms, including product-style intake processes, prioritization frameworks, program operating rhythms, and launch readiness reviews.
  • Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Build, Architecture, and leadership teams to drive successful product launches and smooth deprecation of legacy tooling.
  • Coordinate security programs spanning multiple engineering teams and maintain clear ownership, milestones, dependencies, risks, and outcomes.
  • Participate confidently in architecture reviews, technical design discussions, build documentation reviews, and post-incident debriefs.
  • Read and reason about production code in modern programming languages such as Python, Go, and Java to effectively engage with engineering teams.

  • 10+ years of technical program management experience, including at least 5 years supporting security, cloud, data platform, infrastructure, or similarly complex technical organizations at scale.

jobs.description:
Job Title: HR Operations Specialist

Experience: 3 - 5 Years

Location: Hyderabad

Employment Type: Full-time

About NationsBenefits:

NationsBenefits is recognized as one of the fastest-growing companies in America and a leading Healthcare Fintech provider. We specialize in supplemental benefits, flex cards, and member engagement solutions.

Partnering with managed care organizations, we offer innovative healthcare solutions that drive growth, improve outcomes, reduce costs, and deliver value to members.

Through our comprehensive suite of supplemental benefits, fintech payment platforms, and member engagement solutions, we enablehealth plans to provide high-quality benefits that address social determinants of health, ultimately improving member health outcomes and satisfaction.

We offer a dynamic and fulfilling work environment that attracts top talent, where associates are encouraged to contribute to delivering premier service to both internal and external customers. Our goal is to transform the healthcare industry for the better! We provide opportunities for career advancement across multiple locations in the US, South America, and India.

Position Overview:

The HR Operations Specialist is primarily responsible for managing clinical license reimbursement. This role will process and track license reimbursement submissions, review receipts and supporting documentation, verify clinical licenses, coordinate reimbursement processing, ensure accurate and timely inputs, and manage reimbursement repayment dates. In addition to licensing and reimbursement responsibilities, the HR Operations Specialist will support employee and consultant lifecycle processes, HR documentation, workforce administration, HRIS maintenance, compliance activities, and coordination with internal stakeholders.

Clinical Licensing & Reimbursements:

  • Manage and maintain accurate records of clinical license reimbursement submissions across the organization and supported regions.
  • Review submitted license reimbursement requests for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with company reimbursement policies.
  • Review receipts and supporting documentation to verify that expenses are valid and relate to the applicable clinical license, renewal, or licensing fee.
  • Verify clinical license information associated with reimbursement submissions, including license number, state, status, and other applicable details.
  • Process and track reimbursement requests from submission through reimbursement completion and repayment timelines.
  • Coordinate with employees, consultants, payroll, finance, and other internal stakeholders to resolve missing documentation, discrepancies, or questions related to reimbursement submissions.
  • Ensure approved reimbursement information is accurately submitted to payroll within established processing timelines.
  • Follow up on outstanding reimbursement payments, rejected submissions, or discrepancies to ensure timely resolution.
  • Maintain organized records of reimbursement requests, receipts, payment confirmations, license documentation, and related correspondence.
  • Coordinate payment of applicable fees associated with new clinical license applications.
  • Verify newly issued licenses and ensure accurate license information is documented in the appropriate internal systems.
  • Communicate with employees, consultants, payroll, and other stakeholders regarding application and reimbursement status.
  • Prepare regular reports or updates on license reimbursement activity, new license applications, pending submissions, and payment status.
  • Identify incomplete submissions or documentation issues and follow up with the appropriate individuals to obtain the information needed to complete processing.
  • Ensure all licensing and reimbursement records are maintained accurately and are readily available for audit or compliance purposes.

Qualifications:

  • Experience in HR Operations, HR Shared Services, staffing operations, workforce administration, licensing administration, or a related operational role.
  • Experience processing or tracking professional or clinical license reimbursements preferred.
  • Familiarity with clinical license verification and state licensing boards.
  • Experience reviewing receipts, expense documentation, and reimbursement requests.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify discrepancies, missing documentation, and payment issues.
  • Experience coordinating reimbursements, payments, payroll inputs, or finance-related processes.
  • Ability to manage multiple reimbursement submissions and licensing applications simultaneously.
  • Knowledge of employee lifecycle management and HR operational processes.
  • Hands-on experience with HRIS platforms such as UKG and Keka preferred.
  • Strong communication, follow-up, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent organizational and documentation skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel and reporting functions.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting clinical or healthcare professional licensing across multiple U.S. states.
  • Familiarity with state clinical licensing boards and online licensing portals.
  • Experience supporting initial license applications, licensing fees, or license verification.
  • Experience with reimbursement, expense management, payroll, or accounts payable processes.
  • Experience supporting multi-state or multi-region workforce operations.
  • Familiarity with audit and compliance documentation processes.
  • Experience working with remote or distributed workforce models.
