Description

Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

We're at the frontier of space-based internet technology, and with that comes the thrill of building something entirely new, along with the unique challenges of operating a service that spans ground infrastructure, orbital assets, and customer homes. When things go wrong at scale, a firmware update impacts thousands of devices, satellite coverage doesn't meet demand, or a field service visit makes headlines on social media, someone needs to take command. That someone is you.

Key job responsibilities

The Network Solutions Global Command Center (GCC) Leo team is looking for a Program Manager who thrives in high-stakes, fast-moving environments. You'll be the calm in the storm, coordinating across Field Services, Engineering, Legal, PR, and Security Operations to protect our customers and our brand in real-time. If you're excited about satellite technology, love solving complex problems under pressure, and want to be part of a venture that's literally changing the world from space, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities

  • Manage high-severity incidents impacting Leo satellite internet customers by running bridge calls and coordinating with Field Services, Product, Engineering, PR, Legal, and Security Operations teams to drive resolution
  • Triage technical incidents (firmware failures, weather events, bandwidth degradation) and coordinate with relevant teams to identify root cause and resolution path
  • Initiate and manage proactive customer communications including website/app banners, IVR updates, and mass notifications to reduce anxiety contacts during known issues
  • Protect contact channels by identifying known-issue volume and ensuring customers with genuine issues can reach Leo Customer Service without congestion
  • Provide regular, timely updates to senior leadership with clear customer impact assessments, resolution timelines, and status indicators
  • Monitor social media escalations involving field service agents or customer property incidents, and coordinate PR/Legal/Security response to protect Leo brand
  • Coordinate with Legal and PR teams on sensitive incidents requiring external messaging — particularly those involving customer property damage, social media traction, or regulatory implications
  • Dive deep into incident data, identify systemic problems, and present solutions and preventive measures to leadership
  • Develop, maintain, and execute Standard Operating Procedures for incident response scenarios, including coordination playbooks for cross-functional teams
  • Track satellite coverage vs. customer demand mismatches and coordinate with Marketing to pause promotions when capacity is insufficient

Basic Qualifications

  • 2+ years of program or project management experience
  • 3+ years of Computerized Maintenance Management System program experience
  • 3+ years of maintenance planner/scheduler in industrial maintenance, manufacturing, or distribution industries experience
  • 3+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience
  • Bachelor's degree in relevant field, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) full time experience

  • Experience in MS Access and SQL
  • Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document
  • Experience using Microsoft Projects software
  • Experience with material handling systems (MHS) installation, operation and maintenance

jobs.title: Director - People Operations (HR)
jobs.description:
Director – People Operations (HR)

Reports to: Managing Partner

Location: Navi Mumbai (Ghansoli) — with oversight across three facilities

Function: Human Resources

Employment Type: Full-time

Industry: IT / Software · RCM (US Medical Billing) · Healthcare Services

About TRIARQ Health

TRIARQ Health is a Physician Practice Services company that partners with doctors to run modern, patient-centered practices so they can be rewarded for delivering high-value care. Our physician-led model simplifies the transition to value-based care by combining a proprietary, cloud-based practice and care-management platform with patient-engagement services, freeing doctors to focus on better outcomes.

About the Role

We are seeking a dynamic, hands-on HR leader to join us as Director – People Operations, reporting directly to the Managing Partner. This role is pivotal in shaping and scaling our people and culture function as the business grows rapidly across our Tech, RCM, and Operations divisions.

You will own four HR verticals end to end — Talent Acquisition, Talent Management & Development, HR Operations & Compliance, and Admin/Facilities — and be accountable for weaving TRIARQ's culture, values, and strategic goals into every part of the employee lifecycle. This is a builder's role for someone who leads from the front, is energized by scale, and turns ambiguity into action.

Key Responsibilities1. Talent Acquisition — Scaling the Business

Build and execute a talent acquisition strategy that fuels the company's growth across Tech, RCM, and Operations. You will:

  • Drive strategic hiring that scales the workforce rapidly and efficiently while keeping our culture and values fully intact.
  • Own workforce planning in close partnership with department heads — forecasting hiring needs, designing recruitment strategies, and ensuring TRIARQ can scale operations ahead of demand.
  • Deliver a seamless onboarding and integration experience so new hires ramp quickly and connect to our culture and ways of working from day one.
2. Talent Management & Development

Act as a strategic HR business partner to the Tech and RCM businesses, with a relentless focus on retention and employee experience. You will:

  • Business-partner the divisions on employee relations, retention strategy, and attrition control — using stay interviews, exit interviews, and employee pulse surveys to continuously read the organization and act on what you learn.
  • Own Learning & Development across technical training, operational training, and soft skills, including the effective rollout and utilization of the Learning Management System (LMS).
  • Lead the performance management cycle end to end — timely quarterly feedback, appraisals, and career development plans that build capability and a clear path for growth.
3. People, Culture & Rewards

Champion TRIARQ's core values and build a workplace where people are engaged, motivated, and aligned to the mission. You will:

  • Drive cultural development — fostering a positive, inclusive, high-performance culture and keeping the company's mission and values front and center.
  • Own compensation and benefits — designing and managing competitive C&B programs that attract and retain top talent, upholding high ethical standards, regularly benchmarking against the market, and running an effective annual increment cycle that you continuously improve.
  • Lead employee engagement and retention — implementing programs that deepen engagement, reduce turnover, and make TRIARQ an employer of choice; expanding our employer brand and social presence; and leading efforts to earn Great Place to Work certification and comparable cultural benchmarks.
  • Align people strategy to business strategy — partnering with senior leadership so every HR program is tied to the company's growth plans and strategic objectives.
  • Lead change management — guiding HR-driven change with clear communication and strong employee engagement throughout each transition.
4. HR Operations & Compliance

Run a tight, compliant, data-accurate HR operation. You will:

  • Ensure full compliance with central and state labour laws and the new wage codes; own employee relations, disciplinary cases, and proactive risk mitigation.
  • Own core HR operations — payroll, leave and attendance, and day-to-day HR system management.
  • Manage HRMS in partnership with the parent company — driving effective implementation and adoption, overseeing payroll systems, and administering benefits including Group Medical Coverage (GMC), Group Personal Accident (GPA), and Group Term Life (GTL) insurance.
  • Continuously improve HR systems and tools to raise efficiency and data accuracy.
5. Admin & Facilities Management

Oversee operations across all three TRIARQ facilities. You will:

  • Run facility operations — housekeeping, security, procurement, and budget management — ensuring compliance with local regulations and optimal use of resources.
  • Optimize cost — implementing strategies that reduce facility-related spend while maintaining high standards of safety and employee well-being.
Who You Are

We are looking for a leader with genuine presence and drive — someone who sets the pace rather than waits for direction:

  • Hands-on and in the detail. You lead from the front and are as comfortable building a process yourself as delegating it. You go to the floor, not just the dashboard.
  • Deeply experienced. You have done this before, at scale, and you carry the pattern recognition that only comes from years in the seat.
  • A natural communicator and people person. You talk to people constantly — across every level and every division — and build trust quickly. Relationships are how you get things done.
  • A proactive thinker. You anticipate problems before they surface, spot what's coming around the corner, and act early rather than react late.
  • Aggressive and driven. You bring urgency and high standards, push hard for outcomes, and are impatient with drift. You move fast and hold the bar high.
  • Solution-oriented. You come with answers, not just problems. When something breaks, you own it and drive it to resolution.
Skills & Qualifications
  • Proven senior HR leadership experience with a strong track record in culture development, strategic HR management, and scaling businesses in the IT and RCM industries.
  • Minimum 15+ years in HR in the IT industry, with hands-on experience in the RCM industry.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead HR operations across multiple verticals and geographies, aligned to the company's strategic objectives.
  • Strong in numbers and logical problem-solving; data-driven, with hands-on use of HR analytics for informed decision-making.
  • Strong strategic thinking and decision-making, paired with tactical execution and the ability to drive change.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and leadership abilities.
  • Proficiency in AI application usage and HRMS tools and systems.
  • Good hands-on command of MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Power BI.
Education

Bachelor's degree required; Master's in Management (HR) preferred.

How to Apply

Send your resume to [HIDDEN TEXT]

jobs.description:
Remote (India) · Full-time · UK business hours

About Script Assist

Script Assist is a UK-based healthtech platform powering the operational infrastructure behind private clinics and pharmacies. We run the operating system layer that makes regulated healthcare workflows safe, auditable, and fast — spanning clinic operations, pharmacy operations, prescribing and dispensing processes, fulfilment and delivery tracking, and operational reporting.

We're growing quickly, and we're building a world-class remote operations team in India to support UK clinic and pharmacy partners at scale.

Important: This is not a patient-facing role and you will not make clinical decisions. It's a high-ownership platform support / service desk role for a pharmacist who is tech-forward and loves structured problem-solving.

The Role

You'll be part of Script Assist's Platform Support / Customer Operations team supporting clinics and pharmacies using our platform every day. You'll handle a structured support queue, troubleshoot operational workflow issues, and escalate with high-quality evidence so problems get fixed quickly and permanently.

This role suits pharmacists who enjoy:

  • software systems and troubleshooting
  • workflow operations and process discipline
  • turning messy partner problems into clean, actionable tickets

What you'll do (pharmacy operations + platform support)

  • Provide platform support and service desk coverage for pharmacy and clinic partners
  • Triage operational issues across pharmacy workflows: dispensing operations, inventory status, batch/lot & expiry, substitutions, delivery exceptions
  • Support prescribing/dispensing operations from an operational perspective (non-clinical execution, SOP-led)
  • Investigate workflow issues before escalation: isolate scope, capture evidence, reproduce issues, document clearly
  • Maintain high-quality operational documentation and audit-friendly logs
  • Communicate clearly with partners: status updates, next steps, what information is needed
  • Identify repeat issues and contribute to SOP/playbook improvements to reduce future tickets

What tech-forward pharmacist means here

We're not looking for someone who can tolerate software. We want a pharmacist who:

  • is comfortable inside complex systems (dashboards, statuses, workflows, queues)
  • naturally troubleshoots issues and learns tools fast
  • writes clear, structured updates and issue reports
  • thinks in workflows and exceptions (if X → then Y; if edge case Z → escalate)

Must-haves

  • BPharm / MPharm (or higher)
  • Strong English (written and spoken)
  • Comfortable working UK business hours
  • Detail-oriented, calm under pressure, process-driven

High-signal experience

  • Pharmacy operations exposure (dispensing workflows, inventory, batch/expiry, delivery exceptions)
  • Healthtech / telemedicine / pharmacy platform exposure
  • Any structured support environment (queue-based work, SOP-led escalation, audit trails

jobs.title: Research Scientist (Field Deployment)
jobs.description:
Do you want to be part of the team that revolutionizes resource exploration through quantum sensing

 

Atomionics is working on quantum sensors based on atom-interferometry where atoms are cooled down to almost absolute zero using lasers. At such cold temperatures, the wave nature of atoms becomes prominent, which allows us to precisely measure the forces acting on them. This opens up a wide range of applications, including paving a path in the energy transition to zero-carbon and transforming resource exploration and geophysical surveying.

 

Headquartered in Singapore, Atomionics is now expanding its footprint to India, with our India operations anchored in the Amaravati Quantum Valley. As part of our India team, you will work closely with our Singapore headquarters, collaborating across borders while building deep tech capabilities locally, with our India team playing a critical role in field deployment of our Quantum Gravimeters.

 

We are looking for a Research Scientist/Physicist who:

  • Wants to be involved in research while gracefully maneuvering through the technical constraints of field deployment
  • Is excited by the prospect of working within an interdisciplinary team comprised of electronics engineers, mechanical engineers, and software engineers

Responsibilities

  • Conduct field trials of atom-interferometry based Quantum Gravimeters, supporting on-site setup and troubleshooting
  • Design and development of atom interferometry based sensors
  • Work in collaboration with electronics engineers and mechanical engineers to develop and refine the system
  • Research on the improvement and miniaturization of atom interferometry based sensors
  • Write patents

About you

  • MSc or PhD in Physics, with research experience in cold atom physics
  • Proficient in experimental work
  • Ability to work independently and in a team
  • Fluency in spoken and written English
  • Willing to travel and support field deployment activities, including work in on-site or remote conditions

Even better if you have

  • Prior experience in atom interferometry
  • Built atom interferometry based gravimeter, accelerometer, or gyroscope
  • Built near-IR lasers, laser locking system, and RF electronics
  • Experience in theoretical simulation of atomic systems
  • Developed control systems using FPGA

How to Apply

If this role sounds like a good fit for you, we'd love to hear from you! Apply directly through our careers page at www.atomionics.com or send your resume to [HIDDEN TEXT] or [HIDDEN TEXT]. Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Specialist
jobs.description:
About Company

House of Spices is a leading South Asian Food manufacturer and distributor in North America (USA & Canada) and has been delivering pure and quality products for over 50 years with 11 distribution centers throughout North America. We have our own brands and have exclusivity for distributing our partner brands in US / Canada. Our vision is to bring our culture alive through the celebration of authentic ethnic food, flavor and families. Our mission is to provide consumers easy access to all authentic ethnic food and flavors across the North American marketplace with a will to win. Visit www.hosindia.com to know more.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Summary/Objective:

The Supplier QA Executive will be primarily responsible for on-site production witnessing and supplier quality assurance for HOS products manufactured at supplier/co-packer facilities across South India.

The key responsibility is to ensure that every witnessed production is carried out as per approved HOS product specifications, formulations, process parameters, food-safety requirements, SOPs, GMP/GHP, sanitation requirements and applicable US FDA/FSMA requirements.

The position will have a strong shop-floor presence and will be responsible for identifying deviations during production, immediately communicating risks, ensuring containment, supporting root-cause analysis (RCA) and verifying effective implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

This is primarily a field-based supplier QA role, not a documentation-focused position.

Key Responsibilities

Supplier Production Witnessing & Process Compliance

  • Regularly visit assigned suppliers and witness production to ensure products are manufactured as per approved HOS specifications, formulations, process parameters, SOPs, quality standards and applicable food-safety requirements. Verify actual production conditions and process controls rather than relying only on supplier documentation.

Raw Material, Formulation & Product Specification Compliance

  • Verify the use of approved raw materials, ingredients and packaging materials and ensure formulation, processing, product characteristics, net weight and finished-product requirements comply with approved HOS specifications. Identify and escalate any unauthorized changes or deviations.

Critical Process & Food Safety Control Verification

  • Verify implementation and monitoring of HACCP/Preventive Controls, CCPs, critical process parameters and other food-safety controls during production, with particular focus on Frozen RTE and Rice processing.

Ready to eat products Quality Assurance:

  • Provide strong on-site quality oversight for Frozen RTE and Rice products, including cooking, cooling, freezing, hygiene, cross-contamination controls, temperature controls, foreign-material controls, destoning, grading, sortex, admixture, varietal authenticity and other product-specific requirements.

GMP, Hygiene, Sanitation & Plant Verification

  • Conduct regular physical verification of supplier facilities for GMP/GHP, personnel hygiene, housekeeping, cleaning and sanitation, pest control, allergen control, foreign-material prevention, equipment condition, calibration and other prerequisite programs.

Supplier Quality & Food Safety Audits

  • Conduct and support supplier/co-packer assessments and audits against HOS requirements, approved specifications, applicable regulatory requirements, GMP, HACCP/Preventive Controls, FSSC 22000/ISO 22000, BRC/customer requirements and other applicable standards.

Deviation, Non-Conformance & Containment Management

  • Identify quality and food-safety deviations during production, ensure appropriate immediate containment and segregation of affected material, determine the scope of impact and communicate significant issues to the QA Manager before product release or shipment.

Root Cause Analysis (RCA)

  • Lead or support supplier investigations for production deviations, complaints and non-conformances and ensure effective RCA using appropriate tools such as 5 Why, Fishbone and process analysis. Challenge incomplete or unsupported root causes and ensure the RCA addresses the actual cause of failure.

CAPA Implementation & Effectiveness Verification

  • Review supplier CAPA, verify implementation at the supplier site and ensure corrective and preventive actions address the identified root cause. CAPA shall be closed only after objective evidence and, where required, follow-up production witnessing demonstrate effectiveness and prevention of recurrence.

Complaint, Traceability & Supplier Performance Management

  • Support investigation of customer and internal complaints, verify batch/lot traceability, mock recalls, sample retention and relevant supplier records, and monitor supplier performance to identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities

Reporting, Follow-Up & Continuous Improvement

  • Prepare timely supplier visit and production-witnessing reports, document observations and objective evidence, track open actions and CAPA, follow up with suppliers until effective closure, and identify opportunities to improve supplier processes, quality performance and food-safety controls.

Travel

  1. Travel is mandatory for this Job Profile

Required Education and Experience

  1. A master's or bachelor's degree in food science/food technology or equivalent qualification.
  2. Should have handled 3P operations
  3. Knowledge of lab technique of analyzing different food product.
  4. Good in MS word, excel, and power point.
  5. Good organoleptic senses for product and sensory evaluation.
  6. Lead Auditor (Any GFSI Scheme Certified PCQI Personnel Preferred.

Preferred Knowledge

  1. Knowledge of lab technique and prior training in fundamental quality assurance technology.
  2. Basic Knowledge of Quality Assurance; GFSI and Regulatory (US FDA); FSMA and other Regulatory standards.
  3. Good Technical skills.
  4. Good communication skills.
  5. Aptitude in problem-solving.
  6. Working with start-up environment

Competencies

  1. Teamwork.
  2. Communication.
  3. Consultation.
  4. Ethical Practice
  5. Problem Solving

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About The Company

Persistent Systems is a global leader in technology services and software solutions, dedicated to helping organizations across various industries innovate and transform their business models. With a rich history of delivering cutting-edge digital solutions, Persistent Systems prides itself on fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning. The company emphasizes building long-term partnerships with clients by leveraging advanced technologies, industry expertise, and a customer-centric approach. Persistent Systems is committed to creating an inclusive work environment that values diversity, promotes professional growth, and encourages innovation at every level.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst specializing in healthcare data to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be instrumental in analyzing large-scale healthcare datasets, developing data models, and supporting data integration efforts to enhance our analytics capabilities. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including healthcare operations, finance, clinical, and compliance, to translate complex healthcare data into actionable insights. Your expertise will help optimize healthcare processes, improve reporting accuracy, and support strategic decision-making. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in SQL, healthcare data modeling, and analytics, with a passion for leveraging data to drive meaningful improvements in healthcare outcomes.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate should possess a bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, statistics, healthcare analytics, or a related field. A minimum of 7 years of hands-on experience working with US healthcare datasets, including benefits, claims, and eligibility data, is required. Proficiency in SQL for querying and analyzing healthcare data is essential. Familiarity with modern data warehousing platforms such as Snowflake and MySQL is highly desirable. Candidates should have experience in creating healthcare process and data flow documentation using tools like Microsoft Visio or equivalent. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data validation skills are crucial, along with excellent communication abilities to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams. A demonstrated ability to manage complex projects and deliver insights in a clear and concise manner is also important.

Responsibilities

As a Data Analyst in our healthcare division, your key responsibilities will include analyzing and reporting on large healthcare datasets, such as claims, provider information, utilization, and quality metrics. You will develop and optimize complex SQL queries to extract and validate data, ensuring accuracy and compliance with regulatory standards. Description

Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they want to buy online. Retail Business Services (RBS) accelerates Amazon's growth by improving customer and Selling Partner (SP) experiences, while optimizing costs across Stores WW. RBS operates at the intersection of retail, operations, technology, and finance, ensuring Amazon's systems and processes scale reliably while maintaining a high-quality customer and selling-partner experience.

Returns Reduction as part of Cost to Serve (CtS) BU is a specialized program within RBS focused on driving down overall Return Rate for both Retail and FBA channels. Returns Reduction Program focuses on Upstream defect elimination with focus on defect identification and defect elimination and partners with System Owners, Category Teams, FC ACES, Finance, CS, and abuse-related programs to uncover true drivers and remove them systematically. The team builds mechanisms that strengthen upstream defect visibility, and enable consistent governance and contributing directly to improved Free Cash Flow and scalable business growth.

This role will focus on identification and prioritization of high-impact defect opportunities and will own and define the roadmap for elimination of the problem space end to end. They will do this by building trusted partnerships with key stakeholders across technology, finance, operations and earning alignment to pursue defect elimination opportunities and influencing senior leaders through compelling, data-driven business cases. This role requires an individual who is comfortable in diving deep into complex data sets and presenting strategic recommendations to leadership up to three tiers above level. The candidate will bring strong business and supply chain acumen, a bias for action, and the strategic vision by directly contributing to improved cost to serve performance and driving scalable growth across Amazon Stores worldwide.

Product Design Engineer

Job Description:

Phillips-Medisize, India is seeking a Product Design Engineer to design and develop drug delivery medical devices, following the Phillips-Medisize Design Development Process (DDP) and applicable standards such as ISO 13485 & ISO 14971 with design controls.

Responsibilities:

  • Operate primary CAD systems such as SolidWorks or Creo
  • Identify and analyze design risks using tools such as tolerance stack-up analysis, FEA and design calculations.
  • Develop appropriate design risk mitigations and test strategies using dFMEA & pFMEA
  • Design, development, prototype and testing of concepts.
  • Develop assembly and test fixtures to aid in the manufacture and testing of the design.
  • Develop appropriate drawings to detail part and assembly specifications in a manner compliant with ASME Y14.5 & ISO 1101.
  • Generate Engineering Change records following change management process.
  • Ensure that design inputs and outputs are properly documented and controlled according to relevant SOP, WI process.
  • Development of test methods and plan for verification of mechanical design specifications.
  • Design/selection of materials for components used in drug delivery medical devices such as springs, elastomers, plastic parts, sheet metal components.
  • Selection of material for plastic, metal, elastomeric parts that interacts with the drug.

Required Qualifications:


  • BE/B. Tech in Mechanical Design or Mechanical Engineering or Mechatronics
  • 2-4 years of experience in the design and development of medical devices preferably drug delivery medical devices such as pen injectors, auto-injectors, wearable pumps etc.
  • Expertise in Plastic injection molding process and new product development.
  • Design for Manufacturability (DFM) experience focusing on plastic injection molding and plastic assembly methods (snaps, ultra-sonic welding, press fit, sealing, bonding, etc)
  • Familiarity with Design controls in compliance with 21 CFR 820.30.

Skills And Abilities –


  • Familiar with ISO 13485 and ISO 14971
  • Ability to generate complex solid & surface models.
  • Familiar with various plastic materials and their design limitations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to communicate design intent to a diverse audience.
  • Demonstrates strong ability to evaluate and recommend appropriate prototyping processes (i.e. SLA, printed, machined, molded)
  • Maintains and respects customer, project, and program confidentiality.
  • Motivated self-starter who is able to manage multiple tasks.

We offer you


  • A challenging position in an international innovative and successful company that is growing.
  • An opportunity to become part of a global team of dedicated and highly qualified colleagues based in Bangalore, India.
  • Well-structured training and continuous development of your competencies.

Phillips Medisize is an expert in the design, development and delivery of advanced drug delivery devices and connected health solutions. Our customers are leading pharmaceutical companies worldwide.   • Improve quality, cost, delivery, and capacity metrics for injection molded parts used in the Starlink products
  • Work on the development of new plastic injection tooling projects to meet a wide range of product performance and cosmetic requirements
  • Research and identify new materials, manufacturing technologies, and finish options
  • Review DFM from the supplier, including gating strategy, Moldflow, and Mold Warp analysis
  • Review and approve prototype/development tool designs, and tooling maintenance procedures
  • Direct tooling modifications while ultimately responsible for approving first article inspection (FAI) reports, and Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) reports
  • Collaborate with design, materials, and manufacturing engineers to gain an in-depth knowledge of injection molded part, assembly, metrology, and/or sub-system design intent
  • Support the procurement team to strategically source parts matched with supplier competencies by reviewing and assessing supplier manufacturing processes and quality systems
  • Create and define supplier technical and quality requirements based on customer and program requirements and expectations for NPI and production phases
  • Lead resolution of supplier quality issues through root cause analysis, while functioning as liaison between purchasing, engineering, production, and suppliers
  • Define product technical requirements, and ensure supplier compliance with these requirements
  • Analyze supplier quality and delivery metrics to identify trends and pinpoint systemic performance gaps and root causes to drive supplier improvement plans
  • Conduct independent research to identify potential new suppliers and capabilities in manufacturing and metrology for injection molded parts
  • Demonstrate a strong sense of ownership, proactivity, technical excellence, creativity, self-direction, and courage

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering
  • 5+ years of experience in one of the following: injection molding process development, direct hands-on injection mold design and/or injection mold construction, or Mold Master

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • Master's degree or PhD in mechanical engineering
  • 10+ years of experience in one of the following: injection molding process development, direct hands-on injection mold design and/or injection mold construction, or Mold Master
  • Knowledge of metrology tools and techniques for measuring and characterizing injection molded parts
  • Knowledge of statistical techniques and methods (design of experiments, Six Sigma, etc.). Experience with JMP plus.
  • Proficiency in Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GDT) principles and applications
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, time management, and organizational skills
  • Ability to act quickly in a fast-moving and high-stress environment.
  • Experience with statistical process control (SPC), Six Sigma certification, or Lean manufacturing principles applied
  • Proven track record of production ramp-up for high-volume electronics manufacturing, preferably in consumer electronics
  • Strong understanding of failure modes, defect analysis, and quality control methodologies (e.g., 8D, Fishbone, Pareto, PFMEA, DOE, SPC), with the ability to develop Product Quality Plans (PQP), implement FAI and Cp/Cpk reviews, and establish audit procedures tailored for high production volumes
  • Hands-on experience with failure analysis with prior experience in the consumer electronics industry, particularly with high volume hardware assembly, would be plus.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple suppliers and projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment

Additional Requirements

  • Position is based in Bangalore, India and requires being onsite - remote work not considered
  • Must be willing to work long hours and weekends when needed to meet critical deadlines
  • Ability to travel: Up to 50% of work week travel may be required to suppliers in Southeast Asia

The Manager delivers within the AI capability strategy set by the Senior Manager, owning a focused set of initiatives — the Senior Manager owns the broader portfolio and capability roadmap.

  • Expertise in data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or matplotlib/seaborn for effective communication of findings.
  • Solid understanding of production-grade delivery Git, SDLC, APIs, CI/CD, monitoring, versioning, testing, and model/prompt/data lifecycle controls.
  • Experience with cloud-native AI/data solutions on AWS and/or Azure; containerization and scalable deployment patterns preferred.
  • People Leadership & Team Culture
  • Demonstrated ability to coach, hire, manage performance, and build culture for a 3–10 person team.
  • Strong project-management and interpersonal skills, with the ability to lead diverse teams and influence cross-functionally.
  • Sound judgment in balancing hands-on technical work with team-leadership responsibilities.
  • Cross-Functional Influence & Senior-Leadership Impact
  • Strong verbal/written skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with and strategically impact senior leadership.
  • Ability to manage US stakeholders and provide clarity to the Hyderabad team across time zones.
  • Comfort operating in a matrixed, global environment with multiple functions and evolving priorities.
  • Creative Problem-Solving & Business Acumen
  • Strong creative problem-solving skills and business acumen, with the ability to identify key findings from disparate data sources and provide recommendations.
  • Ability to frame ambiguous business problems into solvable AI products.
  • Strong business translation — connecting technical output to user needs, adoption, and measurable outcomes.
  • Experience & Qualifications

  • Master's or Ph.D. in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Biostatistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, Operations Research, or another quantitative discipline, with 5+ years of experience; OR

  • GenAI depth hands-on experience with LLM-based systems, especially RAG, orchestration, evaluation, and production deployment.
  • Stakeholder experience partnering with US + India business, product, and engineering stakeholders in matrixed environments.

  • Expertise in big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark).

jobs.description:
Sports for Change initiative of HCLFoundation

HCLFoundation's flagship initiative, Sports for Change, recognizes the contribution of sports towards personal and social development. It works towards harnessing the positive transformative potential of sports by increasing access and participation in sport at the grassroots.

Sports for Change views sports as tool for progress and leverages the potential and capacity of sports to foster inclusion and bring people together. As part of this initiative, HCLFoundation empowers young leaders from disadvantaged communities by channelizing their energy towards play and sports. We identify, train, and nurture talent and excellence in sports while making opportunities for play and physical education accessible to children and youth from the urban slum communities. It is an approach based on the belief that play or sport is not just an end in itself but also an effective way to help achieve larger development goals.

Sports for Change started as a volunteer led movement wherein passionate HCLites devoted their time and skill towards identifying and honing sport talent from the urban slum communities with support from the HCLFoundation team. Over the years, we have been able to successfully train 75,000+ students in various sports such as football, volleyball, kabaddi, athletics, basketball, girls cricket, badminton, athletics, chess, etc. Students have represented and won accolades at the District, State and National Level Tournaments.

In 2016, HCLFoundation launched an Annual National Level Sporting Event under the banner of Sports for Change. Every year, children and youth who have been part of HCLFoundation supported projects from across India contest to participate at the national level event. Regional qualifiers are organized to identify the most promising sports talent who represent at the National Tournament. The best performing players at the National Tournament are also awarded Sports Scholarships which supports their academic training as well as sports training through provision of coaching, sports gear and membership to sports clubs and facilities along with a small nutrition grant to support a healthy diet for the athletes. These scholarships are sponsored entirely through the voluntary payroll contributions made by HCLites under the Power of One program.

So far, 15,000+ children and youth from various states of India have participated in the National Level Sports for Change Competition and 250+ Sports Scholarships have been awarded across various sporting categories to promote excellence in sports.

jobs.title: Newpage - Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

We are hiring QA Engineers to validate that AI products do what they're meant to doand don't do what they shouldn't.

AI outputs aren't deterministic; testing them isn't either.

You will design golden-question suites, hunt hallucinations, verify evidence citations, and confirm guardrails hold under combinatorial pressure.

You will build coverage that survives an LLM swap, a prompt change, or a new retrieval index.

You sit close to the engineers building the systems you test, and you raise the quality bar by asking questions the model itself can't answer.

You treat AI as the substrate of the products you validate, and you stay current on how these systems break.

What You'll Do

Plan And Design :

  • Build test plans for AI products across large combinatorial matrices : input variants, user roles, content states, deployment surfaces.
  • Maintain golden-question test suites that catch regressions when models, prompts, retrieval, or content change.
  • Design coverage for the things AI products specifically get wrong : hallucinations, citation drift, prompt injection, context bleed, guardrail bypass, role escalation, stale or unapproved content surfacing where it shouldn't.
  • Translate ambiguous quality requirements into concrete, repeatable test casesespecially where audit trails, access controls, and content provenance matter.

Execute & Design

  • Run structured test passes across web UIs and APIs; investigate failures deeply enough to give engineers a useful starting point, not just a screenshot.
  • Validate evidence citations point to the right sources and that pending review or restricted content stays excluded from AI responses where the rules require it.
  • Verify role-based access at the UI and API layersusers see what they should and nothing more.
  • Verify data integrity using read-only SQL queries; cross-check what the UI shows against what the database holds.
  • Exercise APIs directly via Postman, Insomnia, or curl; read OpenAPI specs and form requests without help.
  • File defects that are clear, reproducible, and rankedstructured enough that an engineer can act without a meeting.

Sustain Coverage

  • Maintain regression coverage as products evolve : prompts change, retrieval indexes update, models get swapped, content gets added.
  • Partner with engineers on evaluation rubrics, golden datasets, and acceptance criteria for AI behaviourthen verify the criteria actually hold in production.
  • Stay current on AI/LLM evaluation tooling and apply what's useful : golden datasets, regression rubrics, hallucination scoring, structured eval frameworks.
  • Maintain test documentation that survives team turnover : clear, structured, and findable.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years manual and automation QA experience in product environments, production-grade.
  • Hands-on experience testing AI / LLM-based products : output validation, hallucination detection, edge-case coverage, prompt injection awareness.
  • Strong test-planning skills for large combinatorial test matrices.
  • Hands-on with test management tooling : TestRail, Zephyr Scale, Xray, or equivalent.

Sales & Marketing Analytics — Healthcare & Life Sciences (HLS)

Location: Bangalore/Mumbai/Gurugram/Coimbatore_Hybrid (specify market or region as needed)

Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent

Practice: Healthcare & Life Sciences (HLS) Commercial Analytics

Level: Senior Consultant / Manager (8+ years experience)

About The Role

We're looking for a senior Commercial Analytics Consultant with a broad, hands-on grounding in pharma and HLS sales and marketing data — someone who has spent close to a decade using that data to solve real commercial problems and is ready to lead engagements, not just execute on them. You'll anchor our HLS analytics team's thinking across a wide spectrum of initiatives spanning marketing, commercial & sales, and customer/omnichannel analytics, bringing a consulting mindset and enough seniority to own client relationships end to end.

You'll lead work across areas like campaign and brand analytics, channel analytics, omnichannel engagement and next-best-action, and hyper-personalization — as well as the data management, dashboarding and reporting work that underpins all of it. You'll also help shape our own analytics products and IP, bringing life sciences context that makes them genuinely fit for the industry. Marketing mix modeling is part of that toolkit alongside these other methodologies, and you'll be equally comfortable framing a new problem with a client as you are directing the team that solves it.

What You'll Do

Marketing Analytics

  • Lead campaign performance analytics, content testing and product development analytics engagements for pharma brand teams.
  • Own brand & portfolio analytics and competitive insights work, from framing through to client-ready output.
  • Direct the application of marketing mix and optimization approaches — including MMM — as part of a broader measurement toolkit.

Commercial & Sales Analytics

  • Lead partner & channel analytics engagements across pharma commercial teams.
  • Own 4P (product, price, place, promotion) insights and broader commercial analytics initiatives.
  • Direct field force effectiveness and territory-level commercial analytics work.

Customer & Omnichannel Analytics

  • Lead omnichannel engagement and customer experience analytics across pharma commercial teams.
  • Own next-best-action, digital shelf and hyper-personalization use cases from scoping to delivery.
  • Guide patient safety / adverse event monitoring analytics where relevant.

Data Management, Visualization & Reporting

  • Partner with data engineering and platform teams to structure and integrate sales, marketing, digital and omnichannel data for analysis-ready use.
  • Set the standard for dashboards and reporting assets (e.g. Power BI or equivalent) that make commercial analytics outputs genuinely usable for brand and field teams.
  • Define reporting requirements and data structures for recurring commercial performance tracking as well as one-off analyses.
  • Own data quality, consistency and governance across the sales & marketing data feeding into analytics and reporting outputs.

Consulting & Client Leadership

  • Own client relationships and lead conversations end to end, translating open-ended business questions into scoped analytical approaches across the above spectrum.
  • Direct delivery teams — including marketing mix modeling, data engineering and visualization — bringing pharma commercial context to their work.
  • Shape pharma commercial context into proposal development and scoping for prospective clients, including new business conversations.
  • Bring life sciences and pharma context to the ongoing development of our own analytics products and IP, helping shape them to be genuinely fit for the industry's commercial use cases.
  • Mentor and guide cross-functional team members working across these engagements.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years in pharma/HLS commercial analytics, working directly with sales and marketing data — promotional spend, prescription/volume, digital and omnichannel engagement, and CRM/field activity.
  • A track record of solving a wide variety of commercial analytics problem statements, spanning areas such as campaign/brand analytics, channel analytics, or customer/omnichannel analytics.
  • Hands-on experience with data structuring, dashboarding and reporting (e.g. Power BI or equivalent tools), and a strong sense of what makes a dashboard genuinely usable for a commercial or brand audience.
  • A consulting mindset with the seniority to own new, loosely-defined problems and structure an analytical approach directly with the client.
  • Working exposure to marketing mix modeling or other media/channel measurement approaches.
  • Strong client-facing communication skills; comfortable owning senior stakeholder relationships and leading conversations independently.
  • Ability to translate fluently between business/brand stakeholders and technical delivery teams in both directions.
  • Experience mentoring or leading cross-functional team members within a project or engagement structure.

Nice To Have

  • Familiarity with synthetic control, test-and-learn or other causal measurement approaches.
  • Experience with data pipeline or automated data ingestion tools that feed into reporting and dashboarding layers.
  • Prior experience contributing to internal analytics products, accelerators or IP.
  • Prior consulting or client-services background, with experience scoping and delivering engagements from discovery through to results.

What We Offer

  • A senior, client-facing seat spanning the full spectrum of HLS commercial analytics, with real ownership over engagements.
  • A voice in shaping our analytics products and IP for the life sciences industry, alongside client delivery leadership.
  • Exposure to a wide portfolio of global pharma and life sciences clients and commercial data ecosystems.

  • A collaborative, flexible working model with a clear path into broader commercial analytics practice leadership.

jobs.title: Cyber Security Analyst II
jobs.description:
Company Introduction

Availity is one of the leading health information networks in the United States, processing more than 4 billion transactions annually and connecting more than two million healthcare providers and over two thousand technology partners to health plans nationwide. Our teams of technology, business, and customer service professionals in Bangalore, India, are working together to transform healthcare delivery in the United States through innovation and collaboration. Our technologists help develop cutting-edge revenue cycle solutions that help hospitals, health systems, and physicians maximize payments and optimize their workflows.

Availity is a diverse group of people whose talents, curiosity and passion steer the company to create innovative solutions for the US Healthcare industry. If you are a driven, creative and collaborative individual, with exceptional technology skills to drive innovation, we want to hear from you.

Job Description

Roles & Responsibilities

About Availity

Availity is a leading healthcare technology company focused on simplifying healthcare administration and solving real-world challenges for healthcare providers, health plans, and patients. Our technology helps reduce complexity so providers can spend less time navigating administrative systems and more time focused on patient care.

About Availity India

Availity India is an important part of Availity's global growth journey. Based in Bengaluru, our India teams partner closely with U.S. and global stakeholders across technology, product, operations, customer support, and corporate functions.

Our India organization is being built with a strong focus on ownership, learning, collaboration, engineering excellence, and meaningful business impact. Associates in India have the opportunity to solve complex problems, contribute to global initiatives, and support products and services that are part of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem.

About The Role

We are looking for a Cybersecurity Operations Analyst II to join our India team. In this role, you will be responsible for monitoring, analyzing, and responding to cybersecurity threats across Availity's enterprise environment while helping protect sensitive healthcare data and critical business systems. You will partner closely with cross-functional teams including Security Engineering, Incident Response, Infrastructure, and IT Operations to identify, investigate, and mitigate security risks while delivering high-quality outcomes aligned with Availity's security, business, and customer goals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor, investigate, and respond to security alerts and incidents generated by SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, and other security monitoring platforms.
  • Perform real-time analysis of suspicious host, network, and user activity to identify potential cybersecurity threats and security breaches.
  • Triage, prioritize, and coordinate remediation of security events in accordance with incident response procedures and service level objectives.
  • Conduct network, endpoint, firewall, proxy, IDS/IPS, and system log analysis to determine the scope, impact, and root cause of security incidents.
  • Research emerging cyber threats, attack techniques, vulnerabilities, and threat actor activities and provide actionable intelligence to strengthen the organization's security posture.
  • Contribute to threat hunting activities by proactively identifying indicators of compromise (IOCs), anomalous behavior, and potential security gaps.
  • Support end-to-end incident response activities, including detection, containment, eradication, recovery, documentation, and post-incident reviews.
  • Leverage the MITRE ATT&CK framework and threat intelligence sources to improve detection capabilities and investigation effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with Security Engineering, Infrastructure, Network, and IT Operations teams to mitigate risks and implement security improvements.
  • Participate in purple team exercises, tabletop simulations, and security assessments to evaluate and strengthen defensive controls.
  • Develop and maintain security documentation, operational procedures, investigation playbooks, and knowledge-sharing resources.
  • Generate and communicate operational metrics, security trends, and incident summaries to leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Assist with Active Directory, identity security, access control reviews, and user account investigations when required.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of SOC processes, automation initiatives, detection rules, and security monitoring capabilities.
  • Participate in a 24x7 security operations environment, including on-call or shift-based coverage as required.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technology field or equivalent in comparable work experience within the information security field.
  • Greater than 2-5 years experience in cybersecurity operations.
  • Experience with SIEM and SOAR platforms.
  • Experience with EDR/XDR platforms.
  • Strong understanding of network infrastructure devices such as firewalls, proxies, routers, switches,IDS/IPS.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity concepts such as authentication procedures, access controls, encryption, etc.
  • Good understanding of modern cyber threats.
  • Good understanding of Incident Response principles.
  • Good understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Certified in a reputable cybersecurity-related certification such as CompTia Security+, or equivalent or greater certification; total cybersecurity experience will be considered as a certification substitute.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience or exposure to network or host forensics.
  • Understanding of emerging threats and cyber threat hunting.
  • Experience in incident response actions, closing an incident from the initial detection to recovery actions.
  • Active Directory skills and experience.

Why Join Availity India

  • Meaningful impact: Work on solutions that help simplify healthcare administration and support better provider and patient experiences.
  • Global exposure: Partner with U.S. teams and leaders while contributing from India to global business priorities.
  • Learning and growth: Be part of a culture that values continuous learning, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and career development.
  • Flexible work experience: Work in a way that supports productivity, collaboration, and team needs across remote, hybrid, and office-based models.
  • Holistic rewards: Benefit from competitive compensation, health and insurance benefits, paid time off, company holidays, leave benefits, Employee Assistance Program support, and learning programs.
  • Inclusive workplace: Join a casual, collaborative, and inclusive environment where associates are encouraged to bring ideas forward.
  • Office experience: For office-based associates, Availity India provides amenities such as coffee and tea, subsidized meals, recreation areas, and eligible night-shift transportation support.

What To Expect From The Hiring Process

Our hiring process is designed to be transparent and engaging. Depending on the role, it may include application review, recruiter discussion, technical or functional assessment, hiring manager interviews, team or leadership conversations, offer discussion, background verification, and onboarding support.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Availity is committed to building an inclusive workplace where all associates feel valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and encourage individuals who are excited by collaboration, innovation, and meaningful impact to apply.

Eligibility

Video Camera Usage

Availity fosters a collaborative and open culture where communication and engagement are central to our success. As a remote first company, we are also camera-first and provide all associates with camera/video capability to simulate the office environment. If you are not able to use your camera for all virtual meetings, you should not apply for this role.

Having cameras on helps create a more connected, interactive, and productive environment, allowing teams to communicate more effectively and build stronger working relationships. The usage of cameras also enhances security and protects sensitive company information. Video participation is required to ensure that only authorized personnel are present in meetings and to prevent unauthorized access, data breaches, preventing social engineering, or the sharing of confidential information with non-participants.

jobs.description:
About This Role

Business Overview

Portfolio Management Group (PMG) Tech is the horizontal technology platform within BlackRock's Portfolio Management Group (PMG), integrating portfolio management, risk management, and quantitative workflows with advanced engineering, AI, and data capabilities to make technology a strategic driver of investment and risk outcomes.

Risk & Quantitative Analysis (RQA) provides independent oversight of BlackRock's investment and enterprise risks through quantitative analysis, risk expertise, and evidence-based insights. In partnership with PMG Tech, RQA leverages advanced engineering, AI, and data platforms to strengthen risk management capabilities, enhance decision-making, and scale innovative solutions across investment, operational, technology, and enterprise risk domains.

Job Purpose / Background

The Research Engineer partners with Risk & Quantitative Analysis (RQA), PMG Tech, and business stakeholders to build data workflows, analytics solutions, and AI-assisted capabilities that transform risk and quantitative challenges into actionable insights. Embedded within PMG Tech Pods—business-focused cross-functional teams—you will collaborate with risk managers, quantitative analysts, AI Leads, and engineers to deliver high-quality data assets, analytical tools, and technology solutions that support risk management and decision-making.

This role requires a strong understanding of business problems and risk workflows, with the ability to translate requirements into scalable data solutions. You will leverage Python, SQL, workflow orchestration, cloud data platforms (BigQuery, Snowflake, GCS), and visualization tools such as Tableau and Power BI to build and operate data-intensive applications. The role also requires experience with data quality, CI/CD pipelines, and data operations to ensure reliable, production-grade solutions that meet business needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain web harvesting and data pipelines, transformations, and workflows to support research hypotheses and data analyses.
  • Develop new platform capabilities to source high-quality data and create scalable and maintainable data solutions.
  • Develop research utilities, prototypes, dashboards, or exploratory tools as needed by the pod for insight generation or research workflows.
  • Engage with investors and researchers to understand research workflows and translate requirements into data solutions.
  • Collaborate with core engineering teams to adopt data extraction and management tools and technologies to accelerate investor research.
  • Collaborate with AI leads to source data and build AI applications to supplement investor research with AI-assisted solutions.

Skills & Experience

  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Knowledge/curiosity about investment research workflows or similar domains.
  • Prior experience in data engineering or data analytics, or data intensive applications.
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively across engineering and business teams.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years hands-on experience in Data Engineering/Analytics
  • B.S. / M.S. college degree in Computer Science, Data Science/Engineering, or related subject area.

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience web harvesting tools and techniques (Scrapy)
  • Experience with cloud data tools (Snowflake, BigQuery, GCP).
  • Exposure to AI/ML tooling, LLM experimentation, or AI applications such as RAG, Summarization and Q&A (Open AI, Vertex, Anthropic).
  • Experience creating dashboards, notebooks, or lightweight research tools (Streamlit, Flask, Tableau, Power BI).
  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration or automation tools (Kubernetes/Airflow).

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock's hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we've provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children's educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It's why we're dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

jobs.title: Instructional Designer
jobs.description:
The Instructional Designer is a practitioner who independently designs and develops high-quality learning solutions. You bring strong command of instructional design methodology, content development, and technical execution, producing learning materials that meet rigorous quality standards.

This role sits above the Instructional Designer on the career ladder. You work with greater autonomy on more complex briefs, apply AI-assisted workflows, and bring emerging awareness of quality, consulting, and ecosystem topics. The Sr. ID is a critical execution anchor on project teams and a deliberate stepping stone toward the Learning Experience Architect path.

What You'll Do Daily

No two days look the same. On any given day you might be:

  • Designing a learning solution from a brief: choosing the right structure, writing learning objectives, and making the key decisions on modality and interaction pattern
  • Building out a storyboard in Storyline or Rise, writing the scenario branches, and making sure the interactions actually test what they are supposed to test
  • Working through SME feedback on a module you drafted, deciding what to take, what to push back on, and updating the content accordingly
  • Running a QA pass on your own work or a colleague's, checking for accuracy, accessibility, and whether the design holds up pedagogically
  • Applying AI tools to speed up a content drafting task or generate variation options for a scenario
  • Sitting in on a needs analysis conversation with a senior team member, taking notes, and starting to recognise which parts of the brief are driving the design

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Instructional Design, Education, Communication, or related field

Experience

2–7 years in instructional design and learning development

Instructional Design

Proficient in applying instructional design frameworks (ADDIE, Bloom's Taxonomy, contemporary adult learning principles) to design effective solutions; independently conducts needs analysis, defines measurable objectives, and ensures pedagogical soundness across a range of project types

Content Development & Storyboarding

Proficient in creating compelling storyboards and learning content that translate complex information into digestible materials; independently produces content with appropriate examples, narrative flow, and cultural adaptability

Authoring Tools & Development

Proficient in building functional eLearning modules using Articulate Storyline or Rise, including interactivity, branching scenarios, and SCORM compliance; working knowledge of LMS platforms; proficient with business tools such as SharePoint, Word / PowerPoint / Excel / Outlook / Teams

Visual Design & Multimedia

Proficient in creating professional visual assets and multimedia elements that enhance learning; independently applies design principles (color theory, typography, layout) to ensure visual consistency, accessibility (WCAG compliance), and brand alignment

Learning Experience Design

Working knowledge of user-centered learning experience design; can apply emotional appeal, learner motivation, and experience-layer thinking with guidance from architects; developing toward independent application

Quality Assurance & Standards

Working knowledge of quality assurance practices; applies established QA frameworks with guidance to ensure learning products meet standards for accuracy, functionality, and pedagogical effectiveness

AI & Emerging Technology

Proficient in leveraging AI-powered tools and emerging technologies to accelerate learning design, enhance quality, and drive innovation; independently applies AI-assisted workflows across the design and development lifecycle

Communication

Strong written and verbal communication skills; collaborates effectively with SMEs, stakeholders, and team members

Why Infopro Learning

Innovation & Impact

Work on award-winning projects creating impactful learning experiences for global Fortune 500 companies.

Growth & Development

Develop expertise through challenging projects, mentorship from senior architects, and access to cutting-edge technologies. The Sr. ID role is a deliberate stepping stone toward the Learning Experience Architect path.

Culture & Balance

Join a collaborative team that values creativity and work-life balance. Enjoy competitive compensation and recognition for your contributions.

Job requirements

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Awareness of performance consulting principles and when learning interventions are or are not the right solution
  • Familiarity with learning ecosystem architecture and curriculum mapping concepts
  • Basic familiarity with learning analytics platforms and interpreting engagement or completion data
  • Experience with business simulations, scenario-based learning, or immersive learning technologies (VR/AR)
  • Awareness of change management or adoption strategies in learning contexts
  • Advanced certifications in instructional design, UX design, or learning technologies

jobs.title: NOC Engineer - Cloud
jobs.description:
Company Introduction

Availity is one of the leading health information networks in the United States, processing more than 4 billion transactions annually and connecting more than two million healthcare providers and over two thousand technology partners to health plans nationwide. Our teams of technology, business, and customer service professionals in Bangalore, India, are working together to transform healthcare delivery in the United States through innovation and collaboration. Availity is a diverse group of people whose talents, curiosity and passion steer the company to create innovative solutions for the US Healthcare industry. If you are a driven, creative and collaborative individual, with exceptional technology skills to drive innovation, we want to hear from you.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced NOC Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to support 24x7 operations, cloud infrastructure monitoring, incident response, cloud networking, and operational excellence initiatives. This role is responsible for ensuring the availability, performance, and reliability of cloud platforms through proactive monitoring, incident management, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement activities.

The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in AWS and Azure cloud operations, cloud networking, observability platforms, infrastructure support, and incident management within a high-availability production environment.

Roles & Responsibilities

About Availity

Availity is a leading healthcare technology company focused on simplifying healthcare administration and solving real-world challenges for healthcare providers, health plans, and patients. Our technology helps reduce complexity, so providers can spend less time navigating administrative systems and more time focused on patient care.

About Availity India

Availity India is an important part of Availity's global growth journey. Based in Bengaluru, our India team's partner closely with U.S. and global stakeholders across technology, product, operations, customer support, and corporate functions.

Our India organization is being built with a strong focus on ownership, learning, collaboration, engineering excellence, and meaningful business impact. Associates in India have the opportunity to solve complex problems, contribute to global initiatives, and support products and services that are part of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced NOC Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to support 24x7 operations, cloud infrastructure monitoring, incident response, cloud networking, and operational excellence initiatives. This role is responsible for ensuring the availability, performance, and reliability of cloud platforms through proactive monitoring, incident management, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement activities.

The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in AWS and Azure cloud operations, cloud networking, observability platforms, infrastructure support, and incident management within a high-availability production environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor and support cloud infrastructure across compute, storage, networking, and platform services.
  • Respond to alerts and incidents following NOC SOPs, escalation procedures, and operational runbooks.
  • Perform incident triage and troubleshooting for cloud and infrastructure-related incidents (P1-P4).
  • Troubleshoot connectivity, routing, DNS, load balancing, and cloud networking issues across AWS and Azure environments.
  • Support Major Incident Management (MIM) activities, bridge calls, escalation management, and service restoration efforts.
  • Manage AWS operational services including EC2, VPC, Route 53, Security Groups, Load Balancers, CloudWatch, and cloud networking services.
  • Support Azure infrastructure including Virtual Networks, NSGs, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Load Balancers, and platform services.
  • Monitor cloud environments using Splunk, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus, and enterprise monitoring platforms.
  • Maintain accurate incident documentation, operational timelines, and stakeholder communications within ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms.
  • Support Linux and Windows server operations within cloud environments.
  • Assist with Kubernetes (EKS) operational support, workload monitoring, and platform health checks.
  • Support infrastructure automation, operational improvements, and repeatable processes using Terraform, PowerShell, Bash, and Python where applicable.
  • Participate in RCA reviews, Problem Management, and continuous service improvement initiatives.
  • Improve monitoring effectiveness through alert tuning, dashboard optimization, and observability enhancements.
  • Collaborate with Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, and Operations teams to ensure service reliability and operational excellence.
  • Ensure smooth shift handovers and support global follow-the-sun operational models.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in NOC, Cloud Infrastructure, Cloud Operations, Network Operations, SRE, or Infrastructure Support roles.
  • Strong hands-on operational experience supporting AWS and/or Azure cloud environments.
  • Experience supporting cloud networking technologies including VPCs, VNets, subnets, routing tables, load balancers, DNS, VPNs, and security controls.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud infrastructure monitoring and incident management processes.
  • Hands-on experience with Splunk, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus, or equivalent monitoring platforms.
  • Experience handling incidents, escalations, and service restoration in 24x7 operational environments.
  • Linux and Windows server administration and troubleshooting experience.
  • Understanding cloud storage, backup, recovery, and high-availability concepts.
  • Working knowledge of AWS RDS, Aurora, Azure SQL, or other cloud database services from an operational support perspective.
  • Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, or equivalent ITSM platforms.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience working within rotational shifts and global support models.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Kubernetes (EKS) environments and containerised workloads.
  • Working knowledge of Terraform and Infrastructure as Code concepts.
  • Experience with scripting and automation using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar technologies.
  • Knowledge of cloud security monitoring, IAM, vulnerability management, and operational security best practices.
  • Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, New Relic, AppDynamics, or Site24x7.
  • Understanding SRE practices, observability frameworks, and reliability engineering concepts.
  • Experience in Healthcare Technology environments.
  • HIPAA awareness and compliance knowledge.
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate or AWS Certified Advanced Networking Specialty.
  • Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate or Azure Network Engineer Associate.
  • CCNA or equivalent networking certification.
  • ITIL Foundation Certification.

Why Join Availity India

  • Meaningful impact: Work on solutions that help simplify healthcare administration and support better provider and patient experiences.
  • Global exposure: Partner with U.S. teams and leaders while contributing from India to global business priorities.
  • Learning and growth: Be part of a culture that values continuous learning, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and career development.
  • Flexible work experience: Work in a way that supports productivity, collaboration, and team needs across remote, hybrid, and office-based models.
  • Holistic rewards: Benefit from competitive compensation, health and insurance benefits, paid time off, company holidays, leave benefits, Employee Assistance Program support, and learning programs.
  • Inclusive workplace: Join a casual, collaborative, and inclusive environment where associates are encouraged to bring ideas forward.
  • Office experience: For office-based associates, Availity India provides amenities such as coffee and tea, subsidized meals, recreation areas, and eligible night-shift transportation support.

What To Expect From The Hiring Process

Our hiring process is designed to be transparent and engaging. Depending on the role, it may include application review, recruiter discussion, technical or functional assessment, hiring manager interviews, team or leadership conversations, offer discussion, background verification, and onboarding support.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Availity is committed to building an inclusive workplace where all associates feel valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and encourage individuals who are excited by collaboration, innovation, and meaningful impact to apply.

Eligibility

Video Camera Usage

Availity fosters a collaborative and open culture where communication and engagement are central to our success. As a remote first company, we are also camera-first and provide all associates with camera/video capability to simulate the office environment. If you are not able to use your camera for all virtual meetings, you should not apply for this role.

Having cameras on helps create a more connected, interactive, and productive environment, allowing teams to communicate more effectively and build stronger working relationships. The usage of cameras also enhances security and protects sensitive company information. Video participation is required to ensure that only authorized personnel are present in meetings and to prevent unauthorized access, data breaches, preventing social engineering, or the sharing of confidential information with non-participants.
