jobs.description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

jobs.title: Design Engineer - Mechanical
jobs.description:
Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop mechanical components for PEM Electrolyzer stacks, including bipolar/end plates, gaskets and seals, current collectors, tie-rod/tension assemblies, and manifolding, using SolidWorks or equivalent CAD tools.
  • Create and maintain detailed part and assembly drawings with GD&T, tolerance dimensioning, and third-angle projection per ASME standards.
  • Perform engineering analysis such as tolerance stack-up, structural/stiffness calculations for endplates, sealing calculations for gaskets, flow field analysis like pressure drop calculations for Bipolar Plates, and material compatibility assessments
  • Lead or contribute to DFMEA studies for design changes (e.g., materials, coatings, surface finishes), identifying failure modes, causes, and effects, and defining mitigations.
  • Develop and validate stack assembly processes, including uniform torquing/compression strategies, torque sequencing, and pressure distribution verification
  • Author and maintain detailed component specifications for stack mechanical components (bipolar/end plates, gaskets/seals, current collectors, tie-rods), including dimensional, material, and performance requirements.
  • Collaborate with supply chain and quality teams to validate that specifications are achievable at the intended production volume, and refine specs based on DFM/DFA feedback.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing and quality teams to define assembly work instructions, inspection & acceptance criteria, and fixture/tooling requirements.
  • Support root-cause investigations for field & test failures and translate findings into design improvements.
  • Prepare and maintain engineering documentation: design reports, drawings, BOMs, ECNs, and DFMEA records.
  • Work closely with R&D, test engineering, and supply chain to bring new designs from concept through pilot to production scale.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or a related discipline (master's degree a plus).
  • 3-5 years of hands-on experience mechanical design, product development & engineering execution across product lifecycle ideally in Electrolyzers, fuel cells, batteries, pressure vessels, heat exchangers, or other precision electromechanical assemblies.
  • Strong proficiency in 3D CAD (SolidWorks preferred) and 2D drawing creation for Sheetmetals & Machined components with proper GD&T and tolerancing practices.
  • Practical experience with DFMEA methodology and root-cause/failure analysis (e.g., 8D).
  • Hands on experience with sheetmetal, plastic part & machined component design, and manufacturing processes such as Injection moulding, casting, machining, and fabrication.
  • Ability to develop mechanical designs, perform engineering calculations, create technical drawings, and execute design verification activities.
  • Strong communication & problem-solving skills, with experience producing clear engineering documentation.

We are looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer to join our Electrolyzer stack engineering team. In this role, you will own mechanical design and analysis for PEM Electrolyzer stack components and assemblies — from concept and CAD through tolerance stack-up, DFMEA, and design validation. You will work cross-functionally with materials, manufacturing, quality, and testing teams to bring reliable, manufacturable stack designs from prototype to production.

  • Actively involve in reviewing materials developed by scientific writers to ensure strategic alignment and scientific accuracy as needed and provide clear constructive feedback, support, and supervision to writers. Mentor and train scientific writers by sharing best practices and client preferences, thereby contributing to skill development within the team.
  • Perform as a document specialist, provide intellectual input across document types, and contribute to making cutting-edge research accessible to specific audiences as appropriate, by maintaining current awareness of developments across therapeutic areas or disciplines.
  • Liaise and build trusting and professional relationships with international pharmaceutical clients, healthcare professionals, internal and external stakeholders, including authors, reviewers, and key opinion leaders across therapeutic areas - learning to anticipate their needs.
  • Effectively and proactively communicate with team members, authors/faculty, clients, and vendors.
  • Attend workshops/seminars/trainings to hone your skills and contribute to organizational objectives.
  • Attend client and other external meetings and support senior team members as needed.
  • Apply your scientific and creative knowledge and work closely with client directors in developing ideas and executing effective medical communications initiatives in the digital space, including publication extenders, creation of infographics, interactive assets, website content, patient narratives, and medical information engagement plans.
  • Ensure all materials follow/comply with client requirements/SOPs, style guides, client templates, client preferences (as applicable), and CACTUS internal SOPs. Any updates to either of these items should be made consistently and documents should remain up to date.
  • Share best practices and client preferences, thereby contributing to skill development within the medical communications team.

Qualifications And Prerequisites

  • 5+ years of experience in medical communications or publications within a pharma company or medical communications agency.
  • PhD/MD (Pharmacology) OR PhD (Life Sciences) OR PharmD with a good understanding of clinical research and medical communication.
  • Clear, concise, scientific style of writing, with a high level of attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Ability to adapt writing style to suit different materials and target audiences.
  • Literature reviewing and evaluation capabilities.
  • Very good working knowledge of MS Office and basic knowledge of biostatistics.
  • Shows an eagerness to learn and apply AI tools and technologies.

Application Process

Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process includes two Technical Interviews with the Hiring Manager and peers, and a Technical Assessment, where candidates will have agreed upon timeline to complete the task. The final round will be the HR Interview. All interactions will be conducted virtually via MS Teams.

AI at Cactus Life Sciences

The life sciences industry is undergoing a fundamental shift in how scientific knowledge is created, communicated, and delivered. We are building our work around it.

AI is embedded meaningfully across everything we do, through proprietary platforms purpose-built for life sciences and generative tools that deliver measurable value to our clients. It is core to how we operate, and an expected way of working for everyone who joins us.

We believe in Human-Anchored AI™: whatever your discipline - science, communications, strategy, or operations, you will work in an environment where AI augments your expertise rather than replaces it.

You will build skills that are in genuine demand and still taking shape across the industry. If you are curious and focused on building capabilities for the world where human intelligence meets artificial intelligence, this is where you belong.

Equal Opportunity

Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

About CACTUS

At Cactus Life Sciences (cactuslifesciences.com), we believe the future of medical communications lies at the intersection of science, technology, and human connection. Headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, with teams in Switzerland, the United Kingdom, India, and Japan, we help biopharmaceutical organizations redefine scientific exchange—leveraging AI, automation, and innovation while keeping patients at the heart of everything we do.

Our expertise spans medical strategy, scientific content development, and medical education across therapeutic areas and the product lifecycle. By blending scientific rigor, agile operational models, and future-ready technologies, we partner with medical affairs teams to catalyze their transformation, adapt to a changing landscape, and drive meaningful outcomes for healthcare communities worldwide.

jobs.title: Global Senior Environmental Data Manager
jobs.description:
We are Reckitt

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.

Supply

Our communications and external affairs team are at the very heart of Reckitt's brand, purpose and products, bringing them to life around the globe for our employees, consumers, investors, governments and our suppliers. It's a rewarding task, growing and protecting Reckitt's image and brand. Every day, we design public relations and communication strategies that build awareness, trust and relationships, while steering us away from reputational risk. We do this by gathering and maintaining knowledge of our policies, principles, and business strategies, while keeping up-to-date with relevant developments right across our business units and trusted brands. From digital, media and events to employee experience, strategic relationships, and community partners, we identify opportunities to deliver on our business and sustainability agenda, while proactively identifying storylines and opportunities to advance our narrative.

About the role

The role oversees the systems-development, data-analysis, and reporting of global, regional & site-based energy, waste, water metrics and other environmental key performance indicators (KPI's) that measure our progress toward publicly declared targets. This includes:

. Planning and project management - Above all the role requires strong data analytics, project and time-management leadership. It involves responding to dynamic data enquiries from Reckitt's senior leadership tier, overseeing the delivery of monthly & quarterly reports, as well as supporting our annual report published in Q2 each year, and its associated data assurance by leading external accreditors. In addition to this, the Env reporting team supports and polices sites data entries into our systems, aids their training on the same, and fields sites data enquiries.
. Data systems management and analysis - The Global Environment Data Manager will support the Global Head of Environment as the team-lead on the interpretation and summarising of site, BU and regional environmental performance reporting, forecasting and insights, in conjunction with the regional environmental managers. Leading all Reckitt's environmental data, the role requires robust environmental data collection, reporting and analytical skills, together with proficiency in Sustainability data management software. Preference will be given to Enablon specialists.

. Sustainability & EHS Network development - Effective and timely communication is key within Reckitt together with developing robust networks, building relationships, (often virtually), to provide on-going site support to enhance understand and drive performance opportunities.

. Presentation skills - Data enquiries are part of the daily routine and come our leadership teams across our Global Business Units. A key role is therefore presenting environmental performance of our sites to a range of stakeholders across the business, often at senior vice-president level and upwards. This will involve utilizing and developing data communications software such as Power BI.

. Training - From time to time, both the role and their subordinates may also be required to provide training to engineers and EHS professionals across our sites in Enablon, Glidepath Tool either in person, or via e-learning and webinar.

. (Reporting) Stakeholder liaison - This role will require leading the analyst on supporting liaison with key regional stakeholders, in the financial, SRI, NGO and reporting best practice communities, to bring reporting intelligence back into the environment leadership team.

. General sustainability support - this role will largely concentrate on the elements above, but another responsibility within this position in support to the wider Global Environment Team. This offers the opportunity of exposure to other aspects of corporate responsibility - everything from regulatory tracking and preparedness, audit support and strategy-setting, to specific events and awareness initiatives.

Your responsibilities

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES (Major end results the role will achieve)

Planning & Project Management

. Good organisational and planning skills are essential. Support the collection of all Reckitt's environmental data via various internal management systems.
. Plan and schedule monthly and quarterly reporting to the senior leadership
. Support the provision of regular monthly/quarterly updates to regional and global management on sites environmental performance status related to all long-term performance targets detailed in our reports
. Support the Global Head of Environment in devising & implementing new environmental targets and programmes to drive continual improvement in Reckitt operational environmental performance.


Reporting, Presentation & Communication skills

. Lead and conduct internal data assurance and manage the external assurance process for environmental data included in the Reckitt annual report including clarification/ review of the findings (in line with external reporting requirements including GRI, GHG Protocol, SASB, CDP & DJSI)
. Under the oversight of the Global Head of Environment, lead in the provision of regular monthly and quarterly reports and updates to the sustainability network and Senior Leadership teams on environmental compliance and performance status
. Developing clear, professional presentation-ware for information provision across Reckitt. Strong familiarity with PowerPoint and equivalent
. Delivering presentations to everyone from site-colleagues to executive level. Provide insights and performance to Reckitt senior leadership to help drive improvements
. Support new starters and newly acquired sites aligning with Reckitt's environmental information systems and reporting framework.
. Support to comm's colleagues on sustainability performance, (e.g. via articles and social media messaging).

Data Systems and Analysis Skills

. You will be the Reckitt lead across our key data management & comm's tools. These include our licensed Enablon system. Our bespoke Glidepath Tool tracking future projections, and Power BI, Rubi and other reporting platforms. Leadership includes coordination with our regional environmental leads and direct site interactions, provide environmental insights and performance to Reckitt senior leadership to help drive improvements, and collaboration with the Global Head of Environment on direction of the above.
. You'll have a proven track-record on data management and interpretation over a 5+ year period, including, conducting data analysis and forecasting, and work with key people to drive change, and overseeing a wider data management team. Ideally in an area of sustainability, but this is NOT essential. Experienced data analytics leadership is.
. Develop techniques to allow retrospective comparisons of historically diverging performance data sets base on previous denominators (e.g. consumer units v's tonnages)
. Familiar with databases & data management software(s) - Enablon, Power BI, Excel, SAP, etc.

Support to Other Teams
. A maximum of 5% of the time will be spent supporting colleagues in the Human Rights, Environment and H&S team on Enablon support, including systems change control, campaign launches, dashboard development etc, Enablon 3rd party support and ad hoc training.

The experience we're looking for

KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERIENCE (Knowledge and experience needed for satisfactory performance of the job)

. Relevant degree or postgraduate qualification in the accounting/data analytics arena.
. Strong project leadership experience with proven analytical abilities and attention to detail
. Knowledge of data-reporting software solutions (Enablon, SAP, Ariba, Intertek, Excel etc).
. Environmental experience on the following is an advantage, but not essential: GRI, SASB & CDP reporting, GHG Protocol Scope 1 and Scope 2 accounting. Plus, familiarity with the wider external reporting landscape (e.g. FTSE, DJSI, integrated reporting, TCFD implementation, SGDs etc).
. Understanding of the FMCG or Healthcare sector is preferred, although again not essential.
. Excellent writing and communication skills.


PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

We are not your average nine-to-five. Environment at Reckitt is as demanding as it is rewarding. We're on a journey to leadership. So, we're really looking for a self-starter - someone who likes to roll their sleeves up & take ownership, who's persuasive to colleagues, and who can motivate and inspire her/his team from the outset. Your natural organisational skills are essential, as are thriving under pressure without losing sight of the big picture, and who's attentive to detail. A people person, you should be someone who's passionate about the power of corporate good to see a more sustainable society. The winning candidate will possess the ability to collaborate, motivate and work effectively with employees across all levels of Reckitt, a data storyteller who can inspire a positive culture of business social purpose.
j
. Be persistent and undeterred on encountering obstacles and tracking work through to completion.
. Have clear and concise communications skills, both written and verbal, requiring a good level of English language, with the ability to adapt communications to various audiences.
. Ability to build and maintain knowledge across Reckitt.
. Be willing to travel

The skills for success

Strategic Thinking, Environmental Knowledge, Stakeholder Engagement, Regulatory Compliance, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Reporting and Communication, Environmental Management Systems, Auditing, Risk Management, Sustainable Sourcing, Training and Education, Life Cycle Assessment, Regulatory Knowledge, Human Rights, Due Diligence, International Standards, Stakeholder Collaboration, Training and Capacity Building, Incident Response, Policy Development, Legal Understanding.

What we offer

With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.

Equality

We recognise that in real life, great people don't always tick all the boxes. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin religion, faith pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities sexual orientation sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity protected veteran status size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Research Integrity Screening Specialist

Location: Pune

Reports to: Team Lead, Research Integrity Screening

About Springer Nature

Springer Nature is one of the leading publishers of research in the world. We publish the largest number of journals and books and are pioneers in open research. Through our leading brands, trusted for more than 180 years, we provide technology-enabled products, platforms and services that help researchers to uncover new ideas and share their discoveries, health professionals to stay at the forefront of medical science, and educators to advance learning. We are proud to be part of progress, working together with the communities we serve to share knowledge and bring greater understanding to the world. For more information, please visit about.springernature.com and follow @SpringerNature.

At Springer Nature, we recognise that great talent develops through many different paths. We encourage applications from individuals with strong transferable skills, provided they are supported by relevant experience that shows how those skills have been successfully applied in practice. Our hiring approach balances skills, experience, and potential to ensure each role is fulfilled with both short term effectiveness and long-term growth in mind. 

About The Brand

Springer Nature's Editorial Excellence team is a central expert team that supports Springer Nature with research integrity, journal editorial policy, and indexing. Within the Editorial Excellence team, the research integrity teams prevent and address concerns about research integrity and other breaches of publication ethics. The Editorial Excellence team ensures editorial and publishing best practice by producing training and self-help guides for in-house staff and external editorial partners; contributes to system and workflow development; audits processes and technologies; provides clear and defensible action plans for complicated cases; leads journals editorial policy; and manages abstracting and indexing.    

About The Role

The Research Integrity Screening Specialist plays a critical role in the pre-publication screening of submissions to resolve all identified integrity concerns. This role must blend a keen eye for detail, resourcefulness in fact-checking, and clear communication skills with our internal and external publication partners.

Roles Responsibilities

  • Analyze concerns in submissions flagged by Springer Nature's research integrity technology solution, Screening Hub, applying critical scientific evaluation, manuscript assessment strategies, and strong decision quality to validate concerns, identify false positives, and ensure accurate outcomes to validate flags or remove false positives.
  • Conduct detailed manuscript assessments to evaluate flagged cases and decide, according to internal best practices and ensuring decision quality, which concerns can be remediated by the authors before reconsideration, which are false positives indicating that the submission is clear to proceed to next steps, and which are true positives to be actioned for withdrawal or rejection.
  • Review re-submissions where concerns have been remediated by authors to ensure compliance with requested changes.
  • Manage complexity inherent in this evaluation and decision process, and take an approach that is action-oriented.
  • Partner with internal team members and external service providers to assess and address integrity of issues that are flagged and remediation of submissions, demonstrating accountability.
  • Communicate concerns, where necessary and determined by protocols and SOPs, to Editors, Publishers, and authors for due consideration, according to relevant Springer Nature policies, COPE guidelines, and industry best practice.
  • Become an expert in the use of technologies and tools in order to provide insights into potential unethical behaviors and provide feedback regarding potential new features or improvements to publishing workflows & systems.
  • Develop and maintain a strong understanding of the evolving publication ethics landscape, identifying new types of issues, and contributing to policy development and improving workflows to address emergent needs.
  • Document case files, project plans, and statistics with detail and may use data analytics / quantitative skills to contribute insights to regular reporting.
  • With the assistance of the Team Lead, Research Integrity Screening, manage your workload to meet targets, rapidly reprioritizing as urgent issues arise.
  • Contribute, when requested by your manager, to other tasks and projects related to ensuring compliance with ethical policies/guidelines (e.g. policy and technology development, contributing to research projects, auditing journals).
  • Proactively contribute to meetings and commit to completing actions assigned to you, demonstrating accountability, ownership, and commitment to team objectives.
  • Drive your professional development by seeking training opportunities.
  • Be an advocate for continuous improvement, quality and efficiency. Foster a culture of openness, transparency and collaboration within the team and with our stakeholders.

Essential

Experience, skills and qualifications

  • Educated to Masters level in STEM or HSS
  • 2+ years of work experience in editorial or publishing. 
  • Knowledge/experience of the academic publishing industry, and scholarly publication processes, systems and tools; and specifically in submission screening and/or evaluation.
  • Familiarity with publication ethics and research integrity issues, and a passion for quality control. 
  • Ability to establish effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders of any background, seniority, or level of experience. A
  • A high level of computer literacy including knowledge of and experience with Office applications. 
  • Excellent organizational, prioritization, analytical and time-management skills, with superior attention to detail. 
  • Positive and proactive approach to problem-solving and task management. 
  • Strong communication (written and oral) and English language skills. 

Desirable

  • Ability to work well under pressure. 

At Springer Nature, our mission is to be part of progress – and that begins with inclusion: of people, perspectives, and ideas. We believe that diverse perspectives drive progress, and we are committed to creating an environment where people and ideas can flourish. If you have any access needs related to disability, neurodivergence or a chronic condition, please contact us so we can make all necessary accommodation. Find out more about our DEI work here https://group.springernature.com/gp/group/taking-responsibility/diversity-equity-inclusion

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Background of The Hans Foundation

The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.

Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not-for-profit organisations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.

The Hans Wellness Centre Project

Hans Wellness Centre project, initiated by The Hans Foundation, aims to improve the physical, mental, and social well-being of school-age children, which can help them lead a healthy life with dignity. Partnering with schools with a greater number of children from the economic weaker section group, this project aims to provide primary healthcare by pairing the interventions of diagnosis, treatment, counselling and prevention related to the children's physical and mental health concerns with the support of qualified teams.

Job Purpose

The Project Manager will be responsible for the overall planning, implementation, management, monitoring, budget management and successful delivery of the Hans Wellness Centre (HWC) project. The role will ensure effective service delivery, team management, resource utilisation, stakeholder coordination, compliance and achievement of project objectives within approved timelines and budgets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Overall Project Management
    • Lead end-to-end implementation of the HWC project across all assigned locations of Delhi NCR.
    • Develop project plans, timelines, milestones and implementation strategies.
    • Monitor project progress against approved objectives, deliverables and timelines.
    • Identify operational challenges and ensure timely corrective actions.
    • Ensure smooth coordination between programme and support functions.
    • Monitor availability and proper management of medicines, consumables, medical equipment and other all required resources.
    • Conduct regular field visits and assess centre performance and service quality.
  • Team Management
    • Lead, supervise and mentor the HWC project team.
    • Define responsibilities, monitor performance and support staff capacity building.
    • Ensure effective manpower deployment and address team-related operational issues.
    • Promote accountability, teamwork and professional work culture.
    • Define Key Result Areas (KRAs) for the project team in alignment with THF's strategies and approach.
  • Budget, Procurement & Resource Management
    • Budget planning, tracking and ensure utilization on monthly, quarterly and yearly.
    • Support project budgeting and monitor expenditure against approved budgets.
    • Coordinate procurement of medical equipment, medicines, consumables, infrastructure and other project requirements.
    • Ensure procurement is aligned with approved specifications, quality standards and organisational processes.
    • Monitor assets, inventory and vendor performance.
  • Stakeholder Management
    • Coordinate with school authorities, healthcare professionals, vendors, government representatives and other relevant stakeholders.
    • Maintain effective communication with internal organizational departments and senior management.
    • Represent the project in meetings and reviews as required.
    • Address stakeholder concerns and ensure timely resolution.
  • Monitoring, Reporting & Compliance
    • Establish and monitor key project performance indicators.
    • Ensure accurate and timely collection, analysis and reporting of project data.
    • Prepare periodic project reports, presentations and management updates.
    • Ensure proper documentation and compliance with THF policies, procedures and project requirements.
    • Support audits, assessments and project reviews.
  • Quality Improvement & Risk Management
    • Identify project risks, operational gaps and areas for improvement.
    • Develop and implement appropriate mitigation and corrective measures.
    • Ensure continuous improvement in service quality, operational efficiency and beneficiary experience.
    • Document best practices, challenges and lessons learned.
Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience & Other requirements (Behavioral, Language, Certifications etc.)

    • Minimum of 8 years of experience, including at least 3 years in project management or coordination within the social development sector after obtaining a relevant degree. Exceptional cases may be considered.
    • Preference will be given to candidates with experience in a high-functioning consulting environment and project management within a school setting.
    • Proficiency in computer applications and office software (MS Word, Excel, etc.), with strong knowledge of spreadsheets and databases.
    • Ability to handle diverse project management tasks, including design, planning, implementation, data management, and reporting.
    • The role requires frequent intra-city travel and occasional visits to Regional Office in Delhi and Head Office in Gurugram.
    • Proficiency in English is required.

jobs.description:
Job description

Who are we

Gain is on a mission to provide global visibility into private markets. Our industry-leading platform combines advanced AI technology with local-for-local research, delivering the highest quality intelligence on the companies and investors that matter most.

We serve 100% of MBB/Big Four advisories, clients representing over $1 trillion of private capital and more than 70% of the top-20 global M&A houses. Trusted by names like Blackstone, McKinsey and Goldman Sachs, we lead the market in client satisfaction with an NPS of 80+.

With offices in New York, Amsterdam, London, Frankfurt, Warsaw and Bangalore, we are one of Europe's fastest-growing companies, recognized in the Deloitte Technology Fast 500 EMEA 2024 and the FT1000: Europe's Fastest Growing Companies.

About the Lenders Team:

  • Private credit and fixed income sit at the center of how capital moves through private markets and today there's no single source of truth connecting lenders, credit and the companies they finance. Gain is building that layer.
  • The Lenders Team, part of Gain's Private Equity Intelligence (PEI) group, gives Gain users a structured view into the global credit and debt markets, including:
  • - Comprehensive lender profiles, covering credit and debt details with breakdowns by sector, region and type
  • - Credit data linked to companies, deals and investors
  • - A growing roadmap of coverage across BDCs, broadly syndicated loans, corporate bonds, CLOs and credit ratings
  • This is still a young, foundational vertical. The data model, taxonomy and vendor integrations are being defined now, in close partnership with Product and Engineering, which means this role has real say in how the product gets built, not just how it gets maintained.

Job requirements

What will you do

  • Own the Lenders data domain end-to-end across BDC, BSL, corporate bonds, CLO and MML, the core building blocks of private credit and fixed income.
  • Act as the subject matter expert on credit and fixed income data (capital structure, pricing mechanics, instrument and holder taxonomy) for the rest of the org.
  • Shape and prioritize the Lenders product roadmap, balancing new coverage against the depth and quality of what's already live.
  • Work with vendors to understand their data, translate it into Gain's data model, and take end-to-end ownership of linking it to Gain's company, deal and investor assets.
  • Resolve open data modeling questions end-to-end rather than just flagging them.
  • Lead process optimization for the team, using AI and automation to keep data workflows and trackers running cleanly as data volume scales.
  • Set priorities, sequence workstreams and keep delivery on pace against business priorities across the vertical.
  • Hire, coach and manage Analysts and Senior Analysts as the team grows and set the processes and quality bar they work to.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product and Engineering, and represent the Lenders vertical in broader leadership conversations.

Who are you

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in private credit, lending or fixed income data, gained in a research, data management or investment operations role.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with lender, credit or debt data such as BDCs, broadly syndicated loans, CLOs or corporate bonds.
  • Strong project management skills: comfortable setting priorities, managing dependencies across vendors and engineering, and driving structured work in an ambiguous, still-being-built environment.
  • Strong people management skills: proven experience managing or building a team, beyond informal mentoring.
  • Comfortable working in structured data environments (internal data systems, spreadsheets and vendor feeds) with high attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable conveying structured decisions and feedback to both your team and leadership.
  • Proactive, self-driven and thrives in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment.

What do we offer

  • Ownership of a foundational, high-visibility vertical, with direct exposure to how leadership thinks about Gain's private credit and fixed income offering.
  • A ground-floor seat in defining how credit and lending data gets modeled and scaled at Gain, not just executing against an existing playbook.
  • A clear path from owning the data to building and running the team behind it.
  • Regular collaboration with Product, Engineering and senior leadership on a vertical that's still being actively shaped.
  • Competitive compensation with a performance and OKR-linked annual bonus.
  • A flexible, hybrid working model based out of our Bangalore office.

We are proud of our wonderful product and believe it has lots of potential. We are growing fast and having fun while building our platform and company. Does this sound like a team you would like to become a part of Reach out to us, we are excited to get to know you and show you what we do!

An integral part of our company's IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. Role Overview

Decommission, Retire and Archive Center of Excellence (DRACOE) is the process and data governance organization for applications that are exiting or reducing data footprint in the production landscape. We provide global governance and archiving services across all divisions and geographies. The Active Data Management service focuses on helping Product Owners design and implement solutions for extracting data from production systems, storing it in near-line storage, and enabling reporting and access to that extracted data in a controlled and compliant manner.

As a Data Architect, your primary responsibility will be to guide Product Owners, project teams, and technical stakeholders through the architecture, design, and implementation approach for active data management solutions. Your responsibilities include evaluating data extraction patterns, defining optimal storage strategies, aligning reporting needs, and addressing integration considerations while ensuring compliance with DRACOE standards, governance policies, security controls, and records retention requirements.

What Will You Do In This Role

  • Collaborate with Product Owners, application teams, engineering teams, and DRACOE stakeholders to define and deliver active data management solutions.
  • Design and implement strategies for archiving infrequently accessed data, ensuring effective data lifecycle management.
  • Establish and enforce data retention, archival, and disposal policies in alignment with organizational and regulatory requirements.
  • Contribute to solution design discussions, providing guidance on end-to-end data flow, architecture, storage, and reporting frameworks.
  • Act as a representative of DRACOE in both technical and business discussions related to data extraction and active data management.
  • Develop in-depth expertise in DRACOE's Active Data Management processes, standards, and service offerings.
  • Analyse source system data structures and define extraction, transformation, and integration strategies to support downstream reporting and analytics.
  • Optimize storage utilization and costs through tiered storage strategies and intelligent data lifecycle management.
  • Enable the creation of compliant, searchable, and reportable datasets that retain their usability post-archival from production systems.
  • Establish governance frameworks and guardrails to enable secure and compliant self-service data access.
  • Drive automation of data pipelines and monitoring processes to enhance scalability, resilience, and platform performance.

What Should You Have

  • Bachelors degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or any Technology stream.
  • 3+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, data integration, or related technical roles.
  • 3+ years of experience working with enterprise data platforms, data flows, or large-scale data sets. Experienced in software/data engineering practices (including versioning, release management, deployment of datasets, agile & related software tools).
  • Strong working knowledge of at least one large-scale data processing technology (e.g., High-performance computing, distributed computing), databases, and underlying technology (cloud or on-prem environments, containerization, distributed storage & databases)
  • Experience supporting data extraction, transformation, storage, or reporting initiatives.
  • Understanding of data governance, security, and compliance considerations in enterprise environments.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work effectively in a matrixed environment and collaborate across multiple stakeholder groups.

Preferred Competencies

  • Proficiency in AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or other cloud platforms.
  • Experience with enterprise architecture or solution design documentation.
  • Experience with near-line storage, archive or data lifecycle management solutions.
  • Experience with reporting tools, analytics platforms, or data access layers.
  • Exposure to regulated industries, preferably biopharmaceutical or healthcare.
  • Familiarity with data catalog or metadata tools such as Collibra, Alation, or similar.
  • Familiarity with Agile delivery methods such as Scrum or Kanban.
  • Our technology teams operate as business partners, proposing ideas and innovative solutions that enable new organizational capabilities.
  • We collaborate internationally to deliver services and solutions that help everyone be more productive and enable innovation

Required Skills

  • Enterprise Architecture, Active Data Management, Data Engineering, Data Governance, Data Orchestration, Data Integration, Metadata Management, Data Visualization, Cloud Data Platforms, Database Administration, Information Management, Security & Compliance, Software Development Life Cycle

Who We Are

We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.

What We Look For

Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

jobs.title: Global GTM & Sales Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world's underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We're a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

The Opportunity

This is a strategic programs role at the center of Global Sales HQ. You own the portfolio of sales-development programs and strategic sales initiatives that turn strategy into repeatable, measurable motions across regions — and you are the connective tissue between Sales and Product, between demand generation and closure, and between global standards and on-the-ground execution.

In a matrixed organization where regional heads own their reps and delivery, you own the standard, the operating rhythm, and the cross-functional programs that make the whole sales engine more effective. It is a builder-strategist role: you design the programs, orchestrate the launches, instrument them, and scale what works.

What You'll Own

SALES DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMS & STRATEGIC SALES INITIATIVES

  • Own the portfolio of sales-development programs and strategic initiatives that raise the productivity and consistency of the global sales organization, from skills and plays to new sales motions.
  • Translate the annual sales strategy into a sequenced program roadmap with clear owners, milestones, and success metrics.
  • Stand up initiatives as time-boxed programs with scale / iterate / kill decision gates, plus the governance rhythm — interlocks, exception desks, QBR cadences — that keeps regions on one standard.

SALES – PRODUCT INTERLOCK

  • Own the operating interlock between Sales and Product: a structured, two-way loop that turns field signal into roadmap input and turns roadmap into sales readiness.
  • Represent the voice of the field in prioritization, packaging, and pricing discussions, and carry product context back into the field.
  • Ensure every material product change lands with the sales org through readiness, positioning, and enablement — nothing ships to market unsold internally.

CAMPAIGNS — DEMAND & CLOSURE ALIGNMENT

  • Orchestrate integrated GTM campaigns that align top-of-funnel demand generation with the sales closure motion, so demand converts to pipeline and pipeline to revenue.
  • Partner with Marketing and RevOps to define targeting, messaging, and the handoff and follow-up SLAs that connect demand to closure.
  • Instrument campaigns end to end (demand → qualified pipeline → closed revenue) and drive continuous, data-led improvement.

NEW PRODUCT INTRODUCTION (NPI) INTO MARKETS

  • Own the sales side of new-product introductions: the launch playbook, market-readiness criteria, and sequencing for introducing products into markets, countries, and corridors.
  • Coordinate the cross-functional launch (Product, Marketing, Enablement, regional sales) so each introduction has clear ownership, ramp targets, and measurement.
  • Define go / no-go gates and post-launch review so the organization scales winners and retires what doesn't land.

COUNTRY & CORRIDOR SALES STRATEGY

  • Define where-to-play / how-to-win by country and corridor — grounded in market, revenue, and account data.
  • Build and maintain the market and corridor tiering and prioritization that focuses sales investment on the highest-value opportunities.
  • Partner with regional Sales heads to translate corridor strategy into coverage, targeting, and sequenced motions on the ground.

What Success Looks Like — First 6–12 Months

  • A published, sequenced program roadmap tied to the sales strategy, with governance live and adopted across regions.
  • A functioning Sales–Product interlock running on a regular cadence, with measurable roadmap and readiness outcomes.
  • Integrated demand-to-closure campaigns live, with clean end-to-end metrics leadership uses to steer.
  • A repeatable NPI launch model and an active country / corridor sales strategy directing prioritized investment.

Required

What You Bring

  • 8+ years in GTM strategy, sales programs, sales enablement / excellence, or strategic sales initiatives, including running cross-functional programs at scale.
  • Proven experience owning a Sales–Product interlock or equivalent alignment between the field and the product roadmap.
  • A track record designing and launching go-to-market campaigns that connect demand generation to sales closure.
  • Experience leading new-product introductions and / or market and corridor launch strategy.
  • Strong analytical foundation — comfortable in the data, building market / corridor prioritization, and instrumenting funnels end to end.
  • A record of operating in a matrixed, multi-region organization and driving alignment without direct authority; excellent executive communication.

Preferred

  • Hands-on fluency with the modern sales stack — Salesforce, Gong, BI / SQL (BigQuery a plus), and campaign tooling.
  • Familiarity with corridor-based, multi-currency GTM and with SMB / marketplace / platform segments.
  • Experience standing up governance rhythms — interlocks, QBRs, and forecast operating models — across regions.

Fintech / Payments Experience Strongly Preferred

  • Background in fintech, payments, or cross-border B2B financial services.
  • Understanding of how compliance, trust, long sales cycles, and multi-stakeholder buying committees shape GTM in regulated financial services.
  • Comfort translating product complexity (multi-currency, FX, working capital, stablecoin rails) into simple, sellable, market-ready motions.

Who You'll Work With

Product, Marketing, RevOps, regional sales heads (EMEA, APAC, LATAM), Sales Enablement & Excellence, Customer Retention & Expansion, and Strategic Accounts. You'll be a core member of the Global Sales HQ leadership team, reporting to the VP of Global Sales.

Why Join

You'll own the programs and cross-functional interlocks that a global sales organization runs on — the layer where strategy, product, demand, and execution meet. You'll build, not just maintain, in a company at the frontier of cross-border payments, with the data, tooling, and executive support to make GTM measurably better across three regions.

The Payoneer Ways of Working

Act as our customer's partner on the inside

Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.

Do it. Own it.

Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.

Continuously improve

Always striving for a higher standard than our last.

Build Each Other Up

Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.

If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.

We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.

You will be at the center of the most consequential shift in enterprise technology: making organizations truly AI-ready. Every agentic AI system, every foundation model grounded in enterprise knowledge, and every GenAI application that moves from prototype to production depends on the data layer beneath it - and that's what you build.

You will design and implement modern data platforms (lake, lakehouse, mesh), architect data pipelines that transform raw, fragmented data estates into governed, AI-ready assets; and design and implement enterprise RAG architectures, vector stores, semantic ontologies, and knowledge graph architectures that allow foundation models and AI agents to reason accurately, access data securely, and execute autonomously within regulated environments. You will work hands-on inside HCLS customer environments with complex data lineage, regulatory overlays (GxP, HIPAA, CDISC), and legacy systems, and ship production-grade data products that serve multiple downstream consumers, from ML model training to agentic orchestration layers.

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives.

Key job responsibilities

Design and implement production-grade data pipelines, data lakes, lakehouses, and data mesh architectures within enterprise HCLS environments, integrating with legacy systems and existing data governance frameworks.

Build data products that serve multiple downstream applications and use cases — from AI/ML model training to agentic AI systems, ensuring data quality, lineage, and reliability at scale.

Operate with a high degree of autonomy within fast-moving delivery engagements, making judgment calls on data modeling, pipeline design, and architecture without waiting for perfect specifications or constant oversight.

Navigate complex data access, security, and privacy requirements unique to pharma and healthcare including GxP compliance constraints, HIPAA, and regulatory data governance frameworks.

Architect contextual knowledge layers, including ontologies and knowledge graphs leveraging AWS Context, Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, and custom ontology extensions to equip AI agents with the vocabulary and guardrails to reason accurately and execute autonomously within regulated environments.

Collaborate across organizational boundaries to secure data access, understand source system context, and resolve data quality challenges with teams across customer IT, business, and partner organizations.

Deliver iteratively when requirements are ambiguous, translating incomplete business needs into well-architected data solutions that can evolve as customer understanding matures.

Apply AI-DLC (AI-accelerated Development Life Cycle) methodologies to data delivery to redesign data workflows to become AI-native for accelerated scale and pace.

About The Team

About AWS:

Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth - We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
  • Experience in advanced SQL & ability to write complex queries from scratch from multiple tables
  • Knowledge of data engineering pipelines, cloud solutions, ETL management, databases, visualizations and analytical platforms
  • Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with compliance & security standards including PCI DSS, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and NIST
  • 6+ years of solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry experience
  • Experience in any Bigdata architecture, or experience in Hive/Spark/Hbase/Yarn and experience in Kafka
  • 4+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
  • Experience in clinical data standards (OMOP, CDISC, FHIR)

jobs.title: Automation Robotics Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Business

Tata Electronics Private Limited is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components.

Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) is building India's first AI-enabled state-of-the-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management IC, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCU) and high-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand in markets such as automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications and artificial intelligence.

Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata group. The Tata Group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with Trust.

Role Overview

Responsible for designing, programming, integrating, commissioning, and troubleshooting industrial robotic systems in automated manufacturing environments. Collaborates with automation, PLC, vision, and production teams to deliver reliable, high-performance robotic solutions that improve productivity, quality, and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement robotic automation solutions for manufacturing and assembly processes.
  • Program, configure, test, and troubleshoot industrial robots to meet production requirements.
  • Work with 6-axis articulated and SCARA robots from manufacturers such as FANUC, ABB, Omron, Epson, and others.
  • Install, commission, validate, and optimize robotic cells from concept through production launch.
  • Integrate robotic systems with PLCs, machine vision systems, sensors, and peripheral equipment.
  • Perform robot path optimization, cycle time improvement, and process validation activities.
  • Conduct root cause analysis and resolve robotic equipment issues to ensure maximum uptime.
  • Support preventive maintenance, upgrades, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with industrial safety standards, machine safety requirements, and risk assessment procedures.
  • Utilize simulation and offline programming tools for system design, validation, and optimization.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve project milestones, quality targets, and production goals.

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Hands-on experience in industrial robot programming, integration, commissioning, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong knowledge of robotic automation, motion control, and manufacturing processes.
  • Experience with industrial communication protocols:
  • PROFINET
  • EtherNet/IP
  • EtherCAT
  • Modbus
  • TCP/IP
  • RS-232 Serial Communication
  • Understanding of PLC integration, HMI systems, machine vision, and factory automation.
  • Knowledge of robotic cell design, safety standards, and risk assessment methodologies.
  • Proficiency in robot simulation and offline programming software.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional manufacturing environment.

Qualifications

  • Diploma / B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Relevant experience in industrial robotics, automation, or manufacturing engineering preferred.

Experience:

  • 4-8 years

jobs.title: Customer Technical Support
jobs.description:
Position: Customer Technical Services (CTS) Engineer – North India

Department: Technical Services

Location: Delhi/NCR

About the Role

The Customer Technical Services (CTS) Engineer will be responsible for providing comprehensive technical support to customers across the automotive and non-automotive segments in North India. The role involves supporting customer trials, product validation, application development, troubleshooting processing issues, and ensuring successful product approvals. The incumbent will work closely with Sales, R&D, Production, Quality, and customers to deliver technical solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and drive business growth.

Responsibilities

Customer Technical Support:

  • Provide on-site and remote technical support to customers for processing, application development, and troubleshooting.
  • Conduct customer visits to understand processing challenges and recommend suitable material solutions.
  • Support customers during machine trials, product development, and production scaleup activities.
  • Assist customers in optimizing processing parameters to achieve desired product performance.

Customer Trials & Product Validation:

  • Plan, coordinate, and execute customer trials for new and existing products.
  • Monitor trial performance and document observations, process parameters, and outcomes.
  • Ensure successful product validation and customer approvals.
  • Coordinate trial schedules with customers, Sales, Production, and R&D teams.

Application Development:

  • Collaborate with customers to develop customized material solutions for automotive and non-automotive applications.
  • Support new application development for segments such as Automotive, Electrical & Electronics, Home Appliances, Consumer Durables, Furniture, Industrial, and Packaging.
  • Recommend product modifications based on customer requirements and processing conditions.

Product Approvals & Certifications:

  • Drive customer product qualification and approval processes.
  • Prepare technical documentation required for customer approvals.
  • Coordinate with Quality Assurance and R&D to address customer technical queries.
  • Ensure compliance with customer specifications and industry standards.

Cross-Functional Coordination:

  • Work closely with the Sales team to provide technical support during customer meetings and new business development.
  • Coordinate with R&D for product improvements and customized developments.
  • Liaise with Manufacturing and Quality teams to ensure consistent product performance.
  • Support new product launches and commercial implementation.

Complaint Handling & Troubleshooting:

  • Investigate customer complaints related to product performance and processing.
  • Conduct root cause analysis in collaboration with internal teams.
  • Recommend corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  • Prepare technical investigation reports and ensure timely closure of customer concerns.

Documentation & Reporting:

  • Prepare detailed customer visit reports, trial reports, and technical presentations.
  • Maintain records of application developments, customer feedback, and technical approvals.
  • Submit periodic activity reports and update CRM systems as required.

Training & Technical Knowledge Sharing

  • Conduct product and application training sessions for customers and internal sales teams.
  • Stay updated with the latest polymer technologies, processing techniques, and industry trends.
  • Support technical seminars, exhibitions, and customer awareness programs.

Qualifications

  • B.E./B.Tech in Polymer Engineering, Plastics Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree in Polymer Science or Plastics Technology will be an added advantage.

Skill Requirement:

Technical Competencies

  • Strong understanding of polymer compounds, masterbatches, and plastic processing.
  • Knowledge of injection moulding, extrusion, blow moulding, and related processing technologies.
  • Familiarity with automotive material standards and approval processes.
  • Product troubleshooting and root cause analysis.
  • Application development and process optimization.
  • Technical report preparation and documentation.

Behavioral Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and presentation abilities.
  • Customer-focused approach.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
  • Strong planning, coordination, and time management skills.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across North India.

Preferred Skills

Candidates from the following industries will be preferred:

  • Plastic Compounds
  • Masterbatches
  • Polymer Manufacturing
  • Engineering Plastics
  • Automotive Components
  • Plastic Processing Industry
  • Specialty Polymer Solutions

Travel Requirement: Extensive travel across North India for customer visits, trials, technical support, and application development.

jobs.title: Senior research engineer - Computer Vision
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

GE Vernova's Advanced Research business is the central innovation engine for GE's portfolio of energy businesses, which is unified under one banner called GE Vernova. The research organization is made up of 300+ researchers representing virtually every major scientific and engineering discipline. Collectively, they are driving major research programs and initiatives to decarbonize power, accelerate renewables, and promote electrification and the creation of a 21st century grid fit to power a zero-carbon energy future.

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Researcher to join our team in the field of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning (AIML). As a Senior Research Engineer, you will lead and drive cutting-edge projects that leverage AIML and computer vision techniques for the development of state-of-the-art visual inspection, anomaly detection, prognostics, diagnostics, and modelling solutions.

Job Description

Roles and responsibilities

  • Lead the development of advanced algorithms and methodologies in artificial intelligence, machine learning (AIML), and computer vision to drive process and product innovation
  • Oversee the analysis of extensive datasets to identify complex patterns, trends, and insights, with an emphasis on computer vision-based diagnostics, visual inspection, and prognostics for large-scale energy equipment.
  • Architect and optimize AIML and computer vision algorithms and models, including convolutional neural networks and generative models, to ensure superior performance and scalability
  • Design, conduct, and supervise experiments to assess the efficacy and reliability of AIML-based solutions.
  • Document and disseminate research findings, methodologies, and implementation strategies for effective knowledge sharing and future reference.
  • Collaborate with and guide cross-functional teams, including engineers, researchers, and product managers, to seamlessly integrate AIML solutions into existing system platforms.
  • Stay at the forefront of advancements in AIML, computer vision, control systems, and signal processing engineering
  • Lead research initiatives to conceptualize and develop AI and computer vision solutions for complex industrial challenges, including image-based defect detection, object recognition, and visual analytics

Job Description

Specialist Software Engineering (Benchling Engineer)

The Opportunity

Join a global biopharma company with a 130-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Be part of a technology-driven, data-led organization supporting a diversified portfolio of medicines, vaccines, and animal health products. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics, and insights to drive decisions and tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers are globally distributed hubs that enable our digital transformation and business outcomes across IT. They bring together diverse teams to collaborate, share best practices, and deliver solutions that save and improve lives.

This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (3 days onsite, 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within commuting distance of the Hyderabad office.

Role Overview

The Benchling Engineer (R2) designs, configures, develops, and evolves Benchling capabilities for the Sample & Reagent Inventory Product Line. The role delivers scalable solutions that enable laboratory sample registration, tracking, inventory, workflows, and related research processes.

This is a hands-on software engineering role requiring direct Benchling Apps development experience. The engineer uses Benchling Python SDK and REST APIs to build platform capabilities, integrates Benchling with enterprise and laboratory systems, and applies approved AI-enabled tools to improve development quality, automation, and engineering productivity.

What Will You Do In This Role

  • Delivers configured and custom Benchling capabilities within a defined product scope.
  • Translates scientific and operational needs into maintainable technical solutions.
  • Builds and maintains integration, data flows, and automation with guidance from senior engineers and product stakeholders.
  • Applies established engineering, quality, data integrity, security, and change-management practices.
  • Collaborates with distributed product, engineering, laboratory, and vendor teams across India, Prague, and the US

Key Accountabilities

Benchling Platform Engineering

  • Develop, customize, test, and deploy applications within Benchling using the Python SDK and REST APIs.
  • Configure Benchling modules, including Inventory, Registry, and Workflows, to enable sample-management and laboratory processes.
  • Design robust data models, automations, and workflows that meet product and scientific requirements.
  • Contribute to the technical evolution of Benchling capabilities within the Sample & Reagent Inventory Product Line.

Integrations and Data Engineering

  • Design and implement integrations between Benchling, enterprise systems, and laboratory systems using RESTful APIs and established integration patterns.
  • Develop data transformations, error handling, and monitoring needed to maintain reliable data exchange.
  • Investigate and resolve issues involving application logic, APIs, data, and connectivity in collaboration with engineering and platform teams.
  • Apply SQL and relational data-modeling skills to analyze and improve data quality and technical solutions.

Software Quality and Delivery

  • Write clean, maintainable, modular code and accompanying technical documentation.
  • Create and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests appropriate to the solution.
  • Participate in code reviews and apply feedback to improve code quality, security, and maintainability.
  • Use Git-based version control and CI/CD practices to deliver changes reliably.

AI-Enabled Engineering and Automation

  • Use approved AI-enabled tools to accelerate code development, test design, technical analysis, documentation, and workflow automation.
  • Validate AI-assisted outputs against technical requirements, platform evidence, and data-handling expectations before use.
  • Identify practical automation opportunities that improve laboratory workflow efficiency while preserving appropriate human oversight.

Product and Scientific Collaboration

  • Partner with scientists, product owners, and stakeholders to translate laboratory and sample-management needs into technical specifications.
  • Communicate technical design choices, delivery risks, and implementation progress clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaborate effectively across India, Prague, and US teams to align technical decisions, coordinate delivery, and maintain continuity across time zones.

Data Integrity, Security, and Compliance

  • Apply established data integrity, access-control, testing, and change-management practices when delivering Benchling solutions.
  • Identify data, integration, and security risks and work with quality, security, and architecture partners to address them.
  • Contribute technical documentation and evidence for reviews, validation activities, and audits when required.

What Should You Have

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of software engineering experience, including direct hands-on Benchling Apps development and configuration.
  • Proficiency with the Benchling Python SDK and REST APIs.
  • Experience configuring or extending Benchling Inventory, Registry, Workflows, data models, or automation capabilities.
  • Strong Python programming skills and experience designing RESTful API integrations.
  • Experience with SQL, relational databases, and data modeling.
  • Knowledge of clean-code practices, modular design, Git-based version control, automated testing, and CI/CD.
  • Familiarity with AWS or comparable cloud-platform services.
  • Demonstrated ability to use approved AI-enabled tools for software engineering, automation, technical analysis, or documentation with appropriate human oversight.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Primary Skills

API integrations, solution architecture, Python, automated testing tools, Github, Jira, Benchling experience, Json, Agile tools, AI Platform, Strong communication skills, team player, Cloud knowledge.

Secondary Skills

Electronic Lab Notebooks (ELN), Benchling App Canvas

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with laboratory informatics, LIMS, ELN, sample-management, or inventory-management platforms.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical R&D, biotechnology, research, or laboratory environments.
  • Familiarity with GxP, GLP, GMP, data integrity principles, computer system validation, or audit-sensitive systems.
  • Experience integrating laboratory instruments or laboratory automation systems with Benchling.
  • Experience working with vendor-hosted SaaS platforms and enterprise integration frameworks.
  • Familiarity with JavaScript, Java, or C#.

Who We Are

We are known as well-known org Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.

What We Look For

Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

Required Skills

Amazon Web Services (AWS), API Integration, Architect Systems, Automation Testing Tools, GitHub, JIRA Tool, JSON, Python (Programming Language), RESTful APIs, System Integration, Technical Analysis, Testing

Preferred Skills

Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN), Java (Programming Language), JavaScript, Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Implementation
