GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

The Director - Legal & Compliance & WREF Digital & Tech Architect defines and governs the architectural framework for a specific Product Domain, ensuring that technology decisions support business goals and enable the successful delivery of domain Products. The role partners with senior stakeholders to guide solution direction, establish domain standards and principles, and provide architectural leadership across solutions delivered within the domain. The Product Domain Architect ensures that products are designed in a way that is scalable, interoperable, and aligned to agreed business and technology objectives.

The Director - Legal & Compliance & WREF Digital & Tech Architect is responsible for defining and governing the technology architecture that underpins a bold transformation in Legal & Compliance. This leadership role combines architecture, AI innovation and delivery enablement. The successful candidate will shape a modern architecture that balances enterprise standards, with rapid innovation. The role ensures we can explore and deploy AI solutions in Legal & Compliance and WREF while understanding what it takes to integrate various systems of a record with AI solutions in order to fundamentally rethink existing processes and drive self-enablement within the functions.

The role will act as the senior technical advisor to the Senior Director, L&C&W Digital & Tech, product teams and business leaders. They will ensure every technology investment in Legal & Compliance and WREF contributes towards a coherent long term technology strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define the Legal & Compliance and WREF technology architecture strategy, aligned to broader GSK Tech Enterprise Architecture.
  • Define and maintain the architectural framework, standards, and schematics for the Product Domain, including domain-specific principles, patterns, data flows, and interface models.

Amazon's Retail Business Services (RBS) team is looking for a Senior Program Manager to help expand its Inventory Optimization Program (IOP) . We understand root cause for these defects and fix/eliminate the defects , thereby increase their availability and sales by enhancing customer experience. Our end customers are the Buying customer and Selling partner. We work hard to reduce the buying customer's product non-availability and to improve the profitability of our selling partners.

He/She will manage business impact via functional activities and will be accountable for designing and delivering on all KPIs of the same. He/she should define the program (mission, vision, tenets), set objectives, analyze data, drive improvements that are quantified with metrics, and influence resource allocation. He/She will solve ambiguous problems and proactively identify and mitigate risks (before they become roadblocks). He/She will be data-driven and demonstrate good judgment in how and when to escalate (without damaging relationships).

A successful candidate will be an exceptional strategic thinker and will have exposure to supply chain improvement.   • Drives detailed discussions and high-level alignment. Is clear and concise in verbal and written communication. Trusted to present decisions to leaders up to 3 tiers above level. Able to communicate across an increasing diversity of areas

You will own few defects that lead to process-gaps in Inventory Management, understand the systems and processes leading to those defects. You will interact with various Tech and program owners whose processes either lead to those defects or will help solve those defects.

Each day, you will dive deep into Data to analyze opportunities, identify patterns and implement upstream solutions.

You will use your expertise of undertaking process improvements using Lean Six Sigma techniques to identify and implement process improvements.

You will present data driven insights to leadership for decision making.

Our program identifies, categorizes, reports and resolves inventory availability process defects in Amazon fulfillment network. We resolve key bottlenecks to make sure inventory is available for our customers. We think tech first to provide scalable solutions.

jobs.description:
Company Name

Description

Making India's Favorite Snacks Since 1937 Over the course of eight decades, a lot has changed about us. We have relocated, undergone expansion, developed new product lines & added segments, opened retail chain of stores across India and embraced new markets overseas. One thing hasn't changed – we're still a tight-knit family business, committed to serving the most authentic taste of India through our products. Our origins can be traced back to a small namkeen shop in Bikaner founded by Ganga Bishan Agarwal (Haldiram Ji). This modest shop quickly gained popularity and scaled up to meet a booming demand for its unique-tasting bhujia. Building on this legacy, his grandson, our pioneer Mr. Shiv Kishan Agrawal steered the business towards the heights it has tasted today. Determined to take bhujia beyond the boundaries of Bikaner, he shifted base to Nagpur in 1970. We opened our first full-production unit to introduce a delectable variety of savouries, sweets and beverages to the market. The success of this venture led us to expand and evolve as a brand, that is an integral part of every Indian household. From our formative years, he instilled the value of keeping the tradition and quality intact, even as we matured as a company. All our products maintain a consistent sense of simplicity. The ingredients and recipes were picked to accentuate these ideas and are followed to this date. We promise that all our products are natural, wholesome and have a homemade feel to them. Although, Haldiram's is about more than just food. By creating a strong sense of community and supporting our associates, we continue to feel like a true family business. We carry these values with us as we operate together to serve generations of happy connoisseurs across the globe and continue to be the nation's beloved snack-food company. As the age old saying goes,The way to one's heart courses through their stomach. We want to leave no stone unturned to win your hearts.

We're seeking an experienced Senior Executive – Regulatory Compliance to join our team at Haldiram-Harrshiv Healthy Foods & More Private Limited in Nagpur. This person in this role will have to ensure that all food products, packaging, and processes comply with FSSAI and other statutory standards. The person will also have to lead documentation, labelling, nutritional validation, barcoding, and audit readiness to support compliant product launches and ongoing market operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure compliance with FSSAI, FDA, BRC, HACCP, ISO, and Legal Metrology standards.

  • Support internal, external, and FSSAI/BRC audits with complete documentation.
  • Collaborate with R&D, QA, Procurement, and Marketing during product development for compliance readiness.
  • Train teams on new regulatory requirements and food safety standards.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Food Technology, or related field. Master's degree will be given more preference.

Experience: At least 5 years of experience in regulatory compliance or affairs within FMCG industry.

Strong command over nutrition labelling and food claims validation.

Hands-on experience in barcode generation & traceability systems.

As a Senior Staff Mechanical Engineer - Inverter, BESS, you will own and drive mechanical and structural design of the inverter variant alongside other hardware and mechanical engineers for MW/MWh-scale utility Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) serving data centers, spanning outdoor cabinets and containerized platforms.

This role requires deep, hands-on expertise in structural design, electro-mechanical product development for outdoor applications, FEM/FEA analysis, and product validation. You will work closely with thermal, electrical hardware, sourcing, manufacturing, and quality teams to ensure the product meets performance, reliability, manufacturability, serviceability, compliance, and cost targets — delivering production-ready designs from concept through deployment.

What will you do:

  • Own structural design from concept to final product.
  • Develop electro-mechanical products for outdoor applications that meet various Ingress Protection (IP) ratings.
  • Perform product structural analysis across injection molded plastics, aluminum metal extrusions, and other materials.
  • Develop structural solutions for components such as PCBs and heatsinks, including warpage and stress analysis under various load conditions.
  • Design custom bulkhead connectors for high-voltage DC (800–1000V) and high-voltage AC (600V) applications.
  • Design new components and products — sometimes as a sole contributor, often as part of a team.
  • Review and analyze solutions to achieve the best outcome for performance, cost, and schedule.
  • Support sourcing, manufacturing, and quality teams with mechanical expertise.
  • Prepare and execute test plans for structural validation (vibration, drop test, impact test, thermal test, thermal cycling, damp heat humidity test, and others).
  • Conduct failure analysis and root-cause identification.
  • Generate and review documentation, including concept proposals, analysis reports, component specifications, and review minutes.
  • Review and approve components, including global travel to vendor sites during the pre-production stage.
  • Provide technical leadership, and mentor and grow other junior engineers under this role.

Who You Are and What You Will Bring:


  • Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering with 12+ years of relevant industry experience, or a Master's degree (Product Design, Mechanical Design, Thermal Engineering, or a related discipline) with 8+ years of relevant industry experience.
  • Strong fundamentals in engineering mechanics and strength of materials.
  • Strong fundamentals in FEM/FEA (structural and thermal) analysis — a key requirement.
  • Strong execution of inverter thermals using Flotherm, Ansys Icepak, or SolidWorks tools.
  • In-depth knowledge of design for manufacture for parts made through injection molding, sheet metal, stamping, and milling/turning.
  • Proficiency with CAD tools (SolidWorks or equivalent) and EPDM.
  • Sound knowledge of inverter standards such as UL1741, IEC 62109, and NEMA, as well as country-specific standards.
  • Thorough knowledge of product validation methods (vibration, drop test, impact test, connector reliability, and others).
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including strong presentation skills.
  • Experience in design and sustaining activities on high-volume products (500k+ to 1 million per annum).
  • Rapid prototyping with 3D printing or high-temperature resin materials.
  • Previous experience in the high-power or consumer products industries.

jobs.title: Head Quality Assurance
jobs.description:
Apply only if you meet the following requirements and hold a B.E./B.Tech in Metallurgical Engineering with TMT Steel Rolling Mill experience.

Job Purpose

To head the Quality Assurance function for ISTEEL's Rolling Mill (TMT bar manufacturing for construction, multiple grades), ensuring robust quality control across raw material inspection, in-process and final product quality, customer complaint resolution, new grade development, and management system certifications (ISO & DNV

Key Responsibilities

1. Quality Control & Process Assurance

•     Own end-to-end quality control for the Rolling Mill — from raw material (billets/scrap-derived inputs) through in-process rolling stages to finished TMT bar dispatch.

•     Establish, review, and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and quality control plans across all rolling mill process stages.

•     Monitor mechanical properties (yield strength, UTS, elongation, bend/re-bend) and dimensional tolerances of TMT bars across all grades against IS and customer specifications.

•     Drive root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) for process deviations and quality non-conformances.

2. Raw Material Inspection

•     Institute and monitor incoming raw material inspection protocols (billets, alloys, scrap-related inputs, sponge iron where applicable) to ensure conformance to specification before release to production.

•     Coordinate with procurement and stores for sampling, chemical/mechanical testing, and vendor quality feedback.

•     Maintain vendor quality scorecards and drive supplier quality improvement where required.

3. Customer Complaint Handling

•     Own the customer complaint resolution process end-to-end — investigation, root cause analysis, corrective action, and closure communication.

•     Track complaint trends and drive systemic improvements to reduce recurrence.

•     Liaise with sales/marketing and customers directly where technical clarification or site visits are required.

4. New Grade Development (R&D)

•     Lead development and trial rolling of new TMT/steel grades in line with market and customer requirements.

•     Work with process/production teams to establish chemistry, rolling parameters, and cooling practices for new grades.

•     Document trial results, validate mechanical properties, and finalize SOPs for new grade production.

5. Quality Systems, Certification & Audits

•     Own and maintain ISO (9001 and applicable series) and DNV certification and surveillance requirements.

•     Plan and conduct internal audits across QA, production, and stores functions; coordinate external/certification body audits.

•     Ensure documentation, records, and calibration systems remain audit-ready at all times.

•     Drive closure of audit findings (internal & external) within defined timelines.

6. Team Leadership & People Management

•     Lead, mentor, and develop a QA team of 15–20 members ranging from Deputy Manager to Operator/Helper level.

•     Define roles, responsibilities, and shift-wise coverage across the QA lab and shop-floor quality checkpoints.

•     Build technical capability within the team through training on testing methods, standards, and equipment.

7. Future Scope — Steel Melting Shop (SMS)

•     As ISTEEL backward-integrates into steel making, this role's scope will expand to cover quality control for the steel making process (furnace metallurgy, casting quality, billet quality) in addition to the Rolling Mill.

Knowledge & Skills Required

•     Steel & Metallurgy Fundamentals: Strong grounding in steel grades, metallurgy, and TMT bar manufacturing process flow.

•     Process Knowledge: Rolling mill process flow, SOPs, and quality checkpoints from raw material to finished product.

•     Quality Systems: ISO and DNV procedures, certification requirements, and both internal and external audit management.

•     Preferred Additional Knowledge: Spectro (spectrometer) analysis for chemical composition, steel mechanical properties and testing, different types of steel scrap, and sponge iron characteristics.

•     Analytical Ability: Root cause analysis, CAPA, and data-driven decision making for quality improvement.

Candidate Profile

•     BE / B.Tech in Metallurgical Engineering (mandatory).

•     10–15 years of experience in a steel making company, forging company, or the broader steel industry; relevant equivalent experience will also be considered.

•     Candidates from strong steel industry backgrounds are welcome even without direct TMT bar / rolling mill manufacturing experience — the metallurgy qualification above remains mandatory.

•     Demonstrated experience managing a quality team and handling ISO/DNV certification and audits.

Key Competencies

•     Strong leadership and people management skills to lead a mid-sized, multi-level team.

•     High attention to detail with a strong ownership mindset on quality outcomes.

•     Strong communication skills for customer-facing complaint handling and cross-functional coordination.

•     Ability to work in a growing organization and take on expanded scope (steel making) as the business scales.

jobs.title: Head Quality Assurance-Gummidipoondi, Tamil Nadu
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Head – Quality Assurance

Position Title

Head – Quality Assurance

Department

Quality Assurance (QA)

Reports To

CEO (functional) and General Manager – Factory (operations)

Direct Reportees

15–20 team members (Deputy Manager, Assistant Manager, Engineers, Supervisors, Operators & Helpers)

Location

Gummidipoondi, Tamil Nadu

Qualification

BE / B.Tech – Metallurgical Engineering (mandatory)

Experience

10–15 years in steel making, forging, or the broader steel industry

Job Purpose

To head the Quality Assurance function for Our client's Rolling Mill (TMT bar manufacturing for construction, multiple grades), ensuring robust quality control across raw material inspection, in-process and final product quality, customer complaint resolution, new grade development, and management system certifications (ISO & DNV

Key Responsibilities

1. Quality Control & Process Assurance

  • Own end-to-end quality control for the Rolling Mill — from raw material (billets/scrap-derived inputs) through in-process rolling stages to finished TMT bar dispatch.
  • Establish, review, and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and quality control plans across all rolling mill process stages.
  • Monitor mechanical properties (yield strength, UTS, elongation, bend/re-bend) and dimensional tolerances of TMT bars across all grades against IS and customer specifications.
  • Drive root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) for process deviations and quality non-conformances.

2. Raw Material Inspection

  • Institute and monitor incoming raw material inspection protocols (billets, alloys, scrap-related inputs, sponge iron where applicable) to ensure conformance to specification before release to production.
  • Coordinate with procurement and stores for sampling, chemical/mechanical testing, and vendor quality feedback.
  • Maintain vendor quality scorecards and drive supplier quality improvement where required.

3. Customer Complaint Handling

  • Own the customer complaint resolution process end-to-end — investigation, root cause analysis, corrective action, and closure communication.
  • Track complaint trends and drive systemic improvements to reduce recurrence.
  • Liaise with sales/marketing and customers directly where technical clarification or site visits are required.

4. New Grade Development (R&D)

  • Lead development and trial rolling of new TMT/steel grades in line with market and customer requirements.
  • Work with process/production teams to establish chemistry, rolling parameters, and cooling practices for new grades.
  • Document trial results, validate mechanical properties, and finalize SOPs for new grade production.

5. Quality Systems, Certification & Audits

  • Own and maintain ISO (9001 and applicable series) and DNV certification and surveillance requirements.
  • Plan and conduct internal audits across QA, production, and stores functions; coordinate external/certification body audits.
  • Ensure documentation, records, and calibration systems remain audit-ready at all times.
  • Drive closure of audit findings (internal & external) within defined timelines.

6. Team Leadership & People Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a QA team of 15–20 members ranging from Deputy Manager to Operator/Helper level.
  • Define roles, responsibilities, and shift-wise coverage across the QA lab and shop-floor quality checkpoints.
  • Build technical capability within the team through training on testing methods, standards, and equipment.

7. Future Scope — Steel Melting Shop (SMS)

  • As Our client backward-integrates into steel making, this role's scope will expand to cover quality control for the steel making process (furnace metallurgy, casting quality, billet quality) in addition to the Rolling Mill.

Knowledge & Skills Required

  • Steel & Metallurgy Fundamentals: Strong grounding in steel grades, metallurgy, and TMT bar manufacturing process flow.
  • Process Knowledge: Rolling mill process flow, SOPs, and quality checkpoints from raw material to finished product.
  • Quality Systems: ISO and DNV procedures, certification requirements, and both internal and external audit management.
  • Preferred Additional Knowledge: Spectro (spectrometer) analysis for chemical composition, steel mechanical properties and testing, different types of steel scrap, and sponge iron characteristics.
  • Analytical Ability: Root cause analysis, CAPA, and data-driven decision making for quality improvement.

Candidate Profile

  • BE / B.Tech in Metallurgical Engineering (mandatory).
  • 10–15 years of experience in a steel making company, forging company, or the broader steel industry; relevant equivalent experience will also be considered.
  • Candidates from strong steel industry backgrounds are welcome with TMT bar / rolling mill manufacturing experience — the metallurgy qualification above remains mandatory.
  • Demonstrated experience managing a quality team and handling ISO/DNV certification and audits.

Key Competencies

  • Strong leadership and people management skills to lead a mid-sized, multi-level team.
  • High attention to detail with a strong ownership mindset on quality outcomes.
  • Strong communication skills for customer-facing complaint handling and cross-functional coordination.
  • Ability to work in a growing organization and take on expanded scope (steel making) as the business scales.

jobs.title: Senior Delivery Consultant - Data, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
jobs.description:
Description

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a Delivery Consultant specializing in Data to join our Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS) practice. You will be at the center of the most consequential shift in enterprise technology: making organizations truly AI-ready. Every agentic AI system, every foundation model grounded in enterprise knowledge, and every GenAI application that moves from prototype to production depends on the data layer beneath it - and that's what you build.

You will design and implement modern data platforms (lake, lakehouse, mesh), architect data pipelines that transform raw, fragmented data estates into governed, AI-ready assets; and design and implement enterprise RAG architectures, vector stores, semantic ontologies, and knowledge graph architectures that allow foundation models and AI agents to reason accurately, access data securely, and execute autonomously within regulated environments. You will work hands-on inside HCLS customer environments with complex data lineage, regulatory overlays (GxP, HIPAA, CDISC), and legacy systems, and ship production-grade data products that serve multiple downstream consumers, from ML model training to agentic orchestration layers.

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives.

Key job responsibilities

Design and implement production-grade data pipelines, data lakes, lakehouses, and data mesh architectures within enterprise HCLS environments, integrating with legacy systems and existing data governance frameworks.

Build data products that serve multiple downstream applications and use cases — from AI/ML model training to agentic AI systems, ensuring data quality, lineage, and reliability at scale.

Operate with a high degree of autonomy within fast-moving delivery engagements, making judgment calls on data modeling, pipeline design, and architecture without waiting for perfect specifications or constant oversight.

Navigate complex data access, security, and privacy requirements unique to pharma and healthcare including GxP compliance constraints, HIPAA, and regulatory data governance frameworks.

Architect contextual knowledge layers, including ontologies and knowledge graphs leveraging AWS Context, Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, and custom ontology extensions to equip AI agents with the vocabulary and guardrails to reason accurately and execute autonomously within regulated environments.

Collaborate across organizational boundaries to secure data access, understand source system context, and resolve data quality challenges with teams across customer IT, business, and partner organizations.

Deliver iteratively when requirements are ambiguous, translating incomplete business needs into well-architected data solutions that can evolve as customer understanding matures.

Apply AI-DLC (AI-accelerated Development Life Cycle) methodologies to data delivery to redesign data workflows to become AI-native for accelerated scale and pace.

About The Team

About AWS:

Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth - We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
  • Experience in advanced SQL & ability to write complex queries from scratch from multiple tables
  • Knowledge of data engineering pipelines, cloud solutions, ETL management, databases, visualizations and analytical platforms
  • Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with compliance & security standards including PCI DSS, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and NIST
  • 6+ years of solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry experience
  • Experience in any Bigdata architecture, or experience in Hive/Spark/Hbase/Yarn and experience in Kafka
  • 4+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
  • Experience in clinical data standards (OMOP, CDISC, FHIR)
  • Experience with data governance and cataloging tools (e.g., AWS Glue Data Catalog, Collibra, Alation) and data lineage tracking and designing data access patterns that support identity and least-privilege access
  • Experience collaborating with customer business teams, IT, and partner organizations to understand data requirements and resolve access challenges and conveying technical concepts to both technical and business audiences.
  • Proficiency in AI-DLC or equivalent AI-accelerated development methodologies — including prompt engineering as a development discipline, mob programming with AI, and experience validating AI-generated data pipeline code for production deployment in regulated environments

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform.   • 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
  • 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
  • Knowledge of SAP systems (like SAP Business Suite, S/4HANA, SAP Business Warehouse, SAP HANA, SAP Business Objects, etc.) and their architecture and infrastructure needs
  • Experience working with end user or developer communities
  • Experience managing relationships with SAP customers and partners
  • Experience in SAP S/4HANA, SAP Cloud Platform, SAP Cloud ERP and Cloud ERP Private
  • Experience in SAP clean core design concepts, including design and build using non-SAP technologies in domains such as Generative / Agentic AI, and data & analytics

jobs.title: Learning Program Manager
jobs.description:
Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you're trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That's why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

Job Description:

Crowe seeks a dynamic Learning Manager who will be crucial in developing and delivering innovative, high-impact learning solutions. This position requires a blend of project management, quality control, critical thinking, and vendor oversight to ensure the successful execution of learning programs.

Key Responsibilities:

Project Management and Quality Control:

  • Collaborate with the India Talent Leader, India BU Directors, firmwide Learning team and other stakeholders to manage multiple high-priority learning projects from inception to completion, ensuring timely and successful implementation.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, and budgets, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
  • Serve as a project manager liaising with multiple stakeholders to support the development and delivery of learning solutions end-to-end.
  • Conduct thorough quality reviews to ensure learning materials meet high standards.
  • Implement quality control processes to enhance the accuracy and effectiveness of learning solutions.
  • Ensure meticulous attention to detail in course development and delivery.

Learning Content Curation and Design

  • Develop innovative and engaging learning programs (e.g., in-person, virtual, e-learning, microlearning) aligned to the business strategy
  • Curate content (e.g., courses, microlearning, videos, podcasts) from existing learning assets and vendor content
  • Oversee and manage large in-person and/or virtual training events

Stakeholder Engagement and Communication:

  • Liaise with key stakeholders, internal business partners, and design teams to translate internal partners needs while managing tight timelines.
  • Maintain effective and appropriate written and verbal US business communication skills in a business environment.

Technology and Innovation:

  • Utilize technology such as AI tools like ChatGPT and CoPilot to acquire knowledge and skills for various content development and delivery engagements.
  • Incorporate online and technology-enhanced course components to improve learning across different delivery modes.

Facilitation and Vendor Management:

  • Support the facilitation of in-office learning events in Crowe India offices, including logistics, course designs, communication, and course follow up.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with Crowe's existing and new external vendors to ensure the delivery of high-quality learning solutions.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Instructional Design, Education, Instructional Systems Design, Adult Education, Project Management, or a related field.
  • 12-15 years of experience with at least 5-6 years of experience developing learning solutions based on industry-recognized adult learning theory and learning design.
  • Experience with LMS systems (preferred)
  • Experience with AI tools specifically ChatGPT and CoPilot (preferred)
  • Working knowledge of designing and developing in Articulate 360 and other digital solutions.
  • Strong planning, project management, communication, and coordination abilities specifically working in Microsoft Teams and Planner
  • Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams to guide the development of extraordinary learning experiences.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills to collaborate effectively with subject matter experts, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams
  • Critical thinking skills to analyze course goals and instructional strategies, ensuring they align with evidence-based practices.

This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to the development of innovative learning solutions while ensuring the highest standards of quality and efficiency. If you are a proactive and detail-oriented professional with a passion for learning and development, we encourage you to apply.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe's values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

Our Benefits:

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!

How You Can Grow:

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

More about Crowe:

Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.

Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.

We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role's responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

jobs.title: AWS Solutions Architect , AWS India Public Sector
jobs.description:
Description

Cloud is the new normal and our customers are interested in leveraging Amazon Web Services (AWS) to increase agility, improve security, reduce costs and gain global footprint.

We are hiring Enterprise Solutions Architects to work with top-tier Enterprise customers. The Solutions Architect engage with customers to understand their business drivers, assess application portfolios, design reliable and cost-effective cloud native architectures. As an Enterprise Solutions Architect, you will partner with customers, AWS Sales and several other AWS teams to create solutions that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with sales, you will drive revenue growth across a broad set of customers.

The ideal candidate must be self-motivated with a proven track record in software/technology sales or consulting. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges. We are looking for candidates who are comfortable at the intersection of technology and business. The Solutions Architect is a very technical role - you must be broadly competent across many areas of technology (infrastructure, security, DevOps, databases, application development, analytics) and deep in at least 2-3 of those areas. On the business side, the ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. The Solutions Architect will spend most of their day interacting with several customer stakeholders, including developers, team leads, engineering directors, and CxOs

Here Are Some Other Qualities We Are Looking For

Be great fun to work with At AWS, we have a credo of Work hard. Have fun. Make history. In this role, you will love what you do, and instinctively know how to make work fun. You will be dynamic and creative, and willing to take on any challenge and make a big impact.

Enjoy working with enterprise customers You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.

Have a strong understanding of large scale computing solutions The ideal candidate will have past experience working as a systems or support engineer, and pre-sales experience. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS.

Key job responsibilities

Roles and Responsibilities

  • In partnership with the sales team, formulate and execute a sales strategy to exceed revenue objectives through the adoption of AWS
  • As a key member of the business development and sales team, ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
  • Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
  • Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
  • Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solutions architect community
  • Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers
  • Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates
  • Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support

Open to travel up to 25%

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience with one of the following programming languages: Python, Ruby, Node.js, C#, or C++
  • Experience with two or more of the following: networking fundamentals, security, storage or databases (relational or NoSQL), operating systems (Unix, Linux, or Windows)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing a cloud-based technology solution
  • Experience in any of the following: Cloud Architecture, Systems Design, Software Development, Infrastructure Architecture, Data Engineering or DevOps

This job opening is for a Solutions Architect role within the public sector team of Amazon Web Services India Private Limited. Along the way, you'll share with and learn from talented team members all focused on helping customers explore the benefits of moving from on-premise infrastructure to the cloud.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

You will do well in this role if you demonstrate excellent customer-facing communication skills representing technical solutions at senior leadership levels. You thrive on diving deep into complex technology environments and express these as industry standard architecture diagrams and well-articulated solution narratives. You will be right at home if you stay updated on latest technology trends and have a sense of urgency and hunger for learning more about customer business and relevant technology solutions across industries. Solutions architects love to travel, spending time with diverse customers, small and large, self-manage high intensity context switching between competing priorities, and demonstrate a sense of urgency to deliver results.

Delivering to primary responsibilities of a solutions architect you will 1) establish technical credibility in sales cycles for Amazon platforms, technologies, and the company, by collaborating with the sales team to win new business; 2) capture and convey best practices and provide prescriptive guidance around application and systems design on the Amazon platforms and technologies, via direct customer and partner interaction, development of technical content, events, evangelism, training, and operational event support; and 3) help drive the evolution of the Amazon platforms and technologies by providing direct input and feedback from the field to the engineering teams developing these offerings. Finally, tenured team members are tasked with recruiting, hiring, and developing top SA talent; managing and applying that resource in a prudent and efficient way; and driving cross-organizational initiatives related to the areas identified above.

You're surrounded by innovation. You're empowered with a lot of ownership. Your growth is accelerated. The work is challenging. You have a voice here and are encouraged to use it. Over the past 20+ years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. Through our entrepreneurial culture, Amazon has developed new technologies and products (like Echo) and, enterprise services (like Amazon Web Services). APEX NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for Transportation Execution across the Amazon's transportation network. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving, NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.

Overall, Relay Ops plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon's ability to serve its customers on time.

Responsibilities of Manager I under Relay Ops/NOC

We're looking for a hands-on and motivated self-starter who's passionate about using data to help us measure every area of the business, drive efficiencies, optimizations and influence decision-making.

He should be proficient, in identifying the input and output metric to gauge the success of a program. In this role, he will work with business and operations team to analyze historic results, challenge status quo and make business recommendations to senior management based on those analyses – all in an environment of rapid growth and increasing complexity. The Manager will drive improvements to the reporting tools, methods, and processes utilized by the team to increase the availability and granularity of actionable data to internal and external partners.

The successful candidate must have very strong analytical skills and expert in excel. Knowledge of SQL and tools like R/Python would be an added advantage. He/she will be experienced at working with large data sets and the technical tools needed to work with them. He/she will have superb communication and customer-relationship skills, good analytic insight, and be a passionate advocate of operations team to other stakeholders.   • You should be able to deal with a high degree of ambiguity
  • You should be able to take a complex problem and break it down to smaller digestible chunks

Description

Our organization spans three distinct Amazon India businesses — Amazon Business (comprising Self-Service Registered / SSR and CPS enterprise sales), Private Brands, and ReCommerce — each on a multi-million-dollar, WW-leading growth trajectory. Delivering that growth depends on executing large, complex, cross-organizational programs across CX, SX, sales, tech, pricing, supply chain, and operations, often with dependencies on Worldwide and partner teams. Increasingly, the most valuable of these programs are AI-powered — agentic buying assistants, AI-driven pricing and selection, intelligent automation across returns and recovery — so AI fluency is central to the role, even as the mandate spans the full breadth of the org's most critical programs.

We are hiring a Senior Technical Program Manager to own the most critical and complex programs across the portfolio, with a primary focus on Amazon Business (SSR and CPS) and targeted support for the largest, highest-complexity programs in Private Brands and ReCommerce. This is a senior, cross-cutting role spanning three separate businesses: you will drive alignment across engineering, product, and business leaders.Many of these programs are customer-facing AI products; others are platform, pricing, expansion, supply-chain, or compliance programs — you will own the hardest ones regardless of type.

You will inherit a portfolio of the org's marquee initiatives. Success looks like complex programs delivered on time across team boundaries, dependencies sequenced before they become blockers, and leadership given a single, trusted view of program health.

Key job responsibilities

Own the largest and most complex programs in Amazon Business (SSR and CPS) — the primary focus of the role — driving them end-to-end from definition through launch across engineering, product, pricing, GTMO/sales, and operations. These span customer-facing AI products as well as platform, pricing, expansion, and compliance programs.

Lead delivery of customer-facing AI experiences where they are on the critical path — turning fast-moving AI capabilities into shipped products with clear customer value — while applying the same rigor to the org's other complex, high-stakes programs.

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Requirement of this position is to perform electrical functional and validation testing of connectors and support engineering personnel to set up, execute, analyze, and report product testing in line with defined test procedures and lab safety requirements. The position requires to:

jobs.title: Director - Brand
jobs.description:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we've raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -
We are looking for Director of Brand to take full ownership of Sprinto's brand strategy and execution. In this role, you will architect Sprinto's brand narrative, voice, and positioning to position us as a credible, differentiated leader in the B2B SaaS market. You will drive storytelling across all customer-facing and internal touchpoints, ensuring a consistent and compelling brand experience everywhere our brand lives – from marketing campaigns, social media, and PR to our website, product UI, events, and even internal communications.

Working cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Design, Sales/GTM, and the executive leadership team, you'll align brand initiatives with business goals and ensure Sprinto's messaging is unified and impactful across all channels. This is a high-impact, high-ownership opportunity (and remote-friendly) for a seasoned brand leader to scale a B2B SaaS brand in a fast-moving startup environment.

Where you'll leave your mark

Brand Strategy and Architecture

  • Own Sprinto's brand architecture and positioning end-to-end – defining our brand pillars, values, and unique value proposition
  • Develop and refine our brand voice and visual identity guidelines to tell a compelling story in the market

Brand Storytelling


  • Craft and champion Sprinto's brand narrative and storytelling across all platforms
  • Oversee content and campaigns that communicate our mission and product story in an engaging way

Cross-Functional Leadership


  • Collaborate closely with Product Marketing, Demand Gen, Design, Sales (GTM), and other teams to infuse the brand into product launches, growth campaigns, and sales enablement
  • Ensure that every external touchpoint and internal initiative reflects a unified brand strategy aligned with business objectives

Social Media and Communications


  • Own Sprinto's social media strategy, PR, and communications programs
  • Drive our presence on LinkedIn, Twitter, and other relevant channels to build community and engagement
  • Manage public relations efforts, thought leadership content, and influencer/partner relationships

Creative Direction


  • Provide leadership on all creative output – from design of marketing assets and website experience to brand campaigns and videos
  • Ensure all creative materials (ads, collateral, event booths, etc.) adhere to brand guidelines
  • Manage external agencies or contractors in developing high-quality creative work

Brand Consistency and Governance


  • Establish and enforce brand guidelines to ensure consistency across all touchpoints
  • Audit customer-facing content and internal materials for brand consistency
  • Provide brand training and resources to enable company-wide adoption

Metrics and Continuous Improvement


  • Define key brand performance metrics (brand awareness, NPS, share of voice, engagement, etc.)
  • Monitor the health and impact of brand initiatives and report on KPIs to leadership
  • Use data-driven insights to continuously refine brand strategy and execution

The kind of builder we're looking for -

  • 10+ years of experience in brand marketing, brand management, or communications roles within B2B technology or SaaS companies
  • Proven track record of scaling a brand at a high-growth or mid-stage company
  • Deep expertise in brand strategy – architecture, positioning, messaging, tone of voice
  • Demonstrated success leading or contributing to major rebranding or brand elevation projects
  • Excellent collaboration and leadership skills; experience working cross-functionally with GTM, design, and executive teams
  • Strong understanding of the U.S. market and enterprise SaaS buying context
  • Hands-on experience in social media, PR, and communications strategy
  • Outstanding storytelling and writing skills; portfolio of content/campaigns is a plus
  • Experience managing creative teams and external agencies
  • Data-driven mindset with experience in brand metrics and campaign analysis
  • Comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced, high-ownership environment

How we care for our Sprinters


  • Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
  • Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
  • We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills
  • We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
  • Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
  • Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you

Inclusion & Diversity -
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.title: Senior Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
Job Title : Senior Social Media Manager

Location: Mumbai HO, In-office

Experience: 4+ years

ABOUT TRUEMEDS

At Truemeds, we're on a mission to make healthcare more affordable and accessible for millions of Indians. Every month, people are forced to choose between their health and their finances. We're changing that by helping customers discover trusted branded substitute medicines that can significantly reduce their monthly medicine bills, without compromising on quality.

As we continue to build one of India's fastest-growing healthcare brands, we're looking for a Senior Social Media Manager who can make Truemeds one of the most trusted, engaging and share-worthy healthcare brands on social media.

We're especially excited to build our YouTube presence from the ground up. If you've been part of a 0 to 1 YouTube growth journey for a brand, understand what it takes to build an audience from scratch, and know how to turn content into a long-term growth engine, this role is built for you.

This isn't a role for someone who simply schedules posts. We're looking for someone who understands culture, storytelling, community building, data and brand strategy, and knows how to bring them together to create meaningful impact.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Own Truemeds Social Presence

• Lead the overall social media strategy across Instagram and YouTube as the primary platforms, while acting as the trusted custodian of LinkedIn.

• Build a consistent, memorable and differentiated brand voice across every platform.

• Continuously answer, and improve upon, the question:

Why should anyone follow Truemeds

2. Build a Content Engine People Want to Share

• Translate the brand's positioning into social-first content that educates, entertains, inspires and gets shared.

• Develop platform-native content strategies instead of repurposing the same content across every platform.

• Identify opportunities around trends, topical moments, awareness days and cultural conversations, while ensuring relevance to the brand.

• Bring fresh content ideas across Reels, Shorts, videos, carousels, creator collaborations, educational content and storytelling formats.

3. Drive Social Growth

• Define monthly, quarterly and annual growth goals across followers, engagement, reach, video views, shares and community metrics.

• Own social media dashboards and regularly identify opportunities for improvement.

• Hold agency partners accountable for delivering agreed KPIs and continuously optimize performance.

• Own Instagram and YouTube growth goals, with clear accountability for engagement rate, follower growth, reach, watch time and audience retention.

• Drive the roadmap to scale YouTube to 800K subscribers in next 12–15 months and Instagram to 1M followers within the next 18 months, through meaningful content IPs, creator collaborations and consistent platform-first storytelling.

• Build repeatable content formats and owned IPs that contribute to sustained audience growth and long-term brand affinity.

4. Be the Brand Custodian

• Ensure brand consistency across every post, video, campaign and interaction.

• Maintain high creative standards while balancing speed with quality.

• Work closely with leadership to translate brand narratives into impactful social campaigns.

5. Collaborate Cross-Functionally

• Partner with Copywriters, Designers, Motion Designers, Video Editors and the Creative Director to build best-in-class content.

• Collaborate with Brand, Performance Marketing and CRM teams to create content that supports awareness, acquisition, engagement and retention objectives.

• Coordinate effectively with creative agencies, social media agencies and external production partners.

6. Community & Reputation Management

• Oversee community management and Online Reputation Management (ORM) across all social platforms.

• Develop response frameworks for customer interactions.

• Support crisis communication planning and ensure timely, brand-appropriate responses during sensitive situations.

7. Build an Influencer Ecosystem

• Develop and scale Truemeds influencer marketing program.

• Identify, onboard and nurture creators across healthcare, lifestyle, wellness, education and regional content categories.

• Work with agencies and internal teams to execute influencer campaigns, from ideation to reporting.

• Measure influencer effectiveness through meaningful brand and business metrics.

8. Support Brand & Performance Growth

• Understand how organic and paid social work together.

• Support Performance Marketing teams through content amplification, boosting strategies and creator-led campaigns.

• Recommend content formats that improve distribution, engagement and conversion, wherever relevant.

• Have a strong understanding of Meta Social Analytics, YouTube Analytics and platform-specific insights to inform content strategy and measure business impact.

9. Stay Curious About Healthcare

• Continuously learn about preventive healthcare, chronic disease management, wellness trends and pharmaceutical developments.

• Translate complex healthcare topics into content that's simple, trustworthy and engaging for everyday audiences.

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE IMPACTFUL

At Truemeds, social media isn't just another marketing channel. It's how millions of people will discover, trust and remember our brand.

You'll have the opportunity to:

• Shape the voice of one of India's fastest-growing healthcare brands.

• Build content that genuinely improves health awareness while driving business growth.

• Influence how millions of Indians think about affordable healthcare.

• Build communities, not just follower counts.

• Work across Brand, Performance Marketing, CRM and Leadership teams to create content that delivers real business impact.

• Help establish Truemeds as the most trusted healthcare brand on social media.

REQUIREMENTS

• 4+ years of experience managing social media for consumer-first brands, D2C brands or high-growth startups.

• Strong understanding of Instagram, YouTube and LinkedIn content ecosystems.

• Proven experience developing and executing social media strategies that drive measurable growth.

• Strong understanding of content planning, storytelling, platform algorithms and audience behaviour.

• Experience working with creative teams, copywriters, designers, video editors and agencies.

• Ability to evaluate creative quality and provide actionable feedback across copy, design and video.

• Hands-on expertise with YouTube Analytics and Meta Social Analytics, with the ability to translate data into actionable content and growth strategies.

• Working knowledge of Meta Creator Marketplace and Google Creator Hub, with experience discovering, evaluating and collaborating with creators.

• Demonstrated experience contributing to or leading a 0 to 1 YouTube growth journey for a consumer brand is highly preferred.

• Proven ability to define and improve engagement rate, audience retention, subscriber growth and follower growth through content-led strategies.

• Experience managing agency relationships and driving accountability against defined KPIs.

• Familiarity with ORM, social listening and crisis communication.

• Understanding of paid social, content boosting and influencer-led distribution strategies.

• Excellent project management and stakeholder management skills.

• A strong bias for ownership, experimentation and continuous improvement.

GOOD TO HAVE

• Experience working with healthcare, health-tech, pharma or wellness brands.

• Experience building and scaling influencer marketing programs.

• Knowledge of chronic disease management, preventive healthcare and health education.

• Experience collaborating closely with Performance Marketing and CRM teams.

• Familiarity with social listening tools and analytics platforms.

• Understanding of video-first content production and the creator economy.

• Passion for building communities and brands that people genuinely trust.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within your first year, you will have:

• Successfully scaled YouTube from 0 to 800K subscribers through a sustainable, content-first strategy.

• Helped grow Instagram to 1M followers within 18 months, supported by meaningful content IPs and a highly engaged community.

• Built recurring content franchises that audiences actively follow, share and return to.

• Established a scalable influencer marketing program.

• Improved engagement rate, reach, watch time, shares and community interactions across platforms.

• Positioned Truemeds as a trusted, educational and highly shareable healthcare brand.

WHAT A DAY IN THIS ROLE LOOKS LIKE

On any given day, you could be:

• Reviewing Instagram, YouTube and LinkedIn performance to uncover growth opportunities.

• Brainstorming with the Creative Director, copywriters and designers on content that's insightful, engaging and share-worthy.

• Planning and reviewing content with internal teams and agency partners to ensure every post reflects the Truemeds brand.

• Spotting trends, topical moments and healthcare conversations and turning them into timely content.

• Collaborating with Performance Marketing and CRM teams to amplify high-performing content.

• Reviewing influencer partnerships, creator briefs and campaign performance.

• Monitoring community conversations, ORM and brand sentiment, while responding to critical issues when needed.

• Tracking key social media metrics, identifying what's working and optimizing the content strategy accordingly.

• Challenging one simple question every day: Why should anyone follow Truemeds and making sure your work keeps answering it.

jobs.title: Business Development Lead - India (Multiple Locations)
jobs.description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

This role is being hired across four locations: Bangalore, Mumbai, Delhi, and Chennai.

Meet The Team

Join our dynamic Dexcom team and help transform diabetes management across India through innovative Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) technology. As the Business Development Lead – India, you will play a pivotal role in driving market awareness, customer adoption, and business growth for Dexcom's CGM solutions across primary care, diabetes specialists, healthcare institutions, and allied healthcare professionals.

This position is responsible for developing and executing market development strategies that expand Dexcom's presence and accelerate CGM adoption across the Indian healthcare landscape. You will build and nurture strategic relationships with healthcare professionals, key opinion leaders, healthcare organizations, channel partners, and other stakeholders to increase patient access to Dexcom technologies.

Where You Come In

Market Development & Growth

  • Drive territory growth and CGM adoption across healthcare providers and institutions.
  • Identify new business opportunities and expand Dexcom's market presence.
  • Achieve territory KPIs, and market share objectives
  • Ensure health and hygiene of demand fulfilment on the shelves, channel management & product availability

Healthcare Professional Engagement

  • Build strong relationships with endocrinologists, diabetologists, physicians, diabetes educators, hospitals, and healthcare networks.
  • Promote Dexcom CGM through clinical discussions, education, and product demonstrations.
  • Support integration of CGM technology into routine patient care.
  • Deliver product training, workshops, webinars, and onboarding support.
  • Serve as a trusted resource for clinical, product, and technical expertise.

Marketing & Business Operations

  • Manage strategic accounts, KOLs, hospitals, and diabetes centers.
  • Develop account plans to strengthen partnerships and improve patient access.
  • Foster loyalty & Ensure high customer satisfaction through effective support and issue resolution.
  • Represent Dexcom at conferences, workshops, and scientific events.
  • Execute marketing initiatives, track territory performance, and analyze market opportunities.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, forecasts, and business reports.
  • Partner with Marketing, Medical Affairs, Clinical Education, Patient Support, and Operations teams.
  • Share market insights and contribute to strategic business initiatives.

What Makes You Successful

  • You will be successful in this role if you can excel in the traits of business development, customer relationship management, market expansion, channel partner engagement, and operational excellence within the assigned territory by strengthening Dexcom's market position with strict adherence to company compliance policies, industry standards, and applicable Indian laws and regulations.
  • You are expected to have a Batchlor degree in science / engineering / pharmacy / biomedical engineering and a relevant experience of 10-15 years
  • You must have hands-on experience in relevant cardio-metabolic / diabetology market in India leading initiatives to enhance healthcare professional education, patient awareness campaigns, new product launch & adoption strategies. You must be adaptable to work as individual contributor, across different geographies with necessary traveling within a month and think out of the box.
  • Your experience in CGM business and experience in Medtech space will be a good add-on in your candidature.

What You'll Get

  • A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community.
  • A full and comprehensive benefits program.

  • Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.

jobs.title: Content Research Intern
jobs.description:
About KeyValue

KeyValue is a product development startup building highly scalable web and enterprise software. Our team specializes in building and scaling digital products from the ground up.

About Pickle.ai

Pickle.ai is a product developed by KeyValue. We're building a mobile app that helps users create beautiful AI-generated videos and photos from their own pictures using ready-to-use templates.

Users can choose a template, upload a photo, and get a personalized AI-generated creation ready to share on WhatsApp, Instagram, and other social platforms.

As a Content Research Intern, you'll be responsible for spotting what's trending across social media and identifying ideas that can be turned into engaging AI templates for Pickle.ai.

You'll closely follow Instagram and other social platforms, understand what different audiences are engaging with, and convert promising trends into clear creative ideas for the AI template team.

What You'll Do

  • Track trending content, memes, visual styles, formats, audio, and creative concepts across social platforms
  • Identify emerging trends early and evaluate whether they are relevant for Pickle.ai
  • Research trends across different Indian regions, languages, cultures, and audiences
  • Identify trends that can be converted into reusable templates where users personalize the content with their own photos
  • Develop creative ideas inspired by current social media trends
  • Create simple creative briefs including references, mood, target audience, and expected output
  • Share relevant references and examples with the AI template team
  • Maintain a pipeline of upcoming and trending content ideas
  • Observe how launched templates perform and identify patterns in what users engage with
  • Use performance learnings to recommend new template ideas
  • Work closely with the content and marketing team.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong understanding of social media culture and current trends
  • Someone who actively follows Instagram, Reels, memes, creators, and internet culture
  • Ability to spot emerging trends and understand why certain content becomes popular
  • Awareness of trends across different Indian regions and languages
  • Creative thinking and ability to convert trends into content ideas
  • Good written communication skills and ability to explain ideas clearly
  • Basic familiarity with AI-generated images/videos is an advantage
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where trends and priorities change quickly
  • Recently completed a degree in Media, Marketing, Communication, Design, or a related field.

What You'll Gain

  • Hands-on experience in social media trend research
  • Exposure to AI-powered consumer content creation
  • Experience converting trends into real product features and templates
  • Understanding of how social trends perform with real users
  • Direct collaboration with the content, marketing, and AI teams
  • Experience taking an idea from trend discovery to a live AI template

Main Responsibilities

The overall purpose and main responsibilities are listed below:

  • Scientific Engagement
    • Support the development of the integrated strategy for scientific expert engagement; scientific congress, scientific events and medical education; scientific dissemination; and multichannel engagement (in collaboration with global and local colleagues covering this area) for the assigned therapeutic area/products.
    • Ensure timely execution of the scientific dissemination, scientific expert engagement, and medical multichannel engagement plans for global and countries.
    • Support the development of engagement plans by identifying new multi-channel customer facing/engagement initiatives that will enhance the customer experience for scientific and medical learning and improvement of patient care, incorporating patient-centric perspectives and patient-reported outcomes (PROs).
    • Closely track emerging and evolving digital technologies across industries, with a focus on healthcare & pharmaceutical industries, leveraging proof of concept to test ideas and channels.
    • Support the development and expansion of a network of experts in the disease areas of responsibility through expert/KOL mapping activities that includes identification, profiling, and segmentation of international experts including emerging leaders and rising stars. Work closely with geographic segments/regions and countries to harmonize expert mapping activities and engagement plans.
    • Establish and maintain professional and collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders, KOLs, scientific and academic societies, patient association and advocacy groups, medical communication and strategy companies involved.
    • Attend the medical meetings, advisory boards, outreach meetings at key institutions, and interact with key experts, academic societies, and advocacy groups.
    • Support the management and oversight of Scientific Congresses / Events, Donations and Other Contributions, advisory board planning & organization, compliance & transparency requirements.

  • Scientific Publications and Medical Communications
    • Support the development and oversight of strategic scientific publication plans and execution of operational and tactical activities within the overall medical communication platforms for assigned products/disease areas of responsibility (including HEVA and PDMD research outputs such as patient-reported outcomes, qualitative patient studies, and real-world evidence).
    • Support the planning and proposal of content deliverables aligned with the strategic imperatives supporting the assigned products/disease areas. This includes reviewing and identifying relevant clinical findings, disease burden, unmet needs, patient-reported outcomes, and then proposing the development of corresponding compelling content.
    • Serve as a key scientific reviewer, performing thorough quality control, scientific/clinical accuracy checks, and peer review of all draft manuscripts, abstracts, posters, slide decks, and value communication documents prior to stakeholder/author circulation.
