jobs.title: Supplier Quality Inspector
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Supplier Quality Inspector based in India.

This role is responsible for ensuring the quality, conformity, and reliability of components sourced from external suppliers.

You will oversee inspection, supplier quality development, audits, and corrective actions across castings, forgings, patterns, machined parts, and mechanical components.

The position combines hands-on technical inspection with supplier development and cross-functional quality leadership.

You will work closely with suppliers and internal Engineering, Manufacturing, Procurement, Project Management, and Quality teams to resolve complex quality issues.

Your expertise will help ensure compliance with engineering specifications, industry standards, regulatory requirements, and customer expectations.

With significant travel to supplier locations, you will have a direct impact on manufacturing capability, defect prevention, and continuous improvement.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of supplier quality in a technically demanding manufacturing environment where sound judgment and rigorous problem-solving are highly valued.

Accountabilities

  • Manage incoming and source inspection activities for bought-out items, including castings, forgings, patterns, machined components, fabricated parts, and mechanical instruments.
  • Review supplier quality documentation such as inspection reports, quality plans, Material Test Certificates (MTCs), manufacturing records, dimensional reports, and NDT documentation.
  • Verify supplier compliance with engineering drawings, specifications, GD&T requirements, dimensional tolerances, surface-finish requirements, material specifications, applicable standards, and internal quality procedures.
  • Conduct and support supplier process reviews to assess manufacturing capability, process controls, repeatability, and consistency of product quality.
  • Develop, implement, and support supplier SOPs, inspection plans, process risk assessments, and appropriate mitigation actions.
  • Identify and investigate supplier quality issues during manufacturing, ensuring effective containment, root cause analysis, corrective action, and prevention of recurrence.
  • Lead supplier NCR management, including root cause analysis, CAPA, effectiveness verification, and timely closure.
  • Plan and conduct supplier audits for qualification, periodic assessment, quality-performance improvement, and resolution of recurring problems.
  • Coordinate and evaluate applicable NDT/NDE activities, including Visual Testing (VT), Magnetic Particle Testing (MT), Penetrant Testing (PT), Ultrasonic Testing (UT), Radiographic Testing (RT), Positive Material Identification (PMI), and hardness testing.
  • Coordinate third-party inspection activities, including scheduling, inspection readiness, documentation review, and follow-up on observations and nonconformities.
  • Ensure supplier compliance with ISO 9001:2015, API, ASME, ASTM, ISO, applicable material standards, customer requirements, and internal quality procedures.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Manufacturing, Procurement, Project Management, and Quality teams to resolve technical and supplier-related quality concerns.
  • Maintain clear communication regarding inspection status, quality risks, corrective-action progress, and potential delivery impacts.
  • Drive supplier development and continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen process capability, reduce recurring defects, improve process controls, and prevent quality issues.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 6 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Supplier Quality, or Inspection within manufacturing, metal-mechanical, pumps, casting, forging, fabrication, or heavy-engineering environments.
  • Hands-on inspection experience with castings, forgings, patterns, machined components, fabricated components, and related mechanical parts.
  • Strong ability to interpret engineering drawings, GD&T, dimensional requirements, surface-finish specifications, material requirements, and inspection standards.
  • Proven experience reviewing MTCs, inspection reports, NDT reports, dimensional reports, and other supplier quality documentation.
  • Strong knowledge of API, ASME, ASTM, ISO standards, material standards, and ISO 9001:2015 quality-management-system requirements.
  • Strong knowledge of ASME Sections II, V, VIII, and IX.
  • NDT Level II certification and practical experience with relevant methods such as VT, MT, PT, UT, RT, PMI, and hardness testing are preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting supplier audits and managing NCRs, CAPA, root cause analysis, and supplier corrective-action follow-up.
  • Experience with pump, pressure-containing equipment, or rotating-equipment manufacturing is preferred.
  • Familiarity with third-party inspection agencies and customer inspection requirements.
  • Experience applying structured quality and problem-solving tools, including 5 Why, Fishbone, 8D, PFMEA, Control Plans, and Process Capability Analysis.
  • Strong analytical thinking, ownership, accountability, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively across supplier and internal cross-functional teams and communicate technical quality issues clearly.
  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 70% to supplier locations for inspections, audits, supplier development, and quality issue resolution.
  • Candidates located in or around the Kolhapur or Sangli region are preferred.

Benefits

  • Employment type: Full-time position.
  • Work arrangement: Work-from-home based in India, with substantial travel to supplier locations.
  • Travel exposure: Approximately 70% travel across various supplier locations, providing broad exposure to manufacturing and quality environments.
  • Professional development: Opportunity to deepen expertise in supplier quality, inspection, auditing, NDT/NDE, and international engineering and quality standards.
  • Cross-functional exposure: Direct collaboration with Engineering, Manufacturing, Procurement, Project Management, Quality, suppliers, and third-party inspection agencies.
  • Technical scope: Exposure to complex components and manufacturing processes including castings, forgings, machining, fabrication, pumps, and pressure-containing or rotating equipment.
  • Impact and ownership: Significant responsibility for supplier performance, product conformity, defect prevention, corrective actions, and continuous improvement.

Share observations with district officials (e.g.,DM&HOs/DIOs) for corrective actions. jobs.title: Tax Compliance Program Manager, Tax and Account Compliance
jobs.description:
Description

We are seeking a Tax Compliance Program Manager to support the First Line of Defense (1LoD) for EU/UK tax compliance across Amazon's Marketplace business. In this role, you will execute against defined risk workstreams, support governance processes, and deliver control activities arising from EU and UK tax regulations. Working within established risk frameworks and under the guidance of senior programme leaders, you will contribute to ensuring the business operates within clearly defined risk appetite and compliance standards.

You will support the identification, assessment, and mitigation of tax compliance risks across Amazon's Global Selling ecosystem. This includes executing operational controls aligned to EU/UK regulatory requirements, maintaining risk documentation, tracking programme deliverables, and escalating emerging risks through appropriate channels. You will monitor regulatory developments and assess their operational implications, contributing analysis that informs programme-level decisions.

Your focus will be on maintaining preventative controls, supporting data integrity across tax and identity systems, and producing audit-ready documentation. Working cross-functionally with Legal, Policy, Product, Tax, and Data Science partners, you will execute against programme plans, support the resolution of systemic issues, and contribute to risk-based control frameworks. You will ensure compliance activities within your workstreams are proportionate, risk-calibrated, and delivered on time and to the expected quality bar.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own defined workstreams within EU and UK tax compliance programmes, delivering risk assessments and control activities on time and to quality standards
  • Execute risk assessments using established methodologies, documenting findings clearly and escalating issues that exceed defined thresholds
  • Analyze EU/UK tax compliance regulations (e.g., VAT, DAC7, JSL, Deemed Reseller) and their implications for Amazon sellers, translating requirements into actionable deliverables
  • Support the development and maintenance of risk models and detection mechanisms to identify non-compliant or fraudulent seller behaviour related to tax obligations
  • Collaborate with legal, policy, finance, tax, tech, and product teams to execute programme plans and deliver operational controls for new and existing programmes
  • Track key risk indicators (KRIs) and programme metrics, producing status reports and flagging deviations to programme leadership
  • Prepare risk assessments, programme updates, and supporting materials for senior leadership reviews
  • Maintain audit-ready documentation and contribute to continuous improvement of risk and programme processes

A day in the life

You are joining a global team spread across the US, EU, Japan, and India. You will partner closely with a Tax Governance manager in the UK and collaborate heavily with Risk teams based in India and the EU to ensure Amazon's compliance controls are in the best possible working order.

Your days will blend regulatory analysis, cross-functional delivery, and stakeholder coordination across multiple time zones. One morning you are reviewing control effectiveness with the 2nd Line of Defence; the afternoon you are in a working session with EU 3P Marketplace partners assessing the impact of a new VAT regulation on sellers. The next day you are preparing materials for a senior leadership review or troubleshooting a data integrity issue with tech partners in Seattle.

No two days are the same, but the constant is pace, impact, and global reach.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Experience in compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent
  • 5+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
  • 2+ years of program or project management experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
  • Experience using lean process improvement, six sigma methodologies, or related performance metrics/process improvements to increase efficiency within processes, forecasting, planning, optimization, or logistics
  • Knowledge of knowledge of VAT in EU/UK
  • Master's degree or equivalent
  • - Experience in tax, regulatory compliance, or financial services risk management

jobs.title: Director of CAD & IT
jobs.description:
Cspeed IO is a stealth start up backed by Sutter Hill Ventures and Atreides Capital - headquartered in Palo Alto, CA. Our executive team has a demonstrated track record of building and scaling category-defining semiconductor and infrastructure businesses at companies like Broadcom, Lumentum, Tesla, Apple, Samsung, Intel, and VMware.

Cspeed IO is developing next-generation optical semiconductor solutions for the AI infrastructure market, focused on enabling true scale-up architectures. Our mission is to replace traditional copper interconnects with advanced fiber-optic technologies that overcome the limitations of existing optics solutions and architectures.

A build role spanning three intertwined domains: design infrastructure (the CAD, compute, and EDA environment our silicon depends on), corporate IT (identity, endpoints, connectivity, and SaaS for a five-site global company), and the security program that spans both. There is no internal IT department today — the environment is MSP-supported and the architecture is yours to define. You will operate an EDA environment representing $5–10M in annual spend, a three-zone infrastructure model (Corporate, Design/CAD, Lab/OT) governed by export-control classification. CAD and IT carry equal weight, and security is required within both: our technology is export-controlled, our customers are the most security-demanding infrastructure buyers on earth, and there is no CISO above this role. And we expect aggression on AI: this role drives aggressive AI use and adoption across the company rather than waiting to be asked.

What You Will Own

  • Design infrastructure & CAD. Design compute (batch scheduling, cloud burst), EDA licensing operations — license servers, utilization telemetry, denial-rate and cost-per-seat reporting; contract and IP negotiation stays with company leadership — the access-controlled PDK enclave, design data management, and storage engineered for EDA workloads.
  • Corporate IT. Identity as a system (single IdP, SAML/SCIM, conditional access, hardware-key MFA), the global Windows/macOS/Linux endpoint fleet under unified MDM, WAN across five sites, the SaaS portfolio and its spend, and the MSP managed against an SLA you write.
  • Security across both zones. EDR on every host including Linux design machines; the outsourced security stack — SOC/MDR partner and SIEM — where you own the outcome and they own the night shift; phishing-resistant MFA; incident response end to end across time zones; segmentation between zones; customer security reviews answered unaided.
  • Export-controlled environments. Operate the design zone under our Technology Control Plan: deemed-export access controls with per-nationality entitlements, logging, quarterly access reviews, and audit-ready evidence.
  • AI adoption. Drive aggressive AI use across engineering and corporate workflows — pick the tools, build the guardrails that make AI safe inside an export-controlled environment, and lead by using it yourself. The job is to make yes safe, not to say no.

First-Year Outcomes

Day 90: asset and access inventory across five sites; EDR on every Windows and Linux host; hardware-key MFA on privileged accounts; MSP SLA rewritten.

Day 180: outsourced SOC/MDR live with SIEM ingesting both zones; identity on a single IdP; PDK enclave access model live; first hire started.

Day 365: incident response tabletop run; a hyperscaler security review passed unaided; license telemetry feeding leadership's renewal decisions.

Must Have

  • CAD: 10+ years in semiconductor design infrastructure at a fabless or IDM; ran design compute, EDA licensing operations at $5–10M scale, and PDK/design-data management; supported tape-outs under deadline.
  • IT: ran identity as a system (SAML/SCIM, conditional access, hardware keys); managed a multi-country Windows/macOS/Linux fleet; managed an MSP against an SLA they wrote; completed customer security questionnaires unaided.
  • Security: operated EDR across mixed Windows/Linux fleets; personally owned a real incident end to end; ran security through outsourced SOC/MDR and SIEM vendors and owned the detection outcome anyway; built access-controlled environments for sensitive IP.
  • Across all of it: built from near-zero at least once; an aggressive, hands-on adopter of AI in their own work; effective across Asia time zones with a small team plus vendors; translates technical risk into executive decisions; a U.S. person or eligible for required export authorizations.

What This Role Is Not

Not a caretaker role, not a single-discipline role, not the EDA contract owner, and not paper security — this role runs the controls, it does not just document them.

Preferred: TCP/deemed-export operating experience; Defender, Intune, and Entra conditional access in production; FreeIPA in Linux design environments; ISO 27001, SOC 2, or NIST 800-171 exposure.

jobs.title: Biochemist
jobs.description:
Biochemist – AI Data Trainer

About The Role

Your deep expertise in biochemistry is exactly what the next generation of AI needs. At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research teams to build smarter, more scientifically rigorous models — and we need PhD-level biochemists to make it happen.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role where your scientific knowledge directly shapes how AI reasons about protein folding, metabolic flux, enzyme kinetics, and beyond. No AI background required — just deep domain expertise and a sharp analytical mind.

  • Organization: Alignerr
  • Type: Hourly Contract
  • Location: Remote
  • Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

  • Design Challenging Problems — Craft advanced biochemistry problems spanning nucleic acid chemistry, proteomics, structural biology, and drug-target interactions to rigorously test AI performance
  • Author Ground-Truth Solutions — Develop precise, step-by-step technical solutions that serve as benchmarks for high-level scientific reasoning in AI systems
  • Audit AI Outputs — Evaluate AI-generated biochemical pathways, molecular structures, and mathematical reasoning for technical accuracy and adherence to scientific standards
  • Identify and Fix Reasoning Errors — Spot logical flaws like incorrect stoichiometry, misapplied stereochemistry, or flawed mechanistic reasoning, and provide structured feedback to improve AI thinking

Who You Are

  • PhD-level expertise in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, or a closely related field (completed or in final stages)
  • Strong foundational knowledge in areas such as structural biology, enzymology, cellular metabolism, or bioinformatics
  • Ability to communicate highly technical concepts clearly and concisely in written form
  • High attention to detail when reviewing chemical equations, molecular diagrams, and experimental logic
  • No prior AI experience required — we'll provide everything you need to get started

Nice to Have

  • Experience with data annotation, evaluation, or quality assurance workflows
  • Familiarity with computational biochemistry tools such as PyMOL, AlphaFold, or BLAST
  • Background in scientific writing, peer review, or technical editing

Why Join Us

  • Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside top research labs and scientists
  • Fully remote and asynchronous — work on your own schedule, from anywhere
  • Freelance perks: autonomy, flexibility, and collaboration with a global expert community
  • Meaningful impact — your expertise helps ensure AI gets the science right
  • Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

  • Establish data definitions and ownership for each ranking indicator.

3. Ranking Methodology Analysis

  • Continuously monitor changes in ranking methodologies.
  • Benchmark Woxsen against peer institutions.
  • Conduct indicator-level gap analysis.
  • Identify where Woxsen is underperforming, overperforming or failing to receive credit for existing performance.

4. Data Validation & Audit

  • Ensure every submitted ranking figure is supported by an auditable institutional source.
  • Establish a source → calculation → submission trail for major indicators.
  • Conduct pre-submission quality checks.
  • Reconcile ranking data with AACSB, NIRF, NAAC, annual reports, websites and other institutional submissions.
  • Maintain historical datasets to enable year-on-year trend analysis.

5. Institutional Data Collection

Coordinate with:

Schools | R&D | HR | Admissions | Placements | Alumni | International Relations | Finance | IQAC | Marketing | Library | Sustainability | IT

to establish systematic data collection.

The Manager will not merely request data; they will build repeatable systems through which the data becomes available automatically or routinely.

6. Benchmarking & Competitor Intelligence

Maintain a defined peer group of Indian and international universities/business schools.

Track:

  • Rankings
  • Faculty strength
  • Research productivity
  • Citations
  • Internationalisation
  • Student quality
  • Employability
  • Partnerships
  • Accreditation
  • Programme portfolio
  • Sustainability
  • Reputation
  • Emerging institutional strengths

Produce periodic Woxsen vs. Peer Benchmarking Reports.

7. Ranking Performance Analytics

Develop dashboards showing:

Current position → historical position → peer position → indicator performance → gap → improvement opportunity

Use Excel/Power BI/Tableau or equivalent tools to create management dashboards.

The role should be able to answer questions such as:

Why did our ranking move

Which three indicators are holding us back

What would need to improve for us to move into the next ranking band

Which data are we currently not receiving credit for

8. Reputation & Survey Management

Support institutional efforts around:

  • Academic reputation surveys
  • Employer reputation surveys
  • Faculty/expert databases
  • Alumni engagement
  • International partner engagement
  • Corporate relationships

Develop systematic and ethically compliant engagement mechanisms to improve response rates and institutional visibility.

No manipulation, fabricated responses or misrepresentation of institutional information will be permitted.

9. Research & Bibliometric Analytics

Work closely with the R&D Office to monitor:

  • Scopus/WoS publications
  • Citations
  • FWCI
  • h-index
  • International co-authorship
  • Institutional affiliations
  • Highly cited papers
  • Research collaboration
  • Journal quality
  • Field-weighted performance

Identify publication-affiliation or database issues that may cause Woxsen to lose legitimate ranking credit.

10. Internationalisation Analytics

Develop institutional datasets covering:

  • International students
  • International faculty
  • International partnerships
  • Student mobility
  • Faculty mobility
  • International research collaborations
  • Joint programmes
  • International placements
  • Global academic engagements

Ensure that definitions are aligned with the relevant ranking methodology.

11. Reporting to Leadership

Prepare:

  • Monthly rankings dashboard
  • Quarterly institutional benchmarking report
  • Ranking-specific readiness reports
  • Annual rankings strategy
  • Executive summaries for senior leadership
  • Red-flag reports on data gaps
  • Recommendations for institutional improvement

The role should convert complex datasets into clear management decisions.

Key Deliverables

The successful candidate will be expected to establish and maintain:

Rankings Master Dashboard

A single institutional view of all major ranking indicators.

Rankings Data Dictionary

Clear definition, source, owner and calculation methodology for every major metric.

Rankings Calendar

All submission dates, surveys, data requirements and institutional owners.

Peer Benchmarking Dashboard

Woxsen versus selected national and international peers.

Ranking Gap Analysis

Top weaknesses, opportunities and recommended interventions.

Five-Year Rankings Database

Historical data enabling trend and trajectory analysis.

Ranking Submission Audit File

Evidence supporting every major submitted figure.

Candidate Profile

Education

Experience

You'll lead requirements gathering, process mapping, and data analysis for projects across the life sciences value chain (e.g., R&D, Clinical Trials, Manufacturing, Commercialization, Regulatory Affairs). Your expertise in life sciences operations, regulatory compliance (e.g., FDA, EMA, GxP), and industry trends will drive the design and implementation of impactful solutions, ensuring alignment with business objectives and delivering measurable value to our clients. You'll mentor junior analysts and champion best practices within the team.

Role & Responsibilities:

As a Senior Business Analyst specializing in the Healthcare & Life Sciences (HCLS) domain, with a focus on Life Sciences operations, you will play a pivotal role in understanding, analyzing, and translating complex business needs into actionable technology solutions. You will act as a key liaison between business stakeholders, technical teams, and project management, ensuring successful delivery of initiatives that enhance efficiency, compliance, and innovation within the life sciences landscape.

Requirements Elicitation & Analysis:

  • Lead and facilitate workshops, interviews, and brainstorming sessions with diverse stakeholders (e.g., R&D scientists, clinical operations, manufacturing, regulatory affairs, commercial teams) to elicit, document, and prioritize detailed business requirements.

  • Analyze current state processes, identify pain points, and propose future state solutions, leveraging deep understanding of life sciences operations (e.g., drug discovery, clinical trial management, manufacturing processes, supply chain, pharmacovigilance, commercial launch).

  • Translate high-level business needs into clear, concise, and unambiguous functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, use cases, and process flows (BPMN).

Solution Design & Strategy:

  • Collaborate with architects, developers, and product owners to design and validate technical solutions that meet business requirements and align with organizational strategy and industry best practices.

  • Evaluate potential solutions, including commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) products (e.g., LIMS, CTMS, EDMS, QMS, CRM) and custom development, performing gap analyses and recommending optimal approaches.

  • Contribute to the development of business cases, ROI analyses, and project roadmaps.

Life Sciences Domain Expertise & Compliance:

  • Apply in-depth knowledge of life sciences regulations (e.g., FDA, EMA, GxP - GLP, GCP, GMP, GDP, GVP, 21 CFR Part 11, ICH guidelines) to ensure all solutions are compliant and mitigate risks.

  • Understand and articulate the impact of industry trends such as precision medicine, digital therapeutics, RWE (Real-World Evidence), AI/ML in drug discovery, patient engagement, and supply chain optimization on life sciences operations.

  • Provide subject matter expertise on various life sciences segments (e.g., Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, Medical Devices, Diagnostics, CROs).

Stakeholder Management & Communication:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders, managing expectations, resolving conflicts, and ensuring alignment throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences and business implications to technical teams effectively.

  • Prepare and deliver presentations, reports, and documentation to various levels of management and project teams.

Testing & Quality Assurance Support:

  • Define acceptance criteria and support the creation of test plans and test cases.

  • Participate in user acceptance testing (UAT) and defect triage, ensuring solutions meet business requirements and quality standards.

Documentation & Artifacts:

  • Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, including Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), process maps, data flow diagrams, and user manuals.

Must Have Skills:

  • Requirements Expertise: Elicitation, documentation, prioritization (JIRA, Azure DevOps, Confluence).

  • Process Modeling: Current/future state, optimization (BPMN, Visio, Lucidchart).

Location: Mumbai, India

Role Overview

PxD is looking for a Senior Program Manager to build and lead an embedded Project Management Unit (PMU) within the Ministry of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra. You will lead a portfolio of work spanning the use of AI for Agriculture, evidence-based policy support, and scaling of digital technologies to improve the livelihoods and resilience of smallholder farmers across Maharashtra. The PMU exists to provide demand-driven support to the Department, responding to its priorities on AI-enabled decision-making and inclusive service access for farmers, and will work across multiple parallel workstreams spanning technology deployment, data and analytics, and public-sector service delivery. You will build and lead a cross-functional team spanning policy staff, data scientists, technologists, program and research staff. This position is based in Mumbai, with regular engagement and travel to Pune and district-level offices.

About PxD

PxD is a rapidly scaling global non-profit that harnesses the power of technology, data science, and behavioral economics to provide targeted information to farmers in low- and middle-income countries. Providing the right information to the right people, in the right way and at the right time, increases incomes, protects the environment, and improves well-being. We are evidence-based: we test our interventions with randomized controlled trials to prove our impact and cost-effectiveness, and to simultaneously learn from and improve our service. Few interventions are as cost-effective as ours.

jobs.description:
Cowbell is signalling a new era in cyber insurance by harnessing technology and data to provide small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) with advanced warning of cyber risk exposures bundled with cyber insurance coverage adaptable to the threats of today and tomorrow. Championing adaptive insurance, Cowbell follows policyholders cyber risk exposures as they evolve through continuous risk assessment and continuous underwriting. Founded in 2019 and based in the San Francisco Bay Area, Cowbell has rapidly grown, now operating across the U.S., Canada, U.K., and India. This growth was recently bolstered by a successful Series C fundraising round of $60 million from Zurich Insurance. This investment not only underscores the confidence in Cowbell's mission but also accelerates our capacity to revolutionize cyber insurance on a global scale. With the backing of over 25 prominent reinsurance partners, Cowbell is poised to redefine how SMEs navigate the evolving landscape of cyber threats.

Cowbell Cyber is hiring a Cyber Security Researcher to join our Data Science team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Security Research & Testing: Conduct in-depth security assessments and manual penetration testing of web apps, APIs, and cloud services. Perform source code reviews and analyze proprietary applications for flaws (e.g., injection, authorization issues, business logic abuse, misconfigurations). Develop custom tooling and Proof-of-Concept (POC) exploits to validate findings.
  • Vulnerability Discovery: Research emerging attack techniques, exploit chains, and zero-day vulnerabilities in internal applications and supporting systems. Conduct threat modeling and evaluate software supply chain and dependency risks.
  • Engineering Collaboration: Partner with engineering teams throughout the SDLC to provide secure coding guidance, support architecture reviews, and integrate security testing into CI/CD pipelines. Contribute to internal security standards.
  • Reporting: Document vulnerabilities, exploitability, and remediation guidance in clear reports. Present findings to stakeholders, track remediation efforts, and verify fixes.

Required Qualifications


  • 5+ years of experience in application security, vulnerability research, or offensive security.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong knowledge of secure development practices, manual security assessments, and source code reviews.
  • Deep understanding of: OWASP Top 10, API Security Top 10, modern web application architectures, secure authentication and authorization models, and cloud security fundamentals.
  • Proficiency with one or more programming languages (Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript).
  • Strong understanding of Linux, networking, and web protocols; experience using common security testing tools.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience discovering novel vulnerabilities, participating in bug bounty/disclosure programs, or background in exploit development/reverse engineering.
  • Knowledge of modern cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), container security/Kubernetes, and building custom security tooling.
  • Experience with current vulnerability research tools ( i.e. Burp Suite, Nuclei, Ghidra).
  • Public vulnerability research, conference presentations, blog posts, or published CVEs.

Preferred Certifications


One or more of the following:

  • OSCP
  • OSWE
  • OSEP
  • GXPN
  • Relevant GIAC certifications

Success Metrics (Within the first 12 months)

  • Identify and validate critical and high-risk vulnerabilities before production impact.
  • Improve application security posture through proactive research and testing.
  • Reduce vulnerability remediation timelines through effective collaboration.
  • Develop repeatable testing methodologies and security automation.
  • Contribute meaningful research into emerging threats.

Equal Employment Opportunity:


We are committed to equal opportunity in the terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - Core Network Delivery & MNO Onboarding
jobs.description:
The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.

Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.

Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.

At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.

When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.

This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works

This role is located in Bangalore, India where we are onsite 3 days a week in office. You will collaborate with a high-velocity, global team spanning multiple time zones.

How You Will Impact Skylo

You will own end-to-end program delivery across the three systems that determine whether an MNO partner can be onboarded, whether traffic flows correctly, and whether it settles correctly: the packet core, the signalling plane, and billing & settlement. You sit at the seam between Network Engineering, Product, Solutions Engineering, Finance/Billing, and external partners (MNOs, IPX providers, clearing houses, roaming suppliers), and you are accountable for turning a growing partner pipeline into predictable, on-time technical delivery.

This is a builder's role. You will be defining the onboarding program, the release cadence, and the launch-readiness bar — not inheriting a mature machine.v

What You'll Do

  • wn the MNO technical onboarding program end-to-end from the core/signalling/billing lens — integration milestones, dependencies, Definitions of Done, and cutover plans across the partner lifecycle.
  • Drive signalling delivery programs: Diameter interfaces (S6a, SGd), MAP-over-IPX via IWF, DRA configuration and routing policy, SMS-over-NAS enablement, and roaming signalling readiness per partner.
  • Coordinate billing & settlement programs: TAP3 / RAP / NRTRDE exchange, BCE readiness, mediation and rating, CDR integrity and reconciliation, and integration with settlement and finance systems.
  • Program-manage the multi-supplier roaming stack — supplier onboarding, contractual/technical cutover, parallel-run and rollback planning, and de-risking the transition away from single-supplier dependency.
  • Run program governance: maintain roadmaps, RAID logs, release trains, and cross-functional launch-readiness reviews; make dependencies and risks visible before they become escalations.
  • Own the metrics that matter: onboarding cycle time, signalling success/attach rates, routing correctness, CDR and settlement accuracy, and billing-run reliability — and report them to engineering and commercial leadership.
  • Be the translation layer between deep network engineering and commercial/partner stakeholders, so that partner commitments and network reality stay aligned.

Sound like you You bring:

You know how wholesale roaming works end to end, and you have the program management discipline to keep a complex multi-partner portfolio running smoothly without losing track of the details.

  • 8+ years in mobile core / signalling engineering or technical program leadership, with deep, hands-on time in the signalling plane
  • Understanding of Signalling in 3GPP core, across EPC and 5GC:
    • NAS procedures (attach, TAU, service request) and the interfaces that carry them — S6a, S6c, S13, SGd, T6a — with fluency in Diameter base protocol, AVP design, realm/application routing, and error/overload handling.
    • DRA/DEA architecture: understanding of routing policy & topology
    • A clear grasp of the SS7/MAP ↔ Diameter boundary and IWF interworking (e.g. legacy SMS via MAP over IPX vs. SGd Diameter).
  • NB-IoT / CIoT and NTN signalling specifics: control-plane CIoT EPS optimisation, NIDD, and the way NTN propagation delay and timer handling (Rel-17 NTN) change attach/retransmission behaviour.
  • Hands-on roaming operations: IREG/TADIG, IR.21/RAEX, IPX interconnect, and per-partner signalling readiness.
  • Working understanding of billing & settlement as it depends on signalling and CDR generation: TAP3 (TD.57), RAP (TD.32), NRTRDE, and the CDR lifecycle from record generation to settlement.
  • Demonstrated track record shipping cross-functional network programs on time across engineering and external partners.
  • Credible in a signalling design review and in a partner integration call alike — equally at home with core engineers and external carrier counterparts.Every role at Skylo uses AI tools daily to amplify output. We expect active habits using AI tools and a track record of picking up new ones quickly.
It Would Be Great If You Had Experience With

  • NTN, NB-IoT, or cellular IoT connectivity experience.
  • SMS-over-NAS delivery paths (SGd Diameter and MAP-via-IPX), and CIoT optimizations (NIDD, control-plane CIoT).
  • Experience with wholesale roaming, MVNO/MVNE, or roaming-hub environments.
  • Familiarity with BCE and next-generation settlement, and with ERP/finance-system integration for billing.
  • Exposure to clearing-house and IPX supplier commercial/technical management.

What Success Looks Like (First 6-12 Months)

  • A single, trusted onboarding program that partner-facing and engineering teams both plan against — with cycle time trending down as volume grows.
  • Signalling and billing readiness treated as a gated part of every partner launch, not a post-launch surprise.
  • The multi-supplier roaming transition de-risked with a clear cutover and rollback plan, and no single-supplier lock-in surprises.
  • Program-level visibility into signalling and settlement health that leadership actually uses to make calls.

What We Offer

With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide and inclusive culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we also offer an attractive range benefits such as:

  • Competitive compensation packages including a stock option based equity program
  • Comprehensive benefits plan
  • Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement
  • A generous time off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad
  • Once in a lifetime opportunity to be a part of developing and running world's first commercial, live direct-to-device satellite network and service
  • Access to world-class team and talent across tech domains: software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite and network virtualization
  • Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends the Silicon Valley, Nordic and South Asia characteristics

EEO Statement

Skylo is an equal-opportunity employer and we celebrate diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, parent or caregiver status, political affiliation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability.

This role involves training the next generation of medical professionals (undergraduates, postgraduates, and residents) while managing complex clinical cases, overseeing departmental administration, and spearheading clinical research or publications.

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled and precise Consultant Histopathologist to lead our tissue diagnostics section. The core responsibility involves macroscopically examining (grossing) and microscopically analyzing surgical resections and biopsies to detect malignancies, inflammatory conditions, and infectious diseases. The ideal candidate ensures the highest level of diagnostic accuracy, strictly follows NABL/ISO 15189 compliance protocols, and collaborates closely with oncologists and surgeons to determine patient treatment pathways.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gross & Microscopic Examination: Perform macroscopic description (grossing) and processing of surgical biopsies and large resection specimens. Examine stained slides under the microscope to provide definitive diagnostic insights.
  • Oncopathology Staging: Accurately classify tumors, grade malignancies, and evaluate surgical margins according to standard guidelines (e.g., CAP protocols).
  • Specialized Testing Interpretation: Order and interpret Immunohistochemistry (IHC) markers, special stains, and molecular diagnostic tests to confirm complex or borderline diagnoses.
  • Cytopathology Reporting: Oversee or perform reporting for Fine Needle Aspiration Cytology (FNAC), exfoliative cytology, and fluid pap smears when required.
  • Frozen Section Analysis: Perform intraoperative consultations (frozen sections) and give rapid, accurate diagnoses to surgeons during active operating procedures.
  • Quality Assurance: Direct the quality control of the histopathology lab, including tissue processing, embedding, microtomy, and staining quality. Ensure complete NABL documentation and active participation in EQAS (External Quality Assessment Schemes).
  • Clinical Consultation: Discuss complex, high-stakes cases directly with referring clinicians, oncologists, or surgeons, and actively participate in Multidisciplinary Team (MDT) tumor boards.

Key Competencies & Technical Skills

CompetencySpecific Skill SetDiagnostic Accuracy Deep expertise in oncopathology, pattern recognition, and tumor margin evaluation. Advanced Techniques High proficiency in interpreting IHC panels and liquid-based cytology (LBC). Manual Dexterity High precision in handling fine biopsies and performing uniform tissue grossing. Lab Automation Familiarity with automated tissue processors, microtomes, and Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS).

Qualifications & Experience

  • Education: MD in Pathology / DNB in Pathology from a recognized medical institution. An additional fellowship in Oncopathology or Surgical Pathology is a strong advantage.
  • Experience: 2 to 5+ years of dedicated experience in histopathology reporting within a reputed diagnostic network or corporate hospital setting.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
About Bytebeam

Bytebeam builds the hardware and software stack for next-generation connected vehicles and IoT devices. Our platform helps teams collect telemetry, monitor device health, debug issues remotely, push OTA updates, generate alerts, and operate connected fleets at scale. We are now building the intelligence layer on top of this data: algorithms that convert raw vehicle signals into diagnostics, predictions, recommendations, and real-world business outcomes.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to build production-grade algorithms for connected vehicles, EVs, and fleet systems.

This is not a dashboard-only analytics role. You will work with noisy field telemetry, CAN/OBD/J1939 signals, fault codes, battery and powertrain data, sensor behavior, and service outcomes. You will design algorithms that detect issues, predict failures, explain root causes, recommend action, and continuously improve as more vehicles come online.

You should be comfortable moving from messy data exploration to deployable models, from signal-level debugging to fleet-level insights, and from interesting graph to customer can take action now.

What You'll Do

Build vehicle intelligence algorithms

Develop algorithms across areas such as fuel, EV battery health, diagnostics, driver behavior, and predictive maintenance. Example problem areas include:

  • Fuel theft, refill, drain, consumption, fill-rate detection, and fuel-sensor failure detection.
  • Fuel rail pressure, pumping efficiency, oil pressure, turbo-health, air-filter, coolant-temperature, and powertrain anomaly detection.
  • DEF efficiency, DPF health, air-intake-system performance, and after-treatment diagnostics.
  • Ambient-aware EV range prediction, battery SOH/SOC estimation, battery-pack temperature forecasting, and battery-swap readiness signals.
  • Driver-behavior scoring and fuel-efficiency impact attribution.
  • Fault-code aggregation, diagnostic-code sequencing, RCA, upstream failure analysis, and guided repair recommendations.

Own the full algorithm lifecycle

Take algorithms from data discovery to production. This includes data cleaning, signal validation, feature engineering, model development, offline evaluation, field validation, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, and iteration.

Work with real-world vehicle telemetry

Handle missing data, sensor noise, inconsistent calibration, vehicle variants, firmware differences, network gaps, and edge cases from field deployments.

Partner across teams

Work closely with firmware, hardware, validation, cloud, product, customer success, and field teams. You will use bench data, vehicle logs, service feedback, and customer reports to make algorithms reliable outside the lab.

Build explainable and actionable outputs

Translate model outputs into alerts, diagnostics, probable causes, recommended fixes, confidence levels, and fleet-level insights. The goal is not just prediction. The goal is useful action.

Must-Have Skills

  • 4+ years of experience in applied ML, data science, algorithm engineering, signal processing, or time-series analytics.
  • Strong Python skills, including NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, and production-quality data pipelines.
  • Experience with time-series data, anomaly detection, forecasting, classification, regression, rule-based systems, or hybrid ML plus heuristics.
  • Strong SQL and comfort working with large telemetry datasets.
  • Experience converting messy sensor data into robust features and measurable algorithms.
  • Ability to evaluate algorithms using precision, recall, false-positive rate, latency, confidence, coverage, and field impact.
  • Experience productionizing models or algorithms, not just building notebooks.
  • Strong debugging instincts and ability to reason from first principles.

Strongly Preferred

  • Automotive, EV, IoT, fleet, industrial, or embedded-systems data experience.
  • Familiarity with CAN, OBD-II, J1939, UDS, DTCs, ECUs, telematics devices, or vehicle logs.
  • Experience with EV battery systems, BMS data, SOC/SOH estimation, thermal models, or range prediction.
  • Experience with diesel/powertrain systems such as DPF, DEF, turbo, fuel rail, oil pressure, coolant temperature, and air intake.
  • Experience with streaming data, Kafka/Flink/Spark, Airflow, data lakes, or real-time analytics.
  • Exposure to online learning, reinforcement learning, auto-calibration, Bayesian methods, Kalman filters, survival models, causal inference, graph-based diagnostics, or sequence models.
  • Ability to build simple internal tools, dashboards, notebooks, or scripts for validation and debugging.

Good-to-Have

  • Experience deploying algorithms to edge devices or constrained environments.
  • Experience working with firmware and hardware teams.
  • Knowledge of MLOps, model monitoring, experiment tracking, and model governance.
  • Rust, Go, or systems-programming exposure.
  • Prior work in predictive maintenance, remote diagnostics, fleet intelligence, insurance telematics, energy analytics, or connected vehicle platforms.

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days: Understand Bytebeam's telemetry schema, vehicle signal sources, customer use cases, and current alerting/diagnostics stack. Identify the first 2 to 3 high-value algorithms to build or improve.

First 90 days: Ship one validated algorithm into pilot use, with clear metrics, alert definitions, dashboards, and field feedback loops.

First 6 months: Own a small portfolio of production algorithms across vehicle health, diagnostics, fuel/energy, or EV battery intelligence. Reduce false positives, improve diagnostic accuracy, and create reusable algorithm frameworks for future use cases.

Ideal Candidate

You are a builder who can speak both ML and machines. You enjoy data, but you do not hide inside notebooks. You can sit with a field log, a firmware engineer, a DTC sequence, and a customer complaint, then emerge with an algorithm that actually helps someone fix a vehicle faster.

You care about precision, but also about practicality. You know that the best algorithm is not always the fanciest one. Sometimes it is a calibrated rule, sometimes a state machine, sometimes a tree model, sometimes a forecast.

Description

Drive transformative technical programs that solve complex retail challenges by bridging science, data engineering, and business operations at Amazon scale. You'll own end-to-end delivery of ML/AI-powered solutions that impact billions in gross merchandise sales and hundreds of millions of customers worldwide, while collaborating with Applied Science, Data Engineering, Finance, and Retail leadership across the organization.

A day in the life

As a Senior Technical Program Manager in Retail Business Services, you'll navigate the intersection of machine learning innovation and retail operations. Your day might include facilitating a design discussion with our Applied Science team to evaluate trade-offs in a new catalog enrichment model, then pivoting to align cross-functional stakeholders on data pipeline architecture for supply chain defect elimination. You'll also prepare executive narratives for leadership forums, manage competing priorities across multiple retail organizations, and identify risks early to keep large-scale programs on track. Throughout it all, you're solving problems that directly affect how millions of products are discovered and purchased by customers globally.

About The Team

We are a team of technical leaders and builders focused on scaling Amazon's retail operations through intelligent automation. Our mission is to ensure that Amazon's catalog is complete, correct, and comprehensive—enabling customers to find exactly what they need every time. We work at the intersection of science, data, and retail business, tackling challenges that span catalog quality, inventory optimization, cost allocation, and supply chain efficiency.

Our team collaborates closely with Applied Science, Data Engineering, Finance, Operations, and Retail organizations worldwide. jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Powering the world's payments ecosystem

ACI powers the payments ecosystem - globally, and you power ACI. You'll innovate, collaborate, and grow - in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers - in all roles and levels - are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments.

As a Technical Program Managerin Bangalore, you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world's payments ecosystem!

Job Purpose

The Technical Program Manager is an individual contributor responsible for implementing portfolio management processes, configuring work management systems, and delivering data analytics that support portfolio visibility, execution, and decision-making.

This role translates strategic portfolio objectives into operational execution through hands-on process design, workflow engineering, Agile planning, reporting, and metrics development. The role partners closely with Engineering, Product, Agile, and leadership teams to improve delivery predictability, governance, and business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio & Process Management

  • Design and implement standardized intake workflows, prioritization frameworks, governance processes, and portfolio operating models.
  • Establish quarterly planning practices, including PI Planning, capacity planning, retrospectives, and continuous improvement routines.
  • Create and maintain documentation such as RACI matrices, SOPs, workflow diagrams, process guides, and training materials.
  • Drive process adoption through change management, stakeholder engagement, training, and self-service knowledge resources.
  • Conduct process reviews, identify improvement areas, and implement corrective actions.
  • Partner with Agile coaches and delivery teams to align portfolio processes with team-level ceremonies.

Workflow Tool Engineering

  • Configure and optimize work management tools including Azure DevOps, Jira, Smartsheet, and Power BI.
  • Build boards, queries, dashboards, work item hierarchies, automation rules, and reporting structures.
  • Create stakeholder-specific dashboards and reports to support delivery visibility and portfolio governance.
  • Provide advanced user support for complex tool, workflow, reporting, and configuration issues.
  • Develop user guides, FAQs, training materials, and platform enablement resources.

Data Analytics & Business Intelligence

  • Design and deliver dashboards for executives, program managers, and delivery teams.
  • Track portfolio health, milestones, risks, dependencies, budget, and delivery performance.
  • Implement and report on DORA Metrics including deployment frequency, lead time, MTTR, and change failure rate.
  • Establish Flow Metrics including cycle time, lead time, throughput, WIP, and flow efficiency.
  • Create executive-level reporting that converts complex data into clear insights and recommendations.
  • Support forecasting, variance analysis, burn-rate tracking, and data quality improvements.

Portfolio Coordination & Delivery Support

  • Coordinate quarterly planning events, governance meetings, and cross-functional working sessions.
  • Track actions, decisions, risks, dependencies, and schedule conflicts.
  • Support software initiatives from concept through delivery, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and business outcomes.
  • Oversee SDLC execution across requirements, development, testing, release, and post-launch activities.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives for the Biller Portfolio.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

Experience

  • 2 to 5 years of experience in program management, portfolio operations, PMO, Agile delivery, or related functions.
  • Hands-on experience administering Azure DevOps, Jira, Smartsheet, or similar work management tools.
  • Experience configuring workflows, dashboards, reports, and process templates.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence tools.
  • Experience supporting Agile teams using Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or similar methodologies.
  • Experience implementing or improving portfolio management processes.

Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in Azure DevOps including boards, queries, dashboards, and process templates.
  • Strong proficiency in Jira/Jira Cloud including JQL, workflows, automation, and portfolio views.
  • Working knowledge of Smartsheet, APIs, webhooks, or workflow integrations.
  • Proficiency in Power BI, data modeling, DAX, and visualization.
  • Strong Excel skills including pivot tables, lookups, Power Query, and reporting.
  • SQL knowledge for querying and analyzing data.
  • Understanding of data quality, validation, and reporting governance.
  • Ability to use AI tools for analytics, documentation, analysis, and content preparation.

Methodology & Metrics Knowledge

  • Portfolio management, prioritization, governance, and capacity management.
  • Agile methodologies including Scrum, Kanban, and SAFe.
  • DevOps practices and engineering productivity measurement.
  • ITIL/ITSM and PMI/PMBOK principles preferred.
  • Flow Metrics including cycle time, lead time, throughput, and WIP.
  • DORA Metrics including deployment frequency, lead time, MTTR, and change failure rate.
  • Financial and portfolio metrics including burn rate, variance analysis, ROI, and resource loading.

Professional Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to adapt communication style for technical, business, and executive audiences.
  • Strong facilitation skills for planning sessions and working groups.
  • High attention to detail in tool configuration, documentation, and reporting.
  • Customer-service mindset with the ability to support and enable users.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Strong collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement mindset.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP, CAPM, PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe, or similar Agile/program management certification.
  • Atlassian, Microsoft, Power BI, ITIL, or Lean Six Sigma certification.
  • Experience in payments, financial services, SaaS, or regulated industries.
  • Experience implementing DORA or Flow Metrics programs.
  • Experience with enterprise portfolio management tools such as Planview or ServiceNow PPM.
  • Scripting or automation exposure using Python, PowerShell, Groovy, or similar technologies.
  • Intermediate SQL skills.

Work Environment

  • Standard office environment with frequent computer-based work.
  • Hybrid work model with regular in-office presence as required.
  • Collaboration with global teams across Engineering, Product, Agile, and business functions.
  • Minimal travel may be required for planning sessions, workshops, or business meetings.

In return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package-all within an innovative and collaborative work environment.

Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Role

We are seeking an experienced, self-driven Senior AI & Agent Developer with 4 to 6 years of experience to join our engineering team in a Hybrid model. In this role, you will act as a core Individual Contributor, owning the end-to-end lifecycle of our cloud-based AI initiatives.

You will heavily leverage tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate development speed, while designing, building, and maintaining multi-agent systems and advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines natively on the Azure Cloud platform using Azure AI Foundry. Beyond code development, you will take full operational support ownership of live agents and act as a technical mentor to upskill and train our existing engineering team on cloud-native AI practices.

Clinisys AI Philosophy

Building an AI‑first organisation is central to Clinisys purpose and the impact we deliver. As a global provider of intelligent diagnostic informatics solutions, we build AI‑enabled, cloud‑based platforms to enhance diagnostic workflows across healthcare, life sciences, and public health. By applying intelligent technology thoughtfully and responsibly, we help laboratories and testing environments operate more effectively, generate meaningful insights at scale, and ultimately support healthier and safer communities. Operating across more than 30 countries, Clinisys expects all colleagues—regardless of role or function—to work confidently with AI‑enabled tools, apply digital and analytical thinking, and continuously adapt as technologies evolve. We must drive an AI-first sense of purpose and urgency.

Key Responsibilities

  • AI Agent Development & Core Engineering
  • Architect and Build: Design and develop production-grade multi-agent frameworks and enterprise LLM applications using Python.
  • Cloud-Native AI: Build, deploy, and evaluate models directly within the Azure AI Foundry ecosystem.
  • Advanced RAG Pipelines: Implement complex Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, integrating advanced semantic search, chunking strategies, and re-ranking techniques.
  • Vector Infrastructure: Set up and manage vector databases (such as Azure AI Search or specialized vector stores) for efficient embedding storage and high-speed similarity searches.
  • AI-Assisted Coding: Maximize daily development efficiency and code quality by effectively utilizing GitHub Copilot.
  • Agent Maintenance & Production Support
  • Agent Operations (AgentOps): Actively monitor, debug, and provide production support for live autonomous AI agents to ensure runtime stability and minimal downtime.
  • Performance Optimization: Track token usage, optimize context windows, and implement robust guardrails within Azure to prevent agent hallucinations or infinite loops.
  • System Integration: Connect AI agent workflows with enterprise databases, Azure storage, and external third-party APIs.
  • Team Upskilling & Knowledge Sharing
  • Technical Training: Conduct structured workshops and hands-on coding sessions to elevate the AI capabilities of our internal engineering team.
  • Best Practices: Teach team members how to effectively prompt, use GitHub Copilot, and leverage Azure's AI suite.

Required Technical Skills

  • Programming Language: Absolute mastery of Python (object-oriented design, asynchronous programming, and clean code principles).
  • Cloud AI Ecosystem: Deep, hands-on experience using Azure AI Foundry (formerly Azure AI Studio) to manage, prompt, and evaluate LLMs.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Strong, hands-on proficiency with Azure Cloud Services (e.g., Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Azure Container Instances) making it seamless to deploy and manage backend code.
  • AI Frameworks & Vector Tools: Experience with orchestration frameworks (such as LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or LlamaIndex) and vector databases (such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, or Qdrant).
  • AI Tooling: Native workflow familiarity with GitHub Copilot for accelerated coding and code review.

Qualifications & Soft Skills

  • Experience: 4 to 6 years of professional software development experience, with a significant focus on cloud-native AI/ML engineering.
  • Autonomy: Proven track record as an independent Individual Contributor who can take an AI product from a cloud concept to live production support with minimal supervision.
  • Communication: Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with a clear passion for teaching, mentoring, and training other developers.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Controls Project Engineer I
jobs.description:
Controls Project Engineer I | Pune, India | Full-time

If you are passionate about industrial automation, PLC-based control systems, and delivering advanced automation solutions for material handling environments, this could be the ideal opportunity for you.

Your Role:

As a Senior Controls Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, development, testing, integration, and commissioning of Low-Level Controls (LLC) software for medium-to-large automated material handling systems. You will work with Siemens PLC technologies, SCADA, HMI, drives, and safety systems to deliver reliable and high-quality control solutions.

You will collaborate with multidisciplinary and international project teams, support customer-facing activities, provide technical guidance to junior engineers, and contribute to the continuous improvement and standardization of Vanderlande's controls solutions.

What you will do/Key Responsibilities:

Controls Software Development & Engineering

  • Design, develop, and test LLC software for medium-to-large automated material handling systems using Siemens TIA Portal.

  • Develop functional PLC software based on customer requirements, project specifications, and standard controls architecture.

  • Program and configure Siemens PLC systems using Ladder Logic, FBD, STL, and SCL.

  • Configure and integrate PLC, HMI, SCADA, drives, and safety systems.

  • Apply reusable software modules, library structures, and standardized controls solutions.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation including functional specifications, interface documents, and engineering deliverables.

Testing, Integration & Commissioning

  • Perform engineering, simulation, emulation, FAT, SAT, and site commissioning activities.

  • Troubleshoot software, communication, PLC, HMI, and controls-related issues during testing and commissioning.

  • Perform system integration activities with SCADA, Equipment Management, Mechanical, Electrical, and Safety disciplines.

  • Use Siemens diagnostic tools such as Proneta and online diagnostics for troubleshooting and system validation.

  • Support backup, version management, and software configuration activities.

  • Prepare test plans, commissioning documentation, and reports to support successful project delivery.

  • Support successful project handover and completion of Service Take Over (STO) deliverables.

Technical Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Identify project risks, technical issues, and dependencies and recommend appropriate mitigation actions.

  • Support customer meetings, design reviews, and technical discussions when required.

  • Mentor junior Controls Engineers and provide technical guidance during engineering, testing, and commissioning activities.

  • Ensure compliance with engineering standards, development processes, and quality guidelines.

  • Contribute to software standardization and continuous improvement of products, tools, and engineering processes.

  • Report technical progress, deviations, risks, and issues to the Project Lead Engineer and Group Leader.

  • Collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary and multicultural project teams across global locations.

What you bring:

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in industrial automation and PLC-based control systems.

  • Proven experience in engineering, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of automated material handling or industrial automation systems.

  • Experience working on international projects and site commissioning activities is preferred.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Siemens TIA Portal for PLC development, troubleshooting, testing, and commissioning.

  • Good understanding of SCADA systems and system integration.

  • Experience with HMI development, screen configuration, alarms, diagnostics, and operator interfaces.

  • Strong knowledge of:

    • Ladder Logic

    • Function Block Diagram (FBD)

    • Statement List (STL)

    • Structured Control Language (SCL)

  • Hands-on experience with:

    • PROFINET

    • PROFIBUS

    • AS-i

  • Familiarity with Siemens engineering and diagnostic tools including Proneta, online diagnostics, backup, and version management.

  • Working knowledge of Siemens PLC concepts including data blocks, indirect addressing, reusable software modules, and library structures.

  • Basic to intermediate experience with Safety PLC programming, testing, and troubleshooting.

  • Experience with Rockwell Studio 5000 and FactoryTalk View is an added advantage.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

  • Good communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary and multicultural project teams.

  • Willingness to travel internationally for commissioning and customer support, approximately 50-70%.

About Vanderlande:

Vanderlande makes automated systems that handle baggage at airports and sort parcels in logistics networks around the world. At airports, our technology manages the complete bag journey-from check-in and security screening through to the reclaim belt. In parcel logistics, our systems power the networks that get packages to customers doors.

At Vanderlande, you will find the space to aspire, to grow, and to achieve something that matters, with people who bring out the best in each other.

Website:

What we offer:

Working at Vanderlande comes with the support and space to grow, achieve, and enjoy the journey. Here is what that looks like in practice:

  • Competitive Salary Package

  • 30 days of annual leave (pro-rated from the start of the financial year), including:

    • 22 paid leave days

    • 8 sick/casual leave days

    • Applicable government holidays

  • Flexible and hybrid working model that promotes work-life balance

  • Access to Vanderlande Academy and a wide range of learning and development programs

  • Comprehensive medical insurance coverage, including parental coverage

  • Opportunities to participate in diverse Vanderlande communities, networks, and employee initiatives

  • Opportunity to collaborate globally with engineering teams and international customers

  • Exposure to advanced automation and material handling technologies

How we work

We work by three values: Every day better, We care, and Team play.

In practice, this means we drive customer success, lead with transparency, celebrate what we achieve together, and do what we say.

Ready to apply

Are you interested in this position Apply directly via our careers page with your CV/Resume.

Diversity & Inclusion

Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Data Loss Prevention Engineer
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Ford's Cyber Security Data Protection team is the frontline defense for our global digital transformation. We manage a diverse portfolio of programs designed to enable a securely connected business while safeguarding the company's most critical data assets. As a DLP Senior Development Analyst, you will serve as a subject matter expert for our Microsoft Purview and Sentinel ecosystem. You will be responsible for architecting and optimizing our Data Loss Prevention framework, ensuring a robust security posture that proactively mitigates risk and prevents the unauthorized disclosure of sensitive information.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Architect & Engineer DLP Solutions: Lead the design and engineering of complex Data Loss Prevention projects, utilizing Python, Java, and Alteryx to build automated workflows and data-driven security controls.
  • API Strategy & Development: Drive the API roadmap for the Data Protection service architecting, developing, and managing RESTful APIs to integrate security tools and streamline internal analytics.
  • Full-Stack Security Engineering: Develop and maintain software within a GitHub-based environment, ensuring robust version control, documentation, and high-quality deployment of security-focused code.
  • Advanced Data Analytics: Build and optimize Alteryx workflows and data models to increase reporting speed, providing deep insights into data movement and potential exfiltration patterns.
  • Software Lifecycle Management: Oversee the end-to-end testing, deployment, and integration of working software and automated workflows, ensuring seamless performance across the security ecosystem.
  • Microsoft Purview Administration: Lead the technical administration of Microsoft Purview, including the architecture and implementation of advanced DLP policies tailored to Ford's global requirements.
  • Stakeholder Architecture Reviews: Formalize and present complex technical architectures to stakeholders, securing approvals and ensuring alignment with Ford's broader cybersecurity standards.
  • Strategic Business Liaison: Translate complex business requirements into technical deliverables, negotiating feasibility and resource allocation with key stakeholders and business customers.
  • Continuous Security Improvement: Define and implement process and technology enhancements to prevent the unauthorized disclosure, modification, or removal of Ford's most sensitive data.
  • Policy Tuning & Optimization: Aggregate and analyze global DLP telemetry to tune existing policies, reduce false positives, and determine where additional technical controls are required.
  • Advanced Threat Analysis: Perform high-level triage and analysis of DLP alerts, managing the remediation of complex incidents and escalating critical risks to leadership.
  • Global Metric Reporting: Design and deliver comprehensive data protection metrics to provide leadership with visibility into the global data loss risk posture.
  • Technical Leadership: Maintain a high degree of technical curiosity, proactively learning and implementing emerging technologies to solve Ford's most challenging data protection problems.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Foundational Education: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related STEM field.
  • Core Professional Experience:
    • 3+ years in a Cybersecurity role, specifically focused on Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Data Governance, or Security Engineering.
    • 3+ years of hands-on experience architecting and managing Microsoft Purview (MIP) and Microsoft Sentinel in a large-scale enterprise environment.
  • Advanced Software Engineering: Proven expertise in Software Engineering Architecture, Lifecycle (SDLC), and Data Management within a GitHub-based environment.
  • Full-Stack Development & Automation: Proficiency in Python or Java development with a focus on building automated security workflows and technical solutions.
  • API Architecture & Management: Extensive experience designing, implementing, and managing RESTful APIs to enable system integration and advanced data analytics.
  • Data Protection Platforms: Deep technical expertise in the administration and architecture of Microsoft Purview, Sentinel, and Defender for Endpoint, including the use of KQL (Kusto Query Language).
  • Automated Data Analytics: Expert-level experience with Alteryx workflow development and data modeling to process global DLP telemetry and increase reporting speed.
  • DLP Policy Engineering: Experience in Policy Tuning and Optimization, including the creation of advanced DLP policies and the analysis of data loss patterns to determine additional controls.
  • Regulatory & Compliance Mastery: Demonstrated experience implementing security controls within a highly regulated environment (e.g., Banking, Finance, or Government), with a deep understanding of GLBA and global privacy compliance.
  • Technical Solution Design: Ability to perform Architecture Knowledge mapping and translate complex business requirements into high-level technical deliverables.
  • Cloud & Emerging Tech: Hands-on experience with GCP (Google Cloud Platform) and familiarity with developing or implementing machine learning algorithms to enhance data classification.
  • Strategic Leadership: Strong Software Engineering Leadership skills with the ability to train, advise, and mentor team members on technical best practices.
  • Stakeholder Management: Excellent written and oral communication skills, with a proven ability to present complex architectures to management and collaborate with global stakeholders.
  • Analytical Problem Solving: Strong decision-making skills with a process-driven mindset and a find-a-way attitude toward solving challenging technical assignments.
  • Professional Toolset: Proficiency in Data Visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and the Microsoft Office 365 suite for advanced data reporting.

We're hiring a Research Analyst for our 1Network team! In this role, you'll ensure that B2B projects are executed smoothly by onboarding the right professionals in line with client requirements and within the required timelines.

  • Understanding project scope and identifying relevant industry stakeholders including dealers, distributors, retailers, doctors, channel partners, and B2B respondents through LinkedIn, Naukri, industry databases, and professional networks.

  • Focused approach to problem-solving along with a strong background in networking.
